verses.niv: On my account you will be brought before governors and kings as witnesses to them and to the Gentiles.

verses.kom: Ghɨ ghal zɨ̀ tî, ka yì na kayn mbzɨ nâ yi n-ndû bê na gha a, ka yi n-kayn nô mɨ nâ yi ndû bê ti a, bòm ta yi ndû chem afu, a ghɨ fe’tɨ iwo zɨ̀ a ka yì be.
verses.niv: But when they arrest you, do not worry about what to say or how to say it. At that time you will be given what to say,

verses.kom: A nì nà laynsɨ̂ taŋî wì zɨ, a nì nà taŋî Ayvɨs a Bò vzɨ toynɨ̂ a zɨ.
verses.niv: for it will not be you speaking, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.

verses.kom: «Ɨtu’ nâ vzɨ̀ læò kfeyna, a wùl ɨ̀ na lî wayn-nà ŋweyn, wu fu na ghɨ zue, bæò ɨ lî wayn, wu fu na ghɨ zue. Woyn ghɨ li læò lalì-à ɨ̀ kè’ ghɨ̀nì nɨ̀ ghɨ̀bæ ɨ̀ fì nì a ghɨ na zuetɨ̂ àŋena.
verses.niv: “Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; children will rebel against their parents and have them put to death.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ læò nà bâyn zɨ̀ kɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m bòm mà, mɨtì ma à wèynsɨ mɨ ndà sɨ chem a ngò’sɨ, a wù bœ.
verses.niv: All men will hate you because of me, but he who stands firm to the end will be saved.

verses.kom: Ghɨ cho’ àvɨ à ki-a a ntè’, yi le’ ɨ ndu kɨ a ntè’ ɨ yîlù. Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na yì læò nî mesì wì ifêl ì zɨ-i a ntè’sɨ Isìlæò sɨ̀ jɨ̀m bùla Wâyn Wùl ɨ̀ kasi gvì.
verses.niv: When you are persecuted in one place, flee to another. I tell you the truth, you will not finish going through the cities of Israel before the Son of Man comes.

verses.kom: «Ba yi n-kya na wayndà ɨ ye’inɨ kà’ wu bu nà chwô ndyèynsɨ̀ ŋweyn, kya kɨmɨ na wùl ɨ̀ fèlɨnɨ bû tìmi nà chwô bò ìfèl.
verses.niv: “A student is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his master.

verses.kom: Yi n-kfeynɨ-à ta ka wayndà ɨ ye’inɨ ye’i, nà ghɨ kɨmɨ ta ndyèynsɨ̀ ŋweyn, fî kfeynɨ-à ta ka wùl ɨ̀ fèlɨnɨ fel ɨ̀ ko’ ɨ̀ kfèynɨ sɨ nà ghɨ kɨmɨ ta bò ìfèl. Ghɨ kæ sɨ nà ghɨ ma ghɨ toŋtɨ meyn bò ndo nɨ̀ ìzɨyn i, yi bef tèyn na Belzibùl, ghɨ læ toŋtɨ nô ghelɨ ndo na gha?
verses.niv: It is enough for the student to be like his teacher, and the servant like his master. If the head of the house has been called Beelzebub, how much more the members of his household!

verses.kom: «Ka yì fi læ̂ fàyn ghelɨ bòm ta afo nɨn ghɨ wi a ghɨ chɨ̀ytɨ a ghɨ læò ŋa’sɨ wi, kèsa ghɨ lèytɨ̀ leytɨ a ghɨ læò faŋ tɨ̀ kèli.
verses.niv: “So do not be afraid of them. There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, or hidden that will not be made known.

verses.kom: Ma nya’tɨ bè be iwo sɨ̂ zɨ̀ lvɨ̂yn, yi læ bè a ndayn sɨ̂ ghelɨ, ɨ̀ chɨ̀mtɨ̀ chɨmtɨ, yi læ se’ jàŋ ɨwe.
verses.niv: What I tell you in the dark, speak in the daylight; what is whispered in your ear, proclaim from the roofs.

verses.kom: Ka yì na fâyn ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ kà’ a ghɨ zue kɨ̀ acha’ ɨwùyn nɨ̀ wùl, mɨtì ma ghɨ kà’ ghɨ bû zue ayvɨs a ŋweyn. Yì na kwo fâyn kɨ Fɨ̀yìnì. Fɨ n-kelɨ àdya’ sɨ bebsɨ ayvɨs a wûl nɨ̀ àcha’ a ŋweyn a ɨvɨ̀s.
verses.niv: Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Rather, be afraid of the One who can destroy both soul and body in hell.

verses.kom: Ba ghɨ n-bey’lɨ̂ mɨ̀nkfala’ ɨ̀m bò kɨ̀ sɨ a fɨkwôtɨ̀ tèyn, mɨtì fɨ̀mò’ fɨ ghɨ wi a fɨ kà’ a fɨ chem a nse, a bu kɨ na à kòŋ Bò vzɨ, ɨ Fɨ̀yìnì?
verses.niv: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father.

verses.kom: Nô mɨ nyuŋsɨ atu nɨ̀ zɨ̀sɨ nɨn ghɨ, Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ kya àkôyn ateyn.
verses.niv: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

verses.kom: Yi ti n-ghɨ na yi n-kelɨ wi sɨ nà fayn afo bòm ta yi n-ko’nɨ̂ chwô mɨ̀nkfala’, mɨ dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn.
verses.niv: So don't be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.

verses.kom: «À dyèyn mɨ ndà asɨ nɨ̀ ghelɨ na yi n-ghɨ wul ɨ̀ wom, a mâ mà læ̂ boŋ bɨ̀mi sɨ̂ Bò wom iyvɨ na wù n-ghɨ wul ɨ̀ wom.
verses.niv: “Whoever acknowledges me before men, I will also acknowledge him before my Father in heaven.

verses.kom: À kæ mo mɨ ndà ma asɨ nɨ̀ ghelɨ, a mâ mà læ̂ boŋ mo ŋweyn asɨ nɨ̀ Bò wom iyvɨ.
verses.niv: But whoever disowns me before men, I will disown him before my Father in heaven.

verses.kom: «Ka yì na kfâ’ na mà gvì a nse afêyn sɨ nì na ghelɨ na chî nɨ̀ mbôynɨ̀. Ma bu gvì nɨ̀ mbôynɨ̀, mà kwo gvì sɨ nì na ghelɨ na nu-à.
verses.niv: “Do not suppose that I have come to bring peace to the earth. I did not come to bring peace, but a sword.

verses.kom: Mà gvì sɨ nì na wayn lûmnɨ̀ lali ɨ̀ kè’ bæò, wayn wi lali ɨ̀ kè’ nì, wî wàyn lali ɨ̀ kè’ nà lum.
verses.niv: For I have come to turn  “ ‘a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law–

verses.kom: Mbàynɨ̀sɨ wûl ɨ sɨ asɨsɨ læò nà fvɨ̂ kɨ a ŋweyn a ndo.
verses.niv: a man's enemies will be the members of his own household.’

verses.kom: «À n-kôŋ mɨ ndà ɨ bò ŋweyn nɨ̀ nà ŋweyn chwô ta wù n-koŋ ma, a wù na kfeynɨ̂ wì sɨ nà ghɨ njùmtɨ̀ ìbam nɨ̀ mà; à na kôŋ mɨ ndà wâyn ŋweyn chwô ta wù n-koŋ ma, a wù na kfeynɨ̂ wì sɨ nà ghɨ njùmtɨ̀ ìbam nɨ̀ mà.
verses.niv: “Anyone who loves his father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; anyone who loves his son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me;

verses.kom: À fàŋ mɨ ndà tɨ̀ bèy’i ànwâmnɨ̀ a ŋweyn sɨ jùmtɨ ma, wu bû kfèynɨ sɨ nà ghɨ njùmtɨ̀ yem.
verses.niv: and anyone who does not take his cross and follow me is not worthy of me.

verses.kom: À mòmsɨ̀ mɨ ndà sɨ chi sɨ faŋ, a wù kfɨ; a kfɨ mɨ ndà bòm mà, a wù chî faŋ.
verses.niv: Whoever finds his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for my sake will find it.

verses.kom: «À tò’nɨ̀ mɨ nda nɨ̀ zɨ̀, a à na ghɨ ma wù tò’nɨ̀ nɨ̀ mà, à tô’nɨ̀ mɨ nda nɨ̀ mà, a à na ghɨ ma wù tò’nɨ̀ nɨ̀ ɨvzɨ̂ a wù tum ma.
verses.niv: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives the one who sent me.

verses.kom: À tò’nɨ̀ mɨ nda nɨ̀ wùl bòm ta wùl àteyn nɨ̀n ghɨ nfè’tɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì, a wù keli ɨmwa’tɨ kɨ̀mɨ ta nfè’tɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì, à fsɨ mɨ ndà wul bòm ta wùl àteyn nɨ̀n ghɨ àtì-ati asɨ nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀, a wù keli ɨmwa’tɨ ɨ wûl àtì-ati.
verses.niv: Anyone who receives a prophet because he is a prophet will receive a prophet's reward, and anyone who receives a righteous man because he is a righteous man will receive a righteous man's reward.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na à fù mɨ ndà kɨ̀ nô bôm mù ɨn saynɨ̂ sɨ̂ wùl ɨ̀ mò’ antêynɨ̀ nɨ̀ woyn ghɨ telâ ghèyn bòm ta wayn ɨ twelâ àteyn nɨ̀n ghɨ njùmtɨ̀ ìbam nɨ̀ mà, jèl mɨ ti, a wù læ̂ kèli ɨ̀mwa’tɨ ɨ ŋweyn.»
verses.niv: And if anyone gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is my disciple, I tell you the truth, he will certainly not lose his reward.”

verses.kom: A nà n-ghɨ ta Jisòs ɨ̀ yè’i meyn mèsì njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibàm nɨ̀ ŋweyn njvàsɨ̀ bò, wu lù sɨ afu ɨ nà sɨ fê’tɨ̀ ìwo i Fɨ̂yìnì fî ye’î ndû nɨ̀ ghelɨ a ntè’ sɨ lisɨ a Galìlî.
verses.niv: After Jesus had finished instructing his twelve disciples, he went on from there to teach and preach in the towns of Galilee.

verses.kom: Joyn Nfû Mù nɨn læ meyn yvɨ awo kì a Christ nà n-nî, ghɨ a ncha’ ɨ tum njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweyn sɨ lisɨ na sɨ ndu bɨf sɨ̂ Christ na,
verses.niv: When John heard in prison what Christ was doing, he sent his disciples

verses.kom: «À n-ghɨ và vzɨ̀ a wà tî nà ghɨ sɨ gvì ma, ghès nɨn kelɨ sɨ nà chitɨ wul ɨ wûlù a?»
verses.niv: to ask him, “Are you the one who was to come, or should we expect someone else?”

verses.kom: Àŋena ndù ɨ bɨf, Jisòs ɨ bè na, «Yì kasi ndù fè’tɨ̀ àwo kì sɨ̂ Joyn a yi n-yvɨ sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghɨ li fî yeyn nô sɨ a yi a ngeŋsɨ:
verses.niv: Jesus replied, “Go back and report to John what you hear and see:

verses.kom: ɨ̀nfèf ɨ̀ nɨn kasî yeyn ɨ̀lwê’, mɨ̀ngês ɨ jelà, ghelɨ ànsàsì ɨ to, ɨ̀nkù’ ɨ yvɨ àwo, ghelɨ ghɨ kfɨtɨnɨ lalì sɨ ikfɨ, ghɨ fî fê’tɨ̀ ntum ì jùŋ sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghɨ bolɨ.
verses.niv: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, those who have leprosy are cured, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.

verses.kom: Njùŋ nɨ̀n ghɨ sɨ̂ wùl vzɨ̀ a wù bû mà’ì ìbɨmi zɨ̀ a wù n-kelɨ sɨ̂ mà.»
verses.niv: Blessed is the man who does not fall away on account of me.”

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ Joynsɨ ɨ ni nà sɨ kasî lu-à, Jisòs ɨ zɨ̀tɨ̀ sɨ nà taŋi sɨ̂ ìnôyn i ghêl zɨ̀-ì kûm Joyn, bɨf na, «Yi n-læ ndù a nse iyum sɨ yeyn gha afu a? Yi n-læ ndù sɨ yeyn wul wu ne’à ta agâŋlɨ̀ ɨlvɨ ta afyef a nɨn chwô ma,
verses.niv: As John's disciples were leaving, Jesus began to speak to the crowd about John: “What did you go out into the desert to see? A reed swayed by the wind?

verses.kom: yi n-læ ndù nô bòm ghà, sɨ yeyn wul ta wù làf ilaf i juŋì ma? Ngaŋ! Yi n-kya na ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-laf a dzɨ nâ ghè nɨ̀n chî kɨ a nto’.
verses.niv: If not, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? No, those who wear fine clothes are in kings' palaces.

verses.kom: Yì fe’tɨ læ̂ sɨ̂ mà nâ yi n-læ ndu bòm ghà a, sɨ yeyn nfè’tɨ i gha’nɨ ma? Yi n-ghɨ kɨ nô tèyn. Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na yi n-læ meyn yeyn wul, wu n-chwô nfè’tɨ i gha’nɨ,
verses.niv: Then what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.

verses.kom: bòm ta Joyn nɨn ghɨ tèyn a ghɨ wul ɨ vzɨ̀ a ghɨ n-læ nyà’ a Ŋwà’lɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì kûm ŋweyn na: ‹Yeyna, mà læò tum wul ɨ̀ ntum nɨ̀ mà, a wù ndu a wa asɨ ɨ̀ fàytɨ dzɨ ɨ̀ zyâ sɨ̂ và.›
verses.niv: This is the one about whom it is written: “ ‘I will send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way before you.’

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na wùl ɨ̀ bu tìmi nà ghɨ a nse afêyn chwô Joyn Nfû Mù, mɨtì nô mɨ ɨvzɨ̂ a wù læ gò’sɨ̀ alè’ ɨfòyn nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ ɨ chwô ŋweyn.
verses.niv: I tell you the truth: Among those born of women there has not risen anyone greater than John the Baptist; yet he who is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

verses.kom: Ɨfôyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì nɨn lemâ ndû kɨ asɨ nɨ̀ àdya’ a kɨ̀ sɨ zɨ̀tɨ̀ ɨtu’ ta Joyn Nfû Mù nɨn læ zɨ̀tɨ ifêl i ŋweyn, ghelɨ adya’ ɨ nû nu sɨ zɨ alè’ ɨfoyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì nâ ghàyn, sâ’ sa’ ɨfoyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì nâ wèyn.
verses.niv: From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven has been forcefully advancing, and forceful men lay hold of it.

verses.kom: Nô nfè’tɨ̀ sɨ gha’nɨsɨ sɨ̀ jɨ̀m nɨ̀ Ìsa’ i Mosìs ì ɨ nà n-taŋî kûm kɨ ìgvî ɨfoyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì jæ nô ta ka Joyn læ̂ boŋ ɨ̀ gvì.
verses.niv: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.

verses.kom: Yi kæ sɨ nà koŋ sɨ bɨmi, yi nà kya na Joyn nâ wèyn nɨ̀n ghɨ Ìlajà vzɨ̀ a ghɨ n-læ bè na wù n-gvi-à.
verses.niv: And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.

verses.kom: À na tof mɨ ndà, wu nà tô’ yvɨtɨ-à.
verses.niv: He who has ears, let him hear.

verses.kom: «Mà ti kà’ a mà fe’nɨ ghelɨ mbzɨ̂ layn nô nɨ̀ ghà? Àŋena nɨn ghɨ ta woynda a ghɨ n-du’ ɨwe, ghɨli jâŋ bê sɨ ghɨli na,
verses.niv: “To what can I compare this generation? They are like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to others:

verses.kom: ‹Ghès ɨ yem meyn njàŋsɨ fomnɨsɨ na yì cheŋ, yi faŋ tɨ̀ chèŋ, ɨ̀ yem njàŋsɨ ikfɨ na yì dzɨ, yi faŋ tɨ̀ dzɨ̀.›
verses.niv: “ ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge and you did not mourn.’

verses.kom: Joyn Nfû Mù nɨn læ meyn gvì ɨ nà yɨ wi afo, nyvɨ wi mɨlû’, ghɨ be kɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m na, ‹Wù n-kelɨ àyvɨs a bɨ-a.›
verses.niv: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’

verses.kom: Wâyn Wùl tî gvì, nà yɨ-a, nyvɨ-a, ghɨ bê na wù vzɨ̀ a wù n-yɨ chwôsɨ̀, nyvɨ chwôsɨ̀-à, fî ghɨ nɨ̀ ɨ̀suyn ŋêyn ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-teyn tâks nɨ̀ ghelɨ ghɨ bɨ ghɨ li! Mɨtì, Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ nɨn dyêyn na itof i nfeynfɨ-i nɨn ghɨ kɨ nô samo’ toynɨ̂ awo ghè a ghelɨ nfeynfɨ nɨn nî a àŋena nchînɨ̀sɨ̀.»
verses.niv: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Here is a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and “sinners.” ’ But wisdom is proved right by her actions.”

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ntè’ sisɨ̀ a Jisòs nɨn læ ni awo a kaynɨ-a a dvɨnɨ-a ateyn nɨn læ meyn teyn na ghɨ n-bêynsɨ̀ wì mɨtem sɨ a mbɨsɨ, Jisòs ɨ nà sɨ yolɨ̀ sɨ̂ àŋena bê na,
verses.niv: Then Jesus began to denounce the cities in which most of his miracles had been performed, because they did not repent.

verses.kom: «Nge’ i gha’nɨ læò nà ghɨ sɨ̂ zɨ̀ a ghelɨ Kòlàzîn kɨ̀mɨ nɨ̀ zɨ̀ a ghelɨ Bèsaydà! A nà n-ghɨ na ghɨ ni awo a kaynɨ-a kèynà sɨ̂ ghelɨ Tayà nɨ̀ ghelɨ Sidòn, ma àŋena nɨn læ meyn fu’ abvɨ ichɨ a àŋena ɨwùyn ɨ nyàŋsɨ mà’ fɨ̀ntsɨ ɨ bèynsɨ̀ mɨ̀tem sɨ a mbɨsɨ nɨ̀ àŋena.
verses.niv: “Woe to you, Korazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! If the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na, à læò nà ghɨ achi a nsa’ nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀, a nge’ na ghɨ sɨ̂ zɨ̀ chwô ta yì n-ghɨ sɨ̂ ghelɨ Tayà nɨ̀ ghelɨ Sidòn.
verses.niv: But I tell you, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

verses.kom: Zɨ̀ ghelɨ Kàbanùm, yi n-kfâ’tɨ̀ na Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ læò ko’sɨ̂ zɨ̀, a yì ko’ chem iyvɨ ma? Yi n-ghɨ wi tî. Fɨ læò mâ’ kɨ zɨ̀ ma’ alè’ ghè a kɨ sœ gò’sɨ̀. A nà n-ghɨ na ghɨ ni awo a kaynɨ-a kì a ghɨ nì a yi antêynɨ̀ a nte’ Sodòm, ma yì bu ghɨ kɨ ghɨ sɨ chem layn.
verses.niv: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to the skies? No, you will go down to the depths. If the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Sodom, it would have remained to this day.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na, à læò nà ghɨ achi a nsa’ nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀, a nge’ na ghɨ sɨ̂ zɨ̀ chwô ta yì n-ghɨ sɨ̂ ghelɨ Sodòm.»
verses.niv: But I tell you that it will be more bearable for Sodom on the day of judgment than for you.”

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨn læ meyn jèm sɨ̂ Bò ŋweyn kɨ̀mɨ ɨlvɨ nâ ghè ɨ bè na, «Bò wom, Bôbo vzɨ̀ a wà n-sa’ iyvɨ nɨ̀ nse, mɨ n-fu àyòŋnɨ̀ sɨ̂ và bòm ta wà lèytɨ̀ meyn àwo kèynà sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghì a àŋena nɨn kfâ’tɨ̀ na ghɨ n-tofa ɨ̀ dyèyn sɨ̂ mbu’sɨ.
verses.niv: At that time Jesus said, “I praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.

verses.kom: Samo’ a Bô, à tî kòŋ kɨ̀ vâ sɨ ni têyn.»
verses.niv: Yes, Father, for this was your good pleasure.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ fi kasi bè sɨ̂ ghelɨ na, «Bò wom fu meyn kɨ̀ ɨfwo ɨ̀ jɨ̀m sɨ̂ mà. Wùl nɨ̀n faytɨ̂ kya wi Wayn a bu kɨ Bæò, wùl ɨ faytɨ̂ kya wi Bæò a bu kɨ Wayn nɨ̀ ghelɨ ghì a Wàyn chò’ meyn sɨ dyeyn Bæò sɨ̂ àŋena.
verses.niv: “All things have been committed to me by my Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him.

verses.kom: «Zɨ̀ ghî a yì bèy’ì nge’sɨ ɨ̀ fì fèl ɨ̀ bol, yì gvi sɨ̂ mà, a ka mà ni, a yì yvɨtɨ.
verses.niv: “Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

verses.kom: Yì li ɨfyâŋ ifèl nɨ̀ mà, fì yè’i nchînɨ̀ yem bòm ta mɨ n-boynɨ, fî kelɨ ìngvɨmlɨ. Yì kæ ni têyn, a yì keli iyvɨ̂tɨ̀ a yi a mɨtèm.
verses.niv: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.

verses.kom: Ɨfyâŋ ɨ̀ wom nɨn boynɨ̂ sɨ ghal, afo kì a mɨ n-fu na yì bey’i ɨ dɨ̂l wì.»
verses.niv: For my yoke is easy and my burden is light.”

verses.kom: Ɨtu’ ɨ nɨ̀n layn meyn achi ɨtu’ ila’ a li-a, Jisòs ŋêyn njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ nà toynɨ̂ chwô ibal asaŋ a bola i li, jèŋ ɨ se sɨ yaf njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweyn, àŋena nà sɨ yolî ɨ̀tu asaŋ, kfɨla.
verses.niv: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry and began to pick some heads of grain and eat them.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ Falàsî ghɨ li yeyn ɨ nà sɨ bê sɨ̂ Jisòs na, «Yeyn iwo a njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ vàsɨ̀ nɨn nî achi ɨtu’ ila’, Isa’ i bɨmî wì a!»
verses.niv: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to him, “Look! Your disciples are doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yi bû jàŋ yvɨ iwo zɨ̀ a Devìt nɨn læ ni ta jèŋ ɨ nà n-yafɨ ŋweyn ŋêyn ghelɨ ŋweyn â?
verses.niv: He answered, “Haven't you read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?

verses.kom: Wu n-zɨ meyn a ndô Fɨ̀yìnì ŋêyn ghelɨ ŋweyn nâ ghì ɨ lì ɨ yɨ abayn a Fɨ̂yìnì, Isa’ i dyêyn na à n-yɨ kɨ ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì.
verses.niv: He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread –which was not lawful for them to do, but only for the priests.

verses.kom: A yi bû jàŋ yvɨ kɨ̀mɨ Isa’ nɨ̀ Mosìs na à n-gvî mɨ achi ɨtu’ ila’ à kà, ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnìsɨ̀ ɨ se sɨ nì ifêl, sɨ kòl ìsa’ zɨ̀ a yi n-kûm achi nâ kì, mɨtì yi nà dyêyn wì na àŋena ni meyn bèbsɨ ìwo?
verses.niv: Or haven't you read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple desecrate the day and yet are innocent?

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na iwo i fɨ-i nɨn ghɨ afêyn, chwô ìwo i ndô Fɨ̀yìnì i gha’nɨ.
verses.niv: I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

verses.kom: Yi nà n-kya iwo zɨ̀ a alê’ a Ŋwà’lɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì kèynà nɨn bê ma yi n-bê wì na ghelɨ ni meyn bèbsɨ ìwo, bùla àŋena nî. Ale’ ateyn a nɨn bê na, ‹Yì na tô’ ɨ̀ dyêyn ìkoynsɨ isuyn sɨ̂ ghelɨ, ka yì na sɨ kɨ nyamsɨ sɨ̂ mà.›»
verses.niv: If you had known what these words mean, ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.

verses.kom: Wâyn Wùl nɨ̀n ghɨ tèyn, kelɨ àdya’ sɨ ni nô mɨ ghà achi ɨtu’ ila’.»
verses.niv: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨn taŋi mèsi têyn ɨ lù ɨ ndù ɨ zɨ a ndô nchɨ̀yntɨ nɨ̀ àŋena,
verses.niv: Going on from that place, he went into their synagogue,

verses.kom: wùl ɨ̂ lvì ɨ ghɨ afu ma ɨkœ ɨ ŋweyn ɨ lvi kfɨ meyn. Ghelɨ nà sɨ kɨŋ dzɨ sɨ nà gham Jisòs, ɨ kæ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Isa’ i nɨn bɨmi na ghɨ kà’ a ghɨ chu’ wul achi ɨtu’ ila’ ma yi n-bɨmî wì a?»
verses.niv: and a man with a shriveled hand was there. Looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, they asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bèynsɨ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «A wùl sɨ̂ zɨ̀ ti n-kelɨ njɨ̀ ŋweyn, yì fe ibɨ achi ɨtu’ ila’, a wù faŋ tɨ̀ fvɨ̀sɨ sɨ afu a?
verses.niv: He said to them, “If any of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will you not take hold of it and lift it out?

verses.kom: A wùl ɨ̀ ti n-ko’nɨ̂ chwô wi njɨ̀ a? Yi ti n-dyêyn na Isa’ i nɨn bɨmî na ghɨ ni njùŋ achi ɨtu’ ila’.»
verses.niv: How much more valuable is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ taŋi tèyn ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ wùl nâ vzɨ̀ na, «Nàysɨ ɨkœ ɨ̀ va.» Wùl àteyn ɨ nàysɨ̀, nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, ɨkœ ateyn ɨ to kɨ to ɨ nà sɨ faytɨ̂ ghɨ kɨmɨ ta ɨlvi.
verses.niv: Then he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” So he stretched it out and it was completely restored, just as sound as the other.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ Falàsî ghì ɨ ni fvɨ̀ nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha ɨ nà sɨ ba’tɨ̂ sɨ zue Jisòs.
verses.niv: But the Pharisees went out and plotted how they might kill Jesus.

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨ̀n keli meyn ìwo zɨ̀ a ghelɨ Falàsî nà n-ba’tɨ kûm ŋweyn ɨ le’ ɨ lù sɨ afu. Ghelɨ ndù a ŋweyn ibàm, dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn. Wu chu’ ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ nà n-ko’i a àŋena antêynɨ̀ nô ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m,
verses.niv: Aware of this, Jesus withdrew from that place. Many followed him, and he healed all their sick,

verses.kom: ɨ tsɨ̀sɨ̀ sɨ̂ àŋena na ka wùl nɨ̂n fè’tɨ̀ ìwo kûm zɨ̀ sɨ̂ wùl.
verses.niv: warning them not to tell who he was.

verses.kom: Wu n-ni têyn sɨ luynsɨ izɨ̂ a Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ nɨn læ tum, nfè’tɨ̀ Ìsayà ɨ bè na:
verses.niv: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:

verses.kom: «Ɨwêyn nɨ̀n ghɨ wul vzɨ̀ a mà cho’ na wù na felɨ̀ sɨ̂ mà. Mɨ n-kôŋ ŋweyn, wu n-ni-à ma saŋlɨ-à. Mɨ n-fu Àyvɨs à kema sɨ̂ ŋweyn a wù na fê’tɨ̀ ìwo zɨ̀ a yi n-ghɨ àtì-ati sɨ̂ ghelɨ ɨtum.
verses.niv: “Here is my servant whom I have chosen, the one I love, in whom I delight; I will put my Spirit on him, and he will proclaim justice to the nations.

verses.kom: Wu læò gûmnɨ̀ wì iwo ŋêyn wùl ɨ̀ faŋ tɨ̀ byal sɨ̂ wùl; wùl læò yvɨ wi gyâ ŋweyn afàf.
verses.niv: He will not quarrel or cry out; no one will hear his voice in the streets.

verses.kom: Agâŋlɨ̀ à læò kolà wì alè’ ma à nì ŋweyn, wù læò nî wì iwo i bzɨ-i nô mɨ sɨ̂ wùl ɨ bol sɨ chem ta ka wù ni, a ghelɨ na chî àtì-ati.
verses.niv: A bruised reed he will not break, and a smoldering wick he will not snuff out, till he leads justice to victory.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ mbzɨ læò nà chî ye’tɨ̂ kɨ a ŋweyn ɨwùyn.»
verses.niv: In his name the nations will put their hope.”

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ghɨ li nɨ̀n læ meyn gvì nɨ̀ wùl sɨ̂ Jisòs, wu yeyn wi ɨlwê’, taŋî wì ma à nì àyvɨs a bɨ-a. Jisòs ɨ chu’ wul àteyn, wu kasi nà yeyn ɨ̀lwê’ fî taŋi-à.
verses.niv: Then they brought him a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute, and Jesus healed him, so that he could both talk and see.

verses.kom: Nô ghelɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m ta ghɨ nà n-ghɨ afu ɨ nà ghɨ nɨ̀ ìkayn i ɨ bɨf na, «A ti bè na ɨwêyn nɨ̀n ghɨ kɨ nô Wâyn Fòyn Devìt a?»
verses.niv: All the people were astonished and said, “Could this be the Son of David?”

verses.kom: Mɨtì ghelɨ Falàsî ɨ yvɨ iwo ateyn ɨ nà sɨ bê na, «Wù n-sâŋ fvɨsɨ̀ ɨ̀yvɨs nâ wèyn têyn kɨ bòm ta Belzibùl, ma à ti fòyn ɨ̀yvɨ̀s ɨ bɨ nɨn fu àdya’ sɨ̂ ŋweyn.»
verses.niv: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, “It is only by Beelzebub, the prince of demons, that this fellow drives out demons.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ keli ìkfâ’tɨ̀ i àŋena ɨ kæ bè na, «À n-ghɨ nô mɨ ghelɨ ila’ ì kà ɨ̀ nà kelɨ àngwòsɨ̀, a ila’ nâ zɨ̀-ì fe. À na fì ghɨ mɨ ghelɨ ntè’ ì kà kèsa ghelɨ isas i ndo, nà kelɨ ìbef a àŋena antêynɨ̀, a ntè’ nâ zɨ̀ kèsa isas i ndo nâ zɨ̀-ì fe.
verses.niv: Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be ruined, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.

verses.kom: Satàyn ti kæ sɨ nà sâŋ fvɨ̂sɨ̀ kɨmɨ Satàyn, a à na ghɨ ma wù sɨ nû ngêŋ ŋweyn. Satàyn ti kæ ni têyn, a yi na dyêyn na wù bu fì kelɨ wi adya’ atu ɨ̀fwo ghè a wù n-sa’.
verses.niv: If Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then can his kingdom stand?

verses.kom: Mà ti kæ sɨ nà ghɨ sâŋ fvɨ̂sɨ̀ ɨ̀yvɨs ɨ bɨ nɨ̀ àdya’ a, a fu Belzibùl, ghelɨ̀ ghi nà sâŋ fvɨ̂sɨ̀-à, a fu ndà adya’ ateyn a? A nì dyêyn kɨ ghelɨ̀ ghi nâ ghèyn na yi n-wam wam ma yi n-bê samo’ a.
verses.niv: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebub, by whom do your people drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.

verses.kom: À n-fu Àyvɨs a Fɨ̂yìnì fu àdya’ na mà na sâŋ fvɨ̂sɨ̀ ɨ̀yvɨs ɨ bɨ nâ wèyn. Yi ti n-dyêyn na ɨfoyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì ɨ gvi meyn sɨ̂ zɨ̀.
verses.niv: But if I drive out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.

verses.kom: «Yì fî kfà’tɨ̀ na wùl ɨ̀ ti kà’ ti a wù zɨ a ndo nɨ̀ wùl àdyà’ ɨ̀ ghal fsɨ ɨfwo ɨ ŋweyn, a bu na wù ghal meyn ɨ̀ kùl wul àdyà’ nâ vzɨ̀ sɨ asɨ a? Wù nì têyn, a wù kæ choŋ ndo ŋweyn nâ zɨ̀.
verses.niv: “Or again, how can anyone enter a strong man's house and carry off his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can rob his house.

verses.kom: «À ti n-ghɨ wi mɨ ndà ibam ì mò’ ghes ɨ̀ ŋweyn, a yi na dyèyn na wù nû mà. À na gâmtɨ̀ wì mɨ ndà ma sɨ nà chɨyntɨ ghelɨ Fɨ̂yìnì, a à na ghɨ wu sasɨ̀ sasɨ.
verses.niv: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who does not gather with me scatters.

verses.kom: Ma kæ sɨ nà sɨ bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na, Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ kà’ a fɨ lesɨ fu nô mɨ mbɨ ì kà ta wùl ɨ̀ nì, ɨ̀ fì lèsɨ̀ fù nô mɨ ndi ì kà ta ghɨ tè ŋweyn nɨ̀ nyeyn, mɨtì ma à tè mɨ ndà Ayvɨs a Ŋwa’nɨ-a, fɨ bu læò lèsɨ̀ fù ŋweyn.
verses.niv: And so I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.

verses.kom: À bè mɨ nda iwo i bzɨ-i kûm Wâyn Wùl, Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ kâ’ a fɨ lesɨ fù ŋweyn, mɨtì ma à bè mɨ ndà iwo i bzɨ-i kûm Àyvɨs a Ŋwa’nɨ-a, fɨ bu læò fì lèsɨ̀ fù ŋweyn nô mɨ achi a li-a.»
verses.niv: Anyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the age to come.

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨn fi meyn ye’i na, «Wà fàytɨ fɨkâ’ a fɨ na kolâ mɨ̀tam ɨ̀n jùŋ, wà ma’ì, a fɨ na kolâ mɨ̀tam ɨ̀m bɨ̂. Ghɨ n-yeyn kelî kɨ fɨ̀kâ’ bòm mɨ̀tam mzɨ̀ a fɨ n-kola.
verses.niv: “Make a tree good and its fruit will be good, or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad, for a tree is recognized by its fruit.

verses.kom: Mbamsɨ bɨ sèynsɨ̀, iwo i juŋì kà’ yi bu læò fvɨ̀ a yi ɨchfɨ̀ bòm ta yi n-ghɨ kɨ nô ghelɨ ghɨ bɨ. Gyà ɨ̀chfɨ̀ nɨ̀n ghɨ tèyn, bê kɨ ìwo zɨ̀ a yi sɨ ghɨ item, ma yi luyn meyn.
verses.niv: You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For out of the overflow of the heart the mouth speaks.

verses.kom: Wùl ɨ̀ jùŋ nɨ̀n nî njùŋ, a nà ghɨ ma yì fvɨ̀ kɨ̀ antêynɨ̀ àwo a juŋà ghê a wù bà’tɨ ɨ̀ lèm a ŋweyn item, wùl ɨ bɨ ɨ nî kɨ mbɨ zɨ̀ a yì sɨ ghɨ ma wù ba’tɨ meyn lèm a ŋweyn item.
verses.niv: The good man brings good things out of the good stored up in him, and the evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in him.

verses.kom: «Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na à læò nà ghɨ achi a nsa’ nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ a nô mɨ ndà na fê’tɨ̀ ɨ̀chfɨ̂ ɨ ŋweyn kûm nô mɨ ghà ta wù tìmi bè, kelɨ wi sɨ bè.
verses.niv: But I tell you that men will have to give account on the day of judgment for every careless word they have spoken.

verses.kom: Yì læò yɨ nsa’ kɨ̀ awo afî a yi n-bê ɨ̀ fe nsa’ kɨ̀ awo afî a yi n-bê.»
verses.niv: For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned.”

verses.kom: Ndyèynsɨ̀ sɨ isa’ sɨ lisɨ nɨ̀ ghelɨ Falàsî ghɨ li ɨ bè sɨ̂ Jisòs na, «Ndyèynsɨ̀, ni iwo i kaynɨ-i i li sɨ dyeyn sɨ̂ ghès sɨ a nchwæ na adya’ à kya lù kɨ̀ nô sɨ̂ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀.»
verses.niv: Then some of the Pharisees and teachers of the law said to him, “Teacher, we want to see a miraculous sign from you.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bèynsɨ̀ ɨ bè na, «À n-ghɨ kɨ àjâŋ a bɨ-a têyn ta akeynà a kɨ n-fâyn wi Fɨ̀yìnì a kɨ kà’ a kɨ na bɨf nchwæ. Kɨ n-yeyn wi nchwæ ì lì, a bu kɨ ɨyî nfè’tɨ̀ Jonà.
verses.niv: He answered, “A wicked and adulterous generation asks for a miraculous sign! But none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.

verses.kom: Jonà nɨn chi meyn ɨlvà nɨ̀ sfɨ̀ i gha’nɨ sɨ a mɨchi ɨ̀n tal, Wâyn Wùl ɨ ghɨ sɨ nì sɨ kfɨ sɨ chi kɨmɨ mɨ̀chi ɨ̀n tal antêynɨ̀ nse sɨ jæ sɨ làlì.
verses.niv: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of a huge fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

verses.kom: À læò nà ghɨ achi a nsa’, a ghelɨ timi asɨ nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀, a ghelɨ Ninivè na ghâm àjâŋ kèynà bòm ta àŋena nɨn læ meyn yvɨ iye’i i Jonà ɨ bèynsɨ̀ mɨ̀tem mɨ̀ àŋena sɨ a mbɨsɨ, ajâŋ kèynà ɨ na sɨ kelɨ wul lvɨ̂yn, wu chwô Jonà mɨtì bêynsɨ̀ wì mɨtem sɨ a mbɨsɨ.
verses.niv: The men of Nineveh will stand up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now one greater than Jonah is here.

verses.kom: À læò nà ghɨ achi a nsa’ nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀, a nàfòyn, ma à ti wul ɨ vzɨ̀ a wù n-sa’ ila’ ighaŋ i mbzɨ, abàs a fɨ̂chèmi, timi nà ghâm àjâŋ nâ kèynà bòm ta wu n-læ lù ila’ nɨ̀ ŋweyn ɨ jèl ndyèyn ì dyà ɨ gvì sɨ yvɨtɨ iye’i itof nɨ̀ fòyn Sòlomùyn. Mɨtì, ajâŋ kèynà ɨ na sɨ kelɨ wul lvɨ̂yn, wu chwô Sòlomùyn, yvɨtɨ̂ wì iye’i i ŋweyn.
verses.niv: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to listen to Solomon's wisdom, and now one greater than Solomon is here.

verses.kom: «À n-nî a nà ghɨ ɨlvɨ ta ayvɨs a bɨ-a fvɨ̀ sɨ a wùl ɨwùyn, kɨ ndù ɨ jèl ɨ kal kɨ nse iyum ì jɨ̀m, kɨŋ àlê’ sɨ yvɨ̀tɨ̀, ɨ̀ kæ faŋ tɨ̀ yeyn,
verses.niv: “When an evil spirit comes out of a man, it goes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it.

verses.kom: kɨ be kɨ sɨ̂ ànkeyna a ngeŋ na, ‹Mɨ n-kasî ndû kɨ a ndo ghè a mà tî fvɨ̀ ateyn.› Kɨ ti n-bê tì ɨ̀ kàsî ndù ɨ̀ yeyn ndo àteyn yi ghɨ iyum ma ghɨ fi meyn fàytɨ ɨ̀ yès ɨ̀ bà’tɨ ɨ̀fwo sɨ antêynɨ̀ àteyn,
verses.niv: Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’ When it arrives, it finds the house unoccupied, swept clean and put in order.

verses.kom: kɨ kasî ndù ɨ li gvì nɨ̀ ɨ̀yvɨs ɨ bɨ ɨ lvi, nsòmbo, wu bem chwô ànkeyna, wu chɨ̀yntɨ̀ ɨ zɨ ɨ̀ nà sɨ chî ɨwùyn nɨ̀ wùl nâ vzɨ̀. Yi n-gâyn tèyn, wùl àteyn nà bem chwô ta wù tî nà ghɨ sɨ asɨ. À ti têyn ta yi læò gâyn sɨ̂ ghelɨ ajàŋ ghèyn.»
verses.niv: Then it goes and takes with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and live there. And the final condition of that man is worse than the first. That is how it will be with this wicked generation.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ nà bu taŋî kɨ taŋi sɨ̂ ànôyn kì a kɨ nà n-jêl a ŋweyn ibàm, nà ŋweyn nɨ̀ woyn-nà ŋweyn ɨ gvì ɨ timi abe ɨ nà kɨŋ sɨ taŋi sɨ̂ ŋweyn.
verses.niv: While Jesus was still talking to the crowd, his mother and brothers stood outside, wanting to speak to him.

verses.kom: Wùl ɨ̀ lvì antêynɨ̀ ànòyn nâ ghè ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Nà vâ ŋêyn woyn-nà ghya nɨn ti abe kɨŋ sɨ taŋi sɨ̂ và.»
verses.niv: Someone told him, “Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak to you.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Nà wom nɨn ghɨ ndà, woyn-nà ghem ghɨ ghɨ̀ ndà?»
verses.niv: He replied to him, “Who is my mother, and who are my brothers?”

verses.kom: Wu n-bɨf tî ɨ kasi sò’ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweyn ɨ bè na, «Nà wom nɨ̀ woyn-nà ghem nɨn ghɨ ghelɨ ghèyn.
verses.niv: Pointing to his disciples, he said, “Here are my mother and my brothers.

verses.kom: À n-nî nô mɨ ndà iwo zɨ̀ a Bò wom iyvɨ nɨn kɨŋ a wù na ghɨ wayn-nà wom, ghɨ jêmtɨ̀ yem, ghɨ nà wom.»
verses.niv: For whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother.”

verses.kom: A nà n-ghɨ kɨmɨ achi nâ ghè, Jisòs ɨ fvɨ̀ sɨ a ndo ɨ ndu dù’ì a mbæò ɨ̀lùe sɨ ye’i ghelɨ.
verses.niv: That same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the lake.

verses.kom: Anôyn a ghêl à ɨ gvì, dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn, wu yeyn tî ɨ zɨ dù’ì a ngù’, ghelɨ timi sɨ a mbæò jvà.
verses.niv: Such large crowds gathered around him that he got into a boat and sat in it, while all the people stood on the shore.

verses.kom: Wu fè’tɨ̀ àwo sɨ̂ àŋena, kɨ dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn kɨ̀ a ngàynsɨ̀. Wu n-be meyn na, «Wùl ɨ̀ lvì nɨ̂n læ meyn se’ sɨ mà’ ɨ ngœò ŋweyn,
verses.niv: Then he told them many things in parables, saying: “A farmer went out to sow his seed.

verses.kom: ɨ se sɨ mà’, ìlì ɨ chemlɨ kɨ avɨ̀ a dzɨ ta yi nà n-chwô a gvêyn, mɨ̀nyûyn ɨ gvì ɨ chubtɨ ɨ kfɨl nô ì jɨ̀m.
verses.niv: As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.

verses.kom: Asɨ a li-a ɨ chemlɨ alè’ a nse ngò’sɨ̀, nse ɨ dvɨ̂ wì afu ɨ nyàŋsɨ̀ ɨ fvɨ̀ kɨ têyn bòm ta nse nà n-wutɨ tî.
verses.niv: Some fell on rocky places, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly, because the soil was shallow.

verses.kom: Chùe ɨ bayn nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, ɨ nyò’ njoŋsɨ ateyn, sɨ yum bòm ta aghaŋ a nà n-bu du’ tɨ̀ nà ghɨ.
verses.niv: But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.

verses.kom: Asɨ a li-a ɨ chemlɨ kɨmɨ alè’, sùnjoŋnjoŋsɨ nî sɨ nà ko’ ateyn, sùnjoŋnjoŋsɨ ateyn sɨ ɨ fvɨ̀ ɨ tàysɨ̀ àsaŋ ateyn.
verses.niv: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the plants.

verses.kom: Asɨ a li-a ɨ chemlɨ kɨ nô a nse ì jùŋ, asaŋ ateyn a ɨ ko’ ɨ bùs ɨ bi. Ghɨ nà sɨ-a, ɨ̀ leŋ, asɨ asaŋ a nà fvɨ̂ atu ìsàŋ i li ɨvɨ, fvɨ̂ ateyn nɨ ili, mɨ̀vɨm ntufa, fvɨ̂ ateyn nɨ ili, mɨ̀vɨm ɨ̀n tal.»
verses.niv: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it produced a crop –a hundred, sixty or thirty times what was sown.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ mò ngàyn nâ yèyn tèyn ɨ kæ bè na, «À na tof mɨ ndà, wu nà tô’ yvɨtɨ-à.»
verses.niv: He who has ears, let him hear.”

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ Jisòs-sɨ̀ ɨ kɨŋtɨ ndù ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn nâ, wù n-taŋî sɨ̂ ghelɨ a ngàynsɨ̀ bòm ghà a.
verses.niv: The disciples came to him and asked, “Why do you speak to the people in parables?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ fu meyn ìtof sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na yì na yvɨ kelî àwo a leytɨnɨ-a kì a kɨ n-ghɨ kûm ɨ̀foyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì, mɨtì ɨ̀ faŋ tɨ̀ fu sɨ̂ àŋena.
verses.niv: He replied, “The knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.

verses.kom: Yi ti n-dyêyn na à sɨ kelɨ mɨ ndà, a ghɨ fu kfèynsɨ sɨ̂ ŋweyn, a wù na tô’ kelɨ-a; à na wo nô mɨ ndà, a ghɨ fsɨ nô mɨ atelâ kì a wù n-kelɨ.
verses.niv: Whoever has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken from him.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-taŋî sɨ̂ àŋena a ngàynsɨ̀ têyn ta ka àŋena na ki ɨ̀lwê’ mɨtì yeyn wi afo, yvɨ mɨ yvɨ awo mɨtì kelî wì na ghɨ n-bê na gha a.
verses.niv: This is why I speak to them in parables:  “Though seeing, they do not see; though hearing, they do not hear or understand.

verses.kom: Ntûm Fɨ̀yìnì zɨ̀ a nfè’tɨ̀ Ìsayà nɨn læ fè’tɨ kfeyn meyn sɨ̂ àŋena. Fɨ n-læ bè na: ‹Yì læò nà yvɨtɨ̂ kɨ nô yvɨtɨ awo, mɨtì kelî wì iwo zɨ̀ a ghɨ n-bê, ki mɨ ki ɨlwê’ mɨtì yeyn kelî wì afo.
verses.niv: In them is fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah: “ ‘You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ghèyn ɨ chɨli meyn, nà yvɨ wi awo, kôŋ wì sɨ nà yeyn ɨlwê’, bu tì, a àŋena se sɨ yeyn ɨlwê’ sɨ fì sɨ yvɨ sɨ keli awo, ɨ̀ kàsi gvì sɨ̂ mà, a mà chu’ àŋena.›»
verses.niv: For this people's heart has become calloused; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts and turn, and I would heal them.’

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ taŋi tì ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ na, «Njùŋ nɨn ghɨ sɨ̂ zɨ̀ bòm ta yi n-kelɨ asɨ sɨ nà yeyn ɨlwê’ fî kelɨ ɨ̀tuŋlɨ sɨ nà yvɨ keli awo kì a ghɨ n-bê.
verses.niv: But blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na nfè’tɨ̀ sɨ gha’nɨ sɨ dvɨnɨsɨ nɨ̀ ghelɨ àtì-ati ghɨ dvɨnɨ nɨn læ meyn nà kôŋ sɨ nà yeyn awo kì a yi n-yeyn, fî kôŋ sɨ yvɨ awo kì a yi n-yvɨ, mɨtì yi faŋ tɨ̀ gàyn.»
verses.niv: For I tell you the truth, many prophets and righteous men longed to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ fi bè na, «Yì yvɨtɨ læ̂ ìwo zɨ̀ a ngàyn bò gvèyn zɨ̀ nɨ̀n ye’i.
verses.niv: “Listen then to what the parable of the sower means:

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-yvɨ ntum kûm ɨ̀foyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì kelî wì nɨn ghɨ tèyn ta asɨ a ngœò kì a kɨ n-chèmlɨ avɨ̀ a dzɨ tî. Àŋena nɨn yvɨ-a, dêblɨ̀ ɨ gvì ɨ sa’ ɨ lù nɨ̀ ìnyeyni sɨ àŋena mɨ̂tèm.
verses.niv: When anyone hears the message about the kingdom and does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is the seed sown along the path.

verses.kom: Wùl vzɨ̀ a wù n-yvɨ iwo i Fɨ̂yìnì, wu nyàŋsɨ̀ ɨ bɨmi kɨ bɨmi nɨ̀ ìsaŋlɨ i nɨn ghɨ tèyn ta ngœò zɨ̀ a yi n-chemlɨ a nse ngò’sɨ̀ tî.
verses.niv: The one who received the seed that fell on rocky places is the man who hears the word and at once receives it with joy.

verses.kom: Wùl ɨ̀ nâ wèyn nɨ̀n yvɨ ìwo i Fɨ̂yìnì, yi bû kèli àghaŋ, wu bɨmi kɨ sɨ a fɨ̂lè’nɨ̀ fɨ ɨlvɨ têyn. À nî a nà ghɨ ta nge’ gvì meyn kèsa ghɨ n-cho’ àvɨ a ŋweyn bòm ìwo i Fɨ̂yìnì nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, wu nyàŋsɨ̀ ɨ fe kɨ fe.
verses.niv: But since he has no root, he lasts only a short time. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, he quickly falls away.

verses.kom: Ngœò ì lì zɨ̂ a yi n-chèmlɨ antêynɨ̀ sùnjoŋnjoŋsɨ tî nɨ̀n ghɨ tèyn ta wul ɨ vzɨ̀ a wù n-yvɨ iwo i Fɨ̂yìnì, afɨm a mbzɨ a nɨ̀ ìkôŋ zɨ̀ a wù n-kôŋ igha’ ɨ tàysɨ̀ ìwo ateyn, yi faŋ tɨ̀ kòla mɨtam a ŋweyn a nchînɨ̀.
verses.niv: The one who received the seed that fell among the thorns is the man who hears the word, but the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke it, making it unfruitful.

verses.kom: Mɨtì ngœò ì lì zɨ̂ a yi n-chèmlɨ a nse ì jùŋ ɨ ghɨ tèyn ta wul ɨ vzɨ̀ a wù n-yvɨ iwo i Fɨ̂yìnì, kelî kɨ keli iwo zɨ̀ a yi n-bê. Yi n-nî yi nà kolâ mɨ̀tam a ŋweyn a nchînɨ̀ mɨ dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn kɨ̀mɨ ta ngœò nâ zɨ̀ a ghɨ n-ntò’ a nse ì jùŋ, yi lema, asɨ asaŋ a nà fvɨ̂ atu àsàŋ a li-a ɨvɨ, fvɨ̂ atu àteyn nɨ̀ ali-a, mɨ̀vɨm ntufa, fvɨ̂ ateyn nɨ̀ ali-a, mɨ̀vɨm ɨ̀n tal.»
verses.niv: But the one who received the seed that fell on good soil is the man who hears the word and understands it. He produces a crop, yielding a hundred, sixty or thirty times what was sown.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ mò ngàyn î lì sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Ɨfôyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì nɨn ghɨ kɨmɨ a dzɨ ghâyn tèyn. Wùl nɨ̀n læ meyn mà’ ngœò ŋweyn a gvêyn,
verses.niv: Jesus told them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.

verses.kom: ɨtu’ ɨ læ jɨ achi a li-a, ghelɨ se sɨ buni kɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m, mbàynɨ̀ ŋweyn ì lì ɨ nya’ ndù ɨ tò’ àfû’ a bɨ-a antêynɨ̀ ngœò nâ ghè,
verses.niv: But while everyone was sleeping, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and went away.

verses.kom: Asaŋ ateyn a ɨ fvɨ̀ ɨ læ bùs nô mɨ ɨtu’ ɨ gha, afû’ a bɨ-a nâ kì ɨ boŋ ko’.
verses.niv: When the wheat sprouted and formed heads, then the weeds also appeared.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ nɨ̀ bò gvèyn nâ wèyn ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, ‹Bòbè, ba wà tî mà’ kɨ̀ nô ngœò àsàŋ î jùŋ a wa gvêyn, ìnkì afù’ yèynì ateyn ti sɨ ghɨ ma yi lù wo?›
verses.niv: “The owner's servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didn't you sow good seed in your field? Where then did the weeds come from?’

verses.kom: Wùl àteyn ɨ bè na, ‹Iwo nâ yèynì nì kɨ wul ɨ̀ lvì ta wù n-bâyn ma.› Ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ nâ ghì ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, ‹Ghèsɨ̀ ndu sùlɨ àfû’ ateyn a?›
verses.niv: “ ‘An enemy did this,’ he replied. “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and pull them up?’

verses.kom: Wùl àteyn ɨ be kɨ sɨ̂ àŋena na, ‹Ngaŋ, yì kà’ a yì ndu sè sɨ sulɨ, nà cho’tɨ̂ ba’sɨ̂ nɨ̀ àsaŋ a.
verses.niv: “ ‘No,’ he answered, ‘because while you are pulling the weeds, you may root up the wheat with them.

verses.kom: Yì visi asaŋ ateyn a na lemâ kɨ antêynɨ̀ àfù’ sɨ chem achi ghè a ka ghɨ se’ ɨ̀ kfì. À læò nà ghɨ achi nâ ghè, a mà be sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghɨ kfinɨ na ghɨ cho’ afû’ ateyn sɨ asɨ ɨ̀ kul a gyâsɨ̀ ta ka ghɨ nyo’ ɨ̀ kæ kfi asaŋ ateyn sɨ kfa sɨ lèm a ma ikàŋ.›»
verses.niv: Let both grow together until the harvest. At that time I will tell the harvesters: First collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to be burned; then gather the wheat and bring it into my barn.’ ”

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨ̀n fi meyn mò ngàyn ì lì sɨ̂ àŋena ɨ bè na, «Ɨfôyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì nɨn ghɨ kɨmɨ tèyn ta fɨsɨ̂lɨ̀ fɨ ngœò fɨ̀kà’ fɨ lifɨ a ghɨ n-toŋtɨ na mostà tèyn, wùl ɨ̀ nî wu mà’ fɨ̀kâ’ nâ fèynfɨ̀ a ŋweyn a gvêyn, fɨ nà lemâ.
verses.niv: He told them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed, which a man took and planted in his field.

verses.kom: A nî a nà ghɨ ɨlvɨ nâ ghè, fɨsɨ̂lɨ̀ fɨ fɨ̂kà’ nâ fèynfɨ̀ ɨ læ̂ chwô nô mɨ ìsɨ i gha ɨlwam, mɨtì fɨ lema, fɨkâ’ fɨ ateyn fɨ nà gha’ chwô nô mɨ ghà ɨlwam nâ ghè. Mɨ̀nyûyn ɨ nà sɨ gvî bâ’lɨ̀ ndosɨ ɨ̀mêyn a tɨ̂fyàs tɨ ateyn.»
verses.niv: Though it is the smallest of all your seeds, yet when it grows, it is the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and perch in its branches.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ fi mò ngàyn ì lì sɨ̂ àŋena ɨ bè na, «Ɨfôyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì nɨn ghɨ kɨmɨ tèyn ta fɨ̀shɨ̀k ta wùl ɨ wi nɨn nî wu lì, ɨ fyes a mɨkàl, mɨ dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn, fɨ jèlɨ kɨ mɨkal mɨ̀ àteyn ɨ̀n jɨ̀m.»
verses.niv: He told them still another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like yeast that a woman took and mixed into a large amount of flour until it worked all through the dough.”

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨ̀n læ ye’i awo nâ kèynà sɨ̂ ghelɨ nô à jɨ̀m kɨ a ngàynsɨ̀, wù n-bu læ fè’tɨ iwo sɨ̂ àŋena nô ì mò’ bùla wù mô sɨ a ngàyn.
verses.niv: Jesus spoke all these things to the crowd in parables; he did not say anything to them without using a parable.

verses.kom: Wu nà n-nî tèyn sɨ luynsɨ awo kì a Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ nɨn læ bè toynɨ a nfè’tɨ i gha’nɨ. Fɨ n-læ bè na: «Mà læò nà taŋî sɨ̂ àŋena a ngàynsɨ̀. Mà læò fê’tɨ̀ àwo sɨ̂ àŋena bùla wùl ɨ̀ timi nà kya nô sɨ ɨtu’ ta ghɨ n-fàytɨ mbzɨ.»
verses.niv: So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophet: “I will open my mouth in parables, I will utter things hidden since the creation of the world.”

verses.kom: A nà n-ghɨ ta Jisòs ŋêyn njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ vìsi meyn ànôyn kì ɨ̀ kàsi zɨ sɨ a ndo, sɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na wù fe’tɨ iwo zɨ̀ a ngàyn àfù’ a bɨ-a zɨ̀ nì nà ye’i-à.
verses.niv: Then he left the crowd and went into the house. His disciples came to him and said, “Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Wùl vzɨ̀ a wu n-to’ ngœò ì jùŋ tì nɨ̀n ghɨ Wâyn Wùl.
verses.niv: He answered, “The one who sowed the good seed is the Son of Man.

verses.kom: Gvèyn àteyn ɨ ghɨ mbzɨ, ngœò ì jùŋ zɨ̀ ɨ ghɨ ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-ghɨ isas isa’ nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀, afû’ a bɨ-a kì ɨ ghɨ ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-ghɨ isas isa’ nɨ̀ dêblɨ̀.
verses.niv: The field is the world, and the good seed stands for the sons of the kingdom. The weeds are the sons of the evil one,

verses.kom: Mbàynɨ̀ zɨ̀ a yi n-tò’ afû’ a bɨ-a kì ɨ ghɨ dêblɨ̀, ɨlvɨ ɨ kfinɨ ɨ ghɨ ngò’sɨ̂ mbzɨ, ghelɨ ghɨ kfinɨ ɨ ghɨ nchìsɨ Fɨ̂yìnì.
verses.niv: and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.

verses.kom: Ghɨ ti læò yvɨ̂ŋtɨ̀ ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-ghɨ isas isa’ nɨ̀ dêblɨ̀ a ngò’sɨ̂ mbzɨ ɨ̀ nyò’ kɨ̀mɨ ighel ta ghɨ n-nî ghɨ yvɨ̀ŋtɨ̀ àfû’ a bɨ-a a gvêyn, ghɨ nyò’.
verses.niv: “As the weeds are pulled up and burned in the fire, so it will be at the end of the age.

verses.kom: Wâyn Wùl ɨ̀ læò tum nchìsɨ ŋweyn, a sɨ fvɨ gvì ɨ̀ chɨ̀yntɨ̀ fvɨ̀sɨ̀ nô mɨ ghà vzɨ̂ a kɨ nî na ghelɨ na nî mbɨ nɨ̀ ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-nî mbɨ sɨ alè’ ɨfòyn nɨ̀ ŋweyn.
verses.niv: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will weed out of his kingdom everything that causes sin and all who do evil.

verses.kom: Sɨ ibàm ateyn ɨ̀ mà’ àŋena alè’ ɨvɨ̀s, a àŋena na luŋlɨ̂ dzɨ-à.
verses.niv: They will throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ àtì-ati læò nà bayn ɨtu’ nâ ghè kɨ ta ɨchfɨ̂-iyvɨ alè’ ɨfòyn nɨ̀ Bò àŋena. À na tof nô mɨ ndà, wu nà tô’ yvɨtɨ-à.»
verses.niv: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears, let him hear.

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨn læ bè na, «Ɨfôyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì nɨn ghɨ kɨmɨ tèyn ta igha’ i li a wùl ɨ̀ ndù kòli a gvêyn ta ghɨ lèsɨ̀ ɨ̀ fì tò’ lèytɨ̀, ɨ̀ kàsi ɨ̀ kfa, iwo ateyn i na fom a ŋweyn ɨwùyn nô a jûŋ, wù ndû ɨ̀ bèy’lɨ nô mɨ ghà ta wù n-kelɨ ɨ̀ se’ ɨ̀ yuyn gveyn nâ zɨ̀.
verses.niv: “The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and then in his joy went and sold all he had and bought that field.

verses.kom: «Ɨfôyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì nɨn ghɨ kɨmɨ ta wul ɨ bey’lɨnɨ, wu jêl kɨŋ ìnki tɨfwo tɨ litɨ, tɨ jôf nô a jûŋ,
verses.niv: “Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant looking for fine pearls.

verses.kom: ɨ̀ kæ læò yeyn isɨ i li, yi ko’nɨ̂ nô a jûŋ, a wù kasi ɨ̀ kfa ɨ̀ bèy’lɨ nô mɨ ghà ta wù n-kelɨ, ɨ̀ ndù ɨ̀ yuyn.
verses.niv: When he found one of great value, he went away and sold everything he had and bought it.

verses.kom: «Ɨfôyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì nɨn fî ghɨ kɨmɨ ta fɨ̀làm ɨlvɨ ta wùl ɨ̀ mà’ a jvâ ɨ̀ ku tɨ̀nkì tɨ sfɨsɨ ateyn kɨ tɨ̀ jɨ̀m,
verses.niv: “Once again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was let down into the lake and caught all kinds of fish.

verses.kom: fɨ luyn, ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-ku sfɨsɨ guf fvɨ̀sɨ̀ a mbæò jvà ɨ̀ tètɨ sfɨsɨ jûŋsɨ̀ ɨ̀ we a nkwòsɨ̀ ɨ̀ mà’ì sɨ bɨsɨ.
verses.niv: When it was full, the fishermen pulled it up on the shore. Then they sat down and collected the good fish in baskets, but threw the bad away.

verses.kom: Yi læò nà ghɨ kɨmɨ tèyn a ngò’sɨ̂ mbzɨ. Nchìsɨ Fɨ̂yìnìsɨ̀ læò gvi-à ɨ̀ tètɨ fvɨ̀sɨ̀ ghelɨ ghɨ bɨ sɨ antêynɨ̀ nɨ̀ ghelɨ àtì-ati,
verses.niv: This is how it will be at the end of the age. The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous

verses.kom: ɨ̀ mà’ zɨ̀sɨ àŋena alè’ ɨvɨ̀s, a àŋena na luŋlɨ̂ dzɨ̂ afu.»
verses.niv: and throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨ̂n tàŋi têyn ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ nâ, àŋena nɨn yvɨ kelî àwo nâ kèynà a? Ghɨ bɨmi.
verses.niv: “Have you understood all these things?” Jesus asked. “Yes,” they replied.

verses.kom: Wu kæ be sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Ndyèynsɨ̀ sɨ isa’ sìsɨ̀ a sɨ yè’i meyn ìwo zɨ̀ a ɨfoyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì nɨn ghɨ ìnyeyni nɨn ghɨ kɨmɨ tèyn ta bò ndo vzɨ̀ a wù n-nî wu nà fvɨsɨ̀ ìgha’ i fɨ-i nɨ̀ ìgha’ i mu-i kɨ̀ alè’ ghè a wù n-lêm ɨfwo ɨ ŋweyn ateyn.»
verses.niv: He said to them, “Therefore every teacher of the law who has been instructed about the kingdom of heaven is like the owner of a house who brings out of his storeroom new treasures as well as old.”

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨn læ mo mèsi ngàyn nâ sèynsɨ̀ têyn ɨ lù sɨ afu
verses.niv: When Jesus had finished these parables, he moved on from there.

verses.kom: ɨ kasi kfa sɨ a ntè’ ghê a wu n-læ lema ko’ ateyn ɨ nà yisî ye’î ghelɨ a ndosɨ nchɨ̀yntɨ nɨ̀ àŋena, àŋena ghɨ nɨ̀ ìkayn i, bɨf na, «Wùl ɨ̀ wèyn lì wo ìnkì itof yèynì nɨ̀ àdya’ a kaynɨ-a kèynà a?
verses.niv: Coming to his hometown, he began teaching the people in their synagogue, and they were amazed. “Where did this man get this wisdom and these miraculous powers?” they asked.

verses.kom: Ba à n-ghɨ kɨ nô wâyn wùl ɨ̀ wèyn a wù n-kom ɨfwo tèyn? Ba izɨyn i nà ŋweyni nɨn ghɨ Mèli, woyn-nà ŋweyn ɨ ghɨ Jêm, nɨ̀ Josèf nɨ̀ Saymùn nɨ̀ Judàs?
verses.niv: “Isn't this the carpenter's son? Isn't his mother's name Mary, and aren't his brothers James, Joseph, Simon and Judas?

verses.kom: Ba jêmtɨ̀sɨ ŋweynsɨ nɨn chî kɨ nô a ntè’ afêyn? Wù ti lì wo itof nɨ̀ àdya’ a sɨ nà nî awo nâ kèynà a?»
verses.niv: Aren't all his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all these things?”

verses.kom: Àŋena taŋi tì ɨ zɨ̀tɨ kɨ sɨ bayn ɨ ŋweyn. Jisòs ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Ghɨ lum ngvɨmlɨ̂ nfè’tɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì nô mɨ wo a bu kɨ alè’ ghè a wù fvɨ̀ ateyn nɨ̀ ìsas i ndo nɨ̀ àŋena-i.»
verses.niv: And they took offense at him. But Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown and in his own house is a prophet without honor.”

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨn bu læ ni awo a kaynɨ-a sɨ idvɨ̀ a Nazalèt bòm ta ghelɨ afu nà n-le’ sɨ bɨmi.
verses.niv: And he did not do many miracles there because of their lack of faith.

verses.kom: A nà n-ghɨ ɨtu’ nâ ghè, Helòd ta wu nà n-sa’ abâs a Galìlî a li-a ɨ yvɨ sa’gha kûm Jisòs,
verses.niv: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus,

verses.kom: ɨ bè sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ nɨ̀ ŋweyn na, «À n-ghɨ tì a ghɨ kɨ nô Joyn Nfû Mù ta wù kàsi làlì sɨ ikfɨ. À ti iwo zɨ̀ a wù n-kelɨ adya’ sɨ nà ni awo nâ kèynà têyn.»
verses.niv: and he said to his attendants, “This is John the Baptist; he has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”

verses.kom: A nà n-ghɨ tì ma à n-læ be kɨ nô ŋweyn sɨ a ŋweyn a ngeŋ na ghɨ ghal Joyn Nfû Mù ɨ̀ kùl ŋweyn ɨ̀ mà’ a ncha’, nî tì ta nô ŋweyn Helòd ghal ɨ fsɨ Hèlodìyàs, ɨ wî wayn-nà ŋweyn, Filîb, Joyn na sɨ yolà.
verses.niv: Now Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife,

verses.kom: Nge’ àteyn nà n-ghɨ na, Helòd nɨn læ meyn mala Hèlodìyàs tì, Joyn faŋ ɨ nà sɨ kûmtɨ̀ kɨ kumtɨ sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Wà ni meyn ìwo, isa’ i bɨmî wì ta wà màla wul ɨ wi wèyn.»
verses.niv: for John had been saying to him: “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

verses.kom: Helòd ɨ nà kɨŋ sɨ zue Joyn mɨtì ɨ fi fayn kɨ ghelɨ bòm ta àŋena nà n-lî Joyn sɨ a nfè’tɨ i gha’nɨ nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀.
verses.niv: Herod wanted to kill John, but he was afraid of the people, because they considered him a prophet.

verses.kom: A læ nà ghɨ ta ghɨ n-yɨ achi kì a ghɨ n-bzɨ Helòd ateyn, wayn wi nɨ̀ Hèlodìyàs ɨ gvì ɨ nà sɨ bɨyn asɨ nɨ̀ àŋena, iwo ateyn i nà fom sɨ̂ Helòd nô sɨ a ŋaŋ.
verses.niv: On Herod's birthday the daughter of Herodias danced for them and pleased Herod so much

verses.kom: Wu kæ chfɨ̀nɨ wayn wi nâ vzɨ̀ ɨ bè na, «Mɨ n-bê samo’ na mɨ n-fu nô mɨ ghà vzɨ̂ a wà n-kôŋ na mà fu sɨ̂ và.»
verses.niv: that he promised with an oath to give her whatever she asked.

verses.kom: Nà ŋweyn ɨ nya’ ɨ nyù’ ŋweyn ɨ bè na wù be kɨ̀ na yi n-kɨŋ na ghɨ fu atu a Joyn Nfû Mù sɨ̂ zɨ̀ a kel i lelinɨ, kɨ̀ ɨlvɨ nâ ghè.
verses.niv: Prompted by her mother, she said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.”

verses.kom: Fòyn Helòd ɨ nà kumî ɨ̀wuyn nô sɨ a ŋaŋ, mɨtì ɨ bè na ghɨ teyn gvì nɨ̀ àtu a Joyn a ɨ̀ fù sɨ̂ wayn wi àteyn. Wu n-ni têyn kɨ bòm ta wu nà n-sɨ ghɨ ma wù ni meyn bè ìwo ateyn sɨ ikàyntɨ̀ asɨ nɨ̀ ghelɨ ghɨ gvinɨ nɨ̀ ŋweyn.
verses.niv: The king was distressed, but because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he ordered that her request be granted

verses.kom: Ghɨ ndù a ndô ncha’ ɨ teyn atu a Joyn,
verses.niv: and had John beheaded in the prison.

verses.kom: ɨ kasi gvì nɨ̀ ànkeyna a kel i lelinɨ ɨ fu sɨ̂ wayn wi nâ vzɨ̀, wu ndu fu sɨ̂ nà ŋweyn.
verses.niv: His head was brought in on a platter and given to the girl, who carried it to her mother.

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ Joynsɨ ndù ɨ lì ìgvɨyn i ŋweyn ɨ gvɨ̀mì ɨ kæ ndù sɨ fè’tɨ iwo ateyn sɨ̂ Jisòs.
verses.niv: John's disciples came and took his body and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ yvɨ iwo zɨ̀ a ghɨ nì sɨ̂ Joyn Nfû Mù ɨ lì ngù’, ŋêyn njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ lù ɨ nà ndû alè’, wùl ɨ ghɨ wi afu. Ghelɨ ghì ɨ yvɨ na wù lu meyn tì ɨ fvɨ̀ ntè’sɨ àŋena nô sɨ idvɨ̀ ɨ jèlɨ ndù a ŋweyn ibàm, kɨ nɨ̀ ɨ̀vɨ.
verses.niv: When Jesus heard what had happened, he withdrew by boat privately to a solitary place. Hearing of this, the crowds followed him on foot from the towns.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ ndù ɨ nà chem gvî kɨ tèyn ɨ fi yeyn kɨ anôyn a ghêl kì, isuyn i ɨ nà sɨ kolâ ŋweyn sɨ̂ àŋena. Wu chu’ ɨghî a ghɨ nà n-ko’i a àŋena antêynɨ̀.
verses.niv: When Jesus landed and saw a large crowd, he had compassion on them and healed their sick.

verses.kom: A ni nà ghɨ aleŋ ɨlvɨ ikfa, njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ gvì ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Ɨlvɨ chwo meyn, alê’ kèynà ɨ fî ghɨ nɨ̀ ìbam i. Yi n-jôf na wà be ghelɨ ghèyn kasi ɨ̀ zɨ ɨ̀ ndù a ntè’sɨ ɨ̀ yuyn ɨfwo ɨ yɨnɨ afu ɨ̀ yɨ.»
verses.niv: As evening approached, the disciples came to him and said, “This is a remote place, and it's already getting late. Send the crowds away, so they can go to the villages and buy themselves some food.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè na, «Àŋena nɨn kelɨ wi kɨ sɨ kfa, nô zɨ̀ fu afo, àŋena yɨ.»
verses.niv: Jesus replied, “They do not need to go away. You give them something to eat.”

verses.kom: Àŋena bè na, «Ghès nɨn kelɨ kɨ tɨ̀ghef tɨ abayn afêyn, tɨ̀ tâyn nɨ̀ sfɨ sɨ̀ bò sɨ.»
verses.niv: “We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè na àŋena fu sɨ̂ zɨ̀,
verses.niv: “Bring them here to me,” he said.

verses.kom: ɨ fi kæ be sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghì na àŋena du’i ndù ɨnfù’. Sɨ ibàm ateyn, wu fsɨ tɨghef tɨ abayn nâ tìtɨ̀ tɨ̀ tâyn nɨ̀ sfɨ sìsɨ̀ sɨ̀ bò ɨ ki ko’sɨ nɨ̀ ìyvɨ-i ɨ fu àyòŋnɨ̀ sɨ̂ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ ɨ be’lɨ àbayn ateyn ɨ chɨ̀yntɨ̀ ɨ fu ɨfwo ateyn na njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ gwotɨ sɨ̂ ghelɨ.
verses.niv: And he directed the people to sit down on the grass. Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke the loaves. Then he gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.

verses.kom: Àŋena yɨ kul nô ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m, njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ kumtɨ ɨ̀bye’lɨ vzɨ̀ a wu faŋ, wu luyn nkwòsɨ̀ njvàsɨ̀ bò.
verses.niv: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-læ yɨ ɨfwo ɨ yɨnɨ nâ vzɨ̀ ɨ nà n-chem ndû nkam sɨ̀ tâyn, ghɨ taŋ wi ghɨ̀kì nɨ̀ woynda.
verses.niv: The number of those who ate was about five thousand men, besides women and children.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ghì ɨ yɨ mèsì nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ na sɨ zɨ a ngù’ ɨ̀ nà dyâŋ ndû injɨyn i ɨlùe i li sɨ asɨ, wu faŋ ibàm ɨ bè ghelɨ nà kfâ.
verses.niv: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of him to the other side, while he dismissed the crowd.

verses.kom: Ta wù bè tî, ghelɨ lù ɨ se sɨ kfa, wu lù ɨ ko’ atû kfɨ̀yn kɨ̀ ŋweyn nìnyɨŋ sɨ jèm, ɨtu’ ɨ ni nà sɨ jɨ gvi-à, wu ghɨ kɨ afu ŋweyn nìnyɨŋ.
verses.niv: After he had dismissed them, he went up on a mountainside by himself to pray. When evening came, he was there alone,

verses.kom: A ghɨ tì, ma ngù’ zɨ̂ a njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ nì zɨ ateyn tì jelɨ meyn nô sɨ aghaf têyn antêynɨ̀ ɨ̀lùe, jvà nà sɨ nê’ nyeyn nô sɨ a ŋaŋ bòm ta a nà n-ghɨ tì afyef a ɨ chwo-à, gvî dzɨ a àŋena asɨ.
verses.niv: but the boat was already a considerable distance from land, buffeted by the waves because the wind was against it.

verses.kom: A ni nà ghɨ a nlâyn ɨ̀tù’, Jisòs ɨ lù ɨ nà jêl ndû atû mù sɨ yeyn njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweyn.
verses.niv: During the fourth watch of the night Jesus went out to them, walking on the lake.

verses.kom: Àŋena yeyn ta wù n-jelɨ̀ gvî atû mù tî, ɨ kfɨ sayn ɨ nà sɨ byal dzɨ-à, bê na, «À n-ghɨ nkfɨ̂ nse!»
verses.niv: When the disciples saw him walking on the lake, they were terrified. “It's a ghost,” they said, and cried out in fear.

verses.kom: Nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, Jisòs ɨ taŋi ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Ka yi n-fàyn. À n-ghɨ mà. Yì yvɨsɨ atem.»
verses.niv: But Jesus immediately said to them: “Take courage! It is I. Don't be afraid.”

verses.kom: Bità ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Bô, à na ghɨ kɨ nô và samo’, wa bè, mà jel atû mù gvì yèyn vâ.»
verses.niv: “Lord, if it's you,” Peter replied, “tell me to come to you on the water.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè na wù gvi. Bità ɨ fvɨ̀ ɨ nà sɨ jêl ndû a ngùŋ nɨ̀ Jisòs kɨ̀ nô atû mù.
verses.niv: “Come,” he said. Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water and came toward Jesus.

verses.kom: A nà sɨ ghɨ ta wù yeyn afyef ta kɨ n-chwô, ifâyn i ku ŋweyn, wu zɨ̀tɨ̀ sɨ sœ a jvâ, ɨ byal dzɨ̀ sɨ̂ Jisòs na, «Bô, gàmtɨ ma ka mà sœ!»
verses.niv: But when he saw the wind, he was afraid and, beginning to sink, cried out, “Lord, save me!”

verses.kom: Nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, Jisòs ɨ nàysɨ̀ àwu ɨ ghal ŋweyn ɨ kæ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Ibɨmi ì zæ nɨn læ̂ ghà têyn a? Bòm ghà ta wà nì nà kfâ’ kfa’ na mà kà’ a mà ni, a wà jel atû mù a?»
verses.niv: Immediately Jesus reached out his hand and caught him. “You of little faith,” he said, “why did you doubt?”

verses.kom: Àŋena kasi zɨ a ngù’ nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, afyef kì ɨ teyna kɨ teyna.
verses.niv: And when they climbed into the boat, the wind died down.

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweyn sìsɨ̀ a sɨ nà n-ghɨ a ngù’ ɨ nà sɨ ngvɨmlɨ̂ ŋweyn bê na, «Wà n-ghɨ kɨ nô Wâyn Fɨ̀yìnì samo’.»
verses.niv: Then those who were in the boat worshiped him, saying, “Truly you are the Son of God.”

verses.kom: Àŋena dyaŋ mèsì jva ɨ chem a ntè’ Gènesalèt,
verses.niv: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret.

verses.kom: ghelɨ ɨ yeyn keli ŋweyn afu ɨ tum fè’tɨ kɨ sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m antêynɨ̀ ìla’ afu na ghelɨ li gvì nɨ̀ ghelɨ ghɨ ko’inɨ sɨ̂ ŋweyn nô ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m,
verses.niv: And when the men of that place recognized Jesus, they sent word to all the surrounding country. People brought all their sick to him

verses.kom: ɨ chwotɨ ŋweyn na wù visi ghelɨ ghɨ ko’inɨ ateyn na kûm kɨ nô kum ighaŋ i ndzɨsɨ nɨ̀ ŋweyn. Ɨghî a ghɨ n-kùm ɨ to nô ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m.
verses.niv: and begged him to let the sick just touch the edge of his cloak, and all who touched him were healed.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ Falàsî ghɨ li nɨ̀ ndyèynsɨ̀ sɨ isa’ sɨ lisɨ nɨ̀n læ meyn lù a Jèlusalèm ɨ gvi yeyn Jisòs ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na,
verses.niv: Then some Pharisees and teachers of the law came to Jesus from Jerusalem and asked,

verses.kom: «Bòm ghà ta njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ vàsɨ̀ nɨn chi wi nchînɨ̀ ghɨ̀bo ghesɨ̀nà a? Àŋena nɨn se sɨ yɨ, ghɨ bû sù ɨ̀wu.»
verses.niv: “Why do your disciples break the tradition of the elders? They don't wash their hands before they eat!”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ kasi bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Bòm ghà ta yi n-kolɨ̀ isa’ i Fɨ̂yìnì bòm nchînɨ̀ ìla’ nɨ̀ zɨ̀ a?
verses.niv: Jesus replied, “And why do you break the command of God for the sake of your tradition?

verses.kom: Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ be meyn na, ‹Ngvɨmlɨ bò vâ nɨ̀ nà vâ,› ɨ̀ fì bè na, ‹À tè mɨ nda bò ŋweyn kèsa nà ŋweyn, a ghɨ na kelɨ sɨ zue ŋweyn.›
verses.niv: For God said, ‘Honor your father and mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.’

verses.kom: Mɨtì yi na ye’î na, wùl ɨ̀ kà’ a wù tuynsɨ sɨ fu afo sɨ̂ bò ŋweyn kèsa sɨ̂ nà ŋweyn kɨ bòm ta wù n-lêm na yì tî nà sɨ ghɨ ma yi chfɨnɨ meyn sɨ fu afo ateyn sɨ̂ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀.
verses.niv: But you say that if a man says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever help you might otherwise have received from me is a gift devoted to God,’

verses.kom: Yi ti n-dyêyn na sɨ̂ zɨ, wùl nâ wèyn nɨ̀n kelɨ wi sɨ ngvɨmlɨ bò ŋweyn. À ti dzɨ zɨ̀ a yi n-kfɨ̂m iwo i Fɨ̂yìnì ateyn bòm nchînɨ̀ ìla’ nɨ̀ zɨ̀.
verses.niv: he is not to ‘honor his father’ with it. Thus you nullify the word of God for the sake of your tradition.

verses.kom: Ghɨ̀ kem kem nì ghèyn! Nfè’tɨ̀ Ìsayà nɨ̂n læ fè’tɨ kɨ nô ntûm Fɨ̀yìnì kûm zɨ̀ samo’ na:
verses.niv: You hypocrites! Isaiah was right when he prophesied about you:

verses.kom: ‹Ghelɨ ghèyn nɨn ko’sɨ̂ kɨ mà nɨ̀ ɨ̀chfɨ̂, mɨtì lî wì ma sɨ afo.
verses.niv: “ ‘These people honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me.

verses.kom: Àŋena nɨn yeyn kɨ nge’ salû, bê na ghɨ n-ko’sɨ̂ mà, bòm ta àŋena nɨn ye’î àwo ma à fàytɨ ghelɨ, lêm na à n-ghɨ tɨ̀sa’ ɨ̀ temtɨ.›»
verses.niv: They worship me in vain; their teachings are but rules taught by men.’ ”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ taŋi tì ɨ jàŋtɨ̀ ànôyn a ghêl kì, kɨ gvì, wu bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yì yvɨtɨ nà kya.
verses.niv: Jesus called the crowd to him and said, “Listen and understand.

verses.kom: À n-ghɨ wi afo kì a wùl nɨ̀n yɨ a kɨ n-nî na wù na ghɨ wi nɨ̀ ìlayn i asɨ nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀, à n-kwo ghɨ àwo kì a kɨ fvɨ̂ a ŋweyn ɨchfɨ̀.»
verses.niv: What goes into a man's mouth does not make him ‘unclean,’ but what comes out of his mouth, that is what makes him ‘unclean.’ ”

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ ni bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn nâ wù n-kya na wù ni meyn tàŋi tì ghelɨ Falàsî na nyô’sɨ̀ ɨ̀toŋ a?
verses.niv: Then the disciples came to him and asked, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bèynsɨ sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Ghɨ nì cho’ nô mɨ ghà vzɨ̂ a kɨ n-lema bùla à tô’ Bò wom iyvɨ.
verses.niv: He replied, “Every plant that my heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by the roots.

verses.kom: Yì visi kɨ̀ visi àŋena. Àŋena nɨn ghɨ ɨ̀nfèf, yeyn wi ɨlwê’, mɨtì kɨŋ sɨ nà dyeyn dzɨ sɨ ɨlvi. Ànfèf à nɨn dyêyn dzɨ sɨ ali-a, a àŋena fe ibɨ kɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m.»
verses.niv: Leave them; they are blind guides. If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit.”

verses.kom: Bità ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Fè’tɨ iwo zɨ̀ a ngàyn nâ yèyn nɨ̀n ye’i sɨ̂ ghès.»
verses.niv: Peter said, “Explain the parable to us.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «A yì bu ghɨ kɨ sɨ ɨ̀ngù ta ghelɨ ghɨ li?
verses.niv: “Are you still so dull?” Jesus asked them.

verses.kom: Ba yi ti n-ghɨ na yi n-yeyn wi na nô mɨ ghà vzɨ̂ a wùl nɨ̀n yɨ nɨn kalì chem a ŋweyn ɨlvà, kɨ fi chwò ɨ fvɨ̀ kɨ fvɨ sɨ a ŋweyn ɨwùyn?
verses.niv: “Don't you see that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and then out of the body?

verses.kom: Mɨtì, awo kì a kɨ n-fvɨ̂ a wùl ɨchfɨ̀ ɨ ghɨ ma kɨ lù kɨ̀ a ŋweyn item, a ghɨ àwo kì a kɨ n-nî na wù na ghɨ wi nɨ̀ ìlayn i.
verses.niv: But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart, and these make a man ‘unclean.’

verses.kom: Ikfâ’tɨ̀ i bzɨ-i nɨn fvɨ̂ kɨ a wùl item nɨ̀ àwo a bɨ-a a li-a têyn ta, sɨ zue, sɨ chi nɨ̀ wî wùl kèsa zɨ̂ lûm wùl, nɨ̀ ìjûm i ghɨ̂kì, nɨ̀ ìchoŋ i, nɨ̀ ànkaŋ a ta ka wà wam a wùl ɨ̀ atu, fì bè àwo a bɨ-a a li-a kûm wul.
verses.niv: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, slander.

verses.kom: À ti awo kì a kɨ n-nî wùl ɨ̀ nà ghɨ wi nɨ̀ ìlayn i, a ghɨ wi ɨlvɨ ta wù yɨ bùla wù sû ɨ̀wu ta nchînɨ̀ ìla’ nɨn dyêyn.»
verses.niv: These are what make a man ‘unclean’; but eating with unwashed hands does not make him ‘unclean.’ ”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ taŋi tì ɨ lù sɨ afu ɨ ndù ɨbwàs ila’ ghè a nte’ Tayà nɨ̀ Sidòn nà n-ghɨ ateyn.
verses.niv: Leaving that place, Jesus withdrew to the region of Tyre and Sidon.

verses.kom: Wùl ɨ wi ìla’ i Kanàn ɨ̀ lvì ta wù nà n-chi ba’sɨ afu ɨ gvì sɨ̂ Jisòs ɨ nà sɨ byal dzɨ-à bê na, «Koynsɨ isuyn sɨ̂ mà a Bô, Wâyn Fòyn Devìt! Wayn wom ɨ wi nɨn yeyn nge’ nô sɨ a ŋaŋ bòm ta wù n-kelɨ ayvɨs a bɨ-a.»
verses.niv: A Canaanite woman from that vicinity came to him, crying out, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on me! My daughter is suffering terribly from demon-possession.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ faŋ tɨ̀ bè iwo. Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ gvì sɨ̂ ŋweyn ɨ nà sɨ chwotɨ̂ ŋweyn bê na, «Sàŋ ŋweyn sɨ a ghesɨ̀nà ibàm, wù n-jêl byal dzɨ̂ tèyn, yôysɨ̀ ɨ̀tuŋlɨ ɨ ghêl.»
verses.niv: Jesus did not answer a word. So his disciples came to him and urged him, “Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ wùl ɨ wi àteyn na, «Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ tî tùm ma kɨ̀ sɨ̂ ghelɨ Isìlæò ghì a ghɨ n-ghɨ têyn ta njɨ̀sɨ lelɨnɨsɨ.»
verses.niv: He answered, “I was sent only to the lost sheep of Israel.”

verses.kom: Wùl ɨ wi àteyn ɨ kɨŋtɨ ɨ gvì ɨ tɨm alvɨ a ŋweyn a nse ɨ bè na, «Bô, gàmtɨ ma.»
verses.niv: The woman came and knelt before him. “Lord, help me!” she said.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Yi n-jofɨ̀ wì na ghɨ li ɨfwo ɨ yɨnɨ nɨ̀ woynda ɨ̀ mà’ sɨ̂ bɨsɨ.»
verses.niv: He replied, “It is not right to take the children's bread and toss it to their dogs.”

verses.kom: Wùl ɨ wi àteyn ɨ bɨmi ɨ bè na, «Mɨ n-kya kɨ nô tèyn a Bô, mɨtì kya kɨmɨ na bò ndo nɨ̀n se sɨ yɨ, ɨbye’lɨ ɨfwo ɨ nà chemlɨ-à, nô mɨ bɨsɨ ɨ boŋ yɨ-a.»
verses.niv: “Yes, Lord,” she said, “but even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their masters' table.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Wà faytɨ meyn bɨ̀mi kɨ nô bɨmi sɨ̂ mà a nàwàyn! Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ nɨn nî ìwo zɨ̀ a wà n-kɨŋ.» Wayn ŋweyn vzɨ̀ ɨ to kɨ ɨlvɨ nâ ghè.
verses.niv: Then Jesus answered, “Woman, you have great faith! Your request is granted.” And her daughter was healed from that very hour.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ lù sɨ afu ɨ nà jêl ndû a mbæò ɨ̀lùe ɨ Galìlî, ɨ ndu ko’ a kfɨyn ɨ nà sɨ chîtɨ̀ afu.
verses.niv: Jesus left there and went along the Sea of Galilee. Then he went up on a mountainside and sat down.

verses.kom: Inôyn i ghêl i nà sɨ gvî sɨ̂ ŋweyn, dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn, lî gvî nɨ̀ mɨ̀ngês nɨ̀ ghelɨ ma ghɨ fef meyn, nɨ ghɨli ma ghɨ lvɨŋ meyn nà bu fì kya wi sɨ jèl, nɨ̀ ɨ̀nkù’ ɨ̀, nɨ ghɨli, ghɨ dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn, ghɨ ko’î nɨ̀ tɨ̀ko’i tɨ kɨ̀ a tɨ̂nkì a tɨ̂nkì. Ghɨ gvî tì lêm asɨ nɨ̀ Jisòs, wu chu’ àŋena.
verses.niv: Great crowds came to him, bringing the lame, the blind, the crippled, the mute and many others, and laid them at his feet; and he healed them.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ateyn ɨ nà ghɨ nɨ̀ ìkayn i ta ghɨ yèyn ta ɨ̀nkù’ ɨ̀ nɨn kasi taŋi, mɨ̀ngês nɨ̀ ghelɨ ghɨ lvɨŋnɨ jelà, ɨ̀nfèf ɨ̀ ɨ kasî yeyn ɨ̀lwê’. Ghelɨ yeyn tî ɨ nà ko’sɨ̂ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ Isìlæò.
verses.niv: The people were amazed when they saw the mute speaking, the crippled made well, the lame walking and the blind seeing. And they praised the God of Israel.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ jàŋ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweyn ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Isuyn i nɨn kolâ mà sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghèyn. Àŋena chi meyn ghesɨ̀ àŋena sɨ a mɨchi ɨ̀n tal lvɨ̂yn ɨ̀ nà bu fì kelɨ wi afo sɨ yɨ. Mɨ n-kôŋ wì sɨ bè na àŋena na kfâ sɨ a jeŋ. Wùl ɨ̀ kà’ a wù fvɨ ɨ̀ bòli ɨ̀ fe a dzɨ.»
verses.niv: Jesus called his disciples to him and said, “I have compassion for these people; they have already been with me three days and have nothing to eat. I do not want to send them away hungry, or they may collapse on the way.”

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Ghès ti kà’ a ghɨ li wo ɨfwo ɨ yɨnɨ alè’ ɨtwa’ tèyn, wu kfeynɨ̂ sɨ yɨsɨ ghelɨ ateyn, ghɨ dvɨ̂ tèyn a?»
verses.niv: His disciples answered, “Where could we get enough bread in this remote place to feed such a crowd?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yi n-kelɨ tɨ̀ghef tɨ abayn tɨ̀ sè’ afî a?» Àŋena bèynsɨ̀ na, «Ghès nɨn kelɨ tɨ̀ghef, nsòmbo nɨ̀ mɨ̀sfɨ̀tɨ̂ ɨ̀n se’ têyn.»
verses.niv: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied, “and a few small fish.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ ànôyn a ghêl nâ kì na kɨ du’i a nse.
verses.niv: He told the crowd to sit down on the ground.

verses.kom: Àŋena dù’ì, wu lì tɨ̀ghef tɨ abayn tìtɨ̀, nsòmbo nɨ̀ mɨ̀sfɨ̀tɨ̂ mɨ̀ àteyn. A nà sɨ ghɨ ta wù fù meyn àyòŋnɨ̀ sɨ̂ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀, wu be’lɨ ɨ fu sɨ̂ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ, àŋena boŋ gwòtɨ ndù sɨ̂ ghelɨ.
verses.niv: Then he took the seven loaves and the fish, and when he had given thanks, he broke them and gave them to the disciples, and they in turn to the people.

verses.kom: Nô mɨ ndà ɨ yɨ ɨ kul. Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ kumtɨ ɨ̀bye’lɨ vzɨ̀ a wu faŋ, wu luyn nkwòsɨ̀ nsòmbo.
verses.niv: They all ate and were satisfied. Afterward the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-yɨ nà n-ghɨ nkam sɨ̀ kæò, ghɨ taŋ wi ghɨ̀kì nɨ̀ woynda.
verses.niv: The number of those who ate was four thousand, besides women and children.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè ghelɨ ateyn ɨ kasi se sɨ kfa, wu zɨ a ngù’ ɨ ndù dzɨ abàs ila’ ghè a ghɨ nà n-toŋtɨ na Magadàn.
verses.niv: After Jesus had sent the crowd away, he got into the boat and went to the vicinity of Magadan.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ Falàsî nɨ̀ ghelɨ Sadùsî nɨn læ meyn gvì sɨ̂ Jisòs ɨ nà kɨŋ dzɨ sɨ ku ŋweyn ateyn ɨ kæ bè na wù ni iwo i kaynɨ-i i li sɨ a nchwæ sɨ dyeyn na adya’ a ŋweyna lù kɨ̀ nô sɨ̂ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀.
verses.niv: The Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus and tested him by asking him to show them a sign from heaven.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Ɨchfɨ̂-iyvɨ i nɨn se sɨ sœ, iyvɨ i na baŋà, yi bè na ɨlwê’ læò nà jôf a libɨs.
verses.niv: He replied, “When evening comes, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red,’

verses.kom: Ɨtu’ ɨ bɨs layn, ɨlwê’ ɨ na gvɨ̂yn kê’ ke’, yi bè na ivɨ i nɨn su’i layn. Yi n-ki kɨ àbe, yi fè’tɨ̀ ìwo zɨ̀ a yi n-ghɨ sɨ gàyn mɨtì ma yì kà’ yi bû ki awo kèynà ɨ̀ fè’tɨ̀ ìwo zɨ̀ a kɨ n-dyêyn a mɨchi ghàyn.
verses.niv: and in the morning, ‘Today it will be stormy, for the sky is red and overcast.’ You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but you cannot interpret the signs of the times.

verses.kom: À n-ghɨ kɨ àjâŋ a bɨ-a têyn ta akeynà a kɨ n-fâyn wi Fɨ̀yìnì a kɨ kà’ a kɨ na bɨf nchwæ. Kɨ n-yeyn wi nchwæ ì lì, a bu kɨ ɨyî Jonà.» Wu taŋi tì, ɨ lu kɨ lu.
verses.niv: A wicked and adulterous generation looks for a miraculous sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.” Jesus then left them and went away.

verses.kom: Jisòs ŋêyn njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ ni se sɨ dyàŋ injɨyn ɨlùe i li, àŋena lèsɨ̀ sɨ lì abayn,
verses.niv: When they went across the lake, the disciples forgot to take bread.

verses.kom: ɨ dyàŋ ɨ chem, Jisòs ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yì na tô’nɨ̀ kûm fɨ̀shɨ̀k fɨ ghelɨ Falàsî ŋêyn ghelɨ Sadùsî.»
verses.niv: “Be careful,” Jesus said to them. “Be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

verses.kom: Àŋena nà sɨ bêsɨ̀ ìwo ateyn a àŋena antêynɨ̀ bê na, «Wù n-taŋî tèyn bòm ta ghesɨ̀nà nì lèsɨ̀ sɨ li abayn.»
verses.niv: They discussed this among themselves and said, “It is because we didn't bring any bread.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ keli ìwo zɨ̀ a àŋena nɨn bêsɨ̀ ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «A ti ta ibɨmi ì zɨ-i nɨn læ têyn? Bòm ghà ta yi n-bê na à n-ghɨ bòm ta yi n-kelɨ wi abayn a?
verses.niv: Aware of their discussion, Jesus asked, “You of little faith, why are you talking among yourselves about having no bread?

verses.kom: Ba yi ti n-ghɨ na yì bu du’ tɨ̀ kèli iwo? Yì bu kfâ’tɨ̀ wì ta mɨ n-læ yɨsɨ ghelɨ ghì nkam sɨ̀ tâyn nɨ̀ tɨ̀ghef tɨ abayn tɨ̀ tâyn tɨ̀ ti â? Yi n-læ kumtɨ ɨbye’lɨ vzɨ̀ a wu n-faŋ, wu luyn nkwòsɨ̀ sè’ ti a?
verses.niv: Do you still not understand? Don't you remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?

verses.kom: Yi lesɨ meyn ghelɨ ghì nkam sɨ̀ kæò a mɨ n-læ yɨsɨ nɨ̀ tɨ̀ghef tɨ abayn tìtɨ̀ nsòmbo ti â? Yi n-læ kumtɨ ɨbye’lɨ vzɨ̀ a wu n-faŋ, wu luyn nkwòsɨ̀ sè’ ti a?
verses.niv: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?

verses.kom: Bòm ghà ta yì nì faŋ tɨ̀ kèli na ma bû nì nà taŋî sɨ̂ zɨ̀ kûm àbayn a? Yì na tô’nɨ̀ kûm fɨ̀shɨ̀k fɨ ghelɨ Falàsî ŋêyn ghelɨ Sadùsî.»
verses.niv: How is it you don't understand that I was not talking to you about bread? But be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

verses.kom: Wu bè tèyn, njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ kæ keli na wù bû nì nà taŋî kûm fɨ̀shɨ̀k fɨ abayn. Àŋena kæ keli na wù nì nà taŋî kûm ìye’i i ghelɨ Falàsî ŋêyn ghelɨ Sadùsî.
verses.niv: Then they understood that he was not telling them to guard against the yeast used in bread, but against the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ lù ɨ ndù abàs ila’ ghè a yi nà n-ba’sɨ a ntè’ Sìsaliya Filìbây ŋêyn njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ kæ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Ghelɨ nɨn bê na Wâyn Wùl nɨ̀n ghɨ ndà?»
verses.niv: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, “Who do people say the Son of Man is?”

verses.kom: Àŋena bèynsɨ̀ ɨ bè na, «Ghɨli nɨn bê na wà n-ghɨ Joyn Nfû Mù, ghɨli bê na wà n-ghɨ nfè’tɨ̀ Ìlajà, ghɨli bê na wà n-ghɨ nfè’tɨ̀ Jèlìmayà, bùla tì a wà na ghɨ kɨmɨ nfè’tɨ i gha’nɨ ì lì.»
verses.niv: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Nô zɨ̀ nɨn bê na mɨ n-ghɨ ndà?»
verses.niv: “But what about you?” he asked. “Who do you say I am?”

verses.kom: Saymun Bità ɨ bè na, «À n-ghɨ và Christ, ɨ Wâyn Fɨ̀yìnì fìfɨ̀ a fɨ n-chi.»
verses.niv: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ kæ bè na, «Njùŋ nɨ̀n ghɨ sɨ̂ và a Saymùn ɨ wâyn Jonà, bòm ta à bû fè’tɨ̀ wul iwo nâ yèynì a wà bè têyn sɨ̂ và, à dyèyn Bò wom, ɨ Fɨ̀yìnì fìfɨ̀ a fɨ n-ghɨ iyvɨ.
verses.niv: Jesus replied, “Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah, for this was not revealed to you by man, but by my Father in heaven.

verses.kom: Ma na sɨ bê kɨmɨ sɨ̂ và na izɨyn ì zæ nɨn ghɨ Bità, ma ghɨ sɨ bà’lɨ nchɨ̀yntɨ̂ ghelɨ ghɨ bɨminɨ nɨ̀ mà atû ngò’ nâ ghàyn, na adya’ ikfɨ-a læ̂ faŋ tɨ̀ to tɨ̀ chwò.
verses.niv: And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not overcome it.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-fu àncho’ alè’ ɨfoyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì sɨ̂ và, a wà na bɨmî mɨ ghà a nse kèsa wà tùynsɨ tuynsɨ, Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ jemtɨ̂ sɨ iyvɨ.»
verses.niv: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven; whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ taŋi tèyn ɨ kæ tsɨ̀sɨ̀ sɨ̂ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ na ka wùl nɨ̂n yvɨ na yi n-ghɨ Christ, ma à ti ɨvzɨ̂ a ghɨ chò’ meyn lèm.
verses.niv: Then he warned his disciples not to tell anyone that he was the Christ.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ zɨ̀tɨ kɨ ɨlvɨ nâ ghè ɨ nà sɨ fê’tɨ̀ sɨ̂ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ na yi n-kelɨ sɨ ndù a Jèlusalèm, sɨ yeyn nge’ i gha’nɨ, na chye’sɨ ŋêyn ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì sɨ gha’nɨsɨ nɨ̀ ndyèynsɨ̀ sɨ isa’sɨ zue zɨ, a à na ghɨ a mɨchi ɨ̀n tal, a yì kasi làlì sɨ ikfɨ.
verses.niv: From that time on Jesus began to explain to his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things at the hands of the elders, chief priests and teachers of the law, and that he must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.

verses.kom: Bità ɨ gùbtɨ̀ ŋweyn ibàm ɨ nà sɨ yolɨ̀ sɨ̂ ŋweyn bê na, «Ka wa n-læò fì bè ìwo nâ yèynì a Bô! Yi kà’ yi bû læò gàyn sɨ̂ và.»
verses.niv: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him. “Never, Lord!” he said. “This shall never happen to you!”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ kasi kè’ Bità ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Kasi sɨ a ma ibàm a Satàyn! Wà n-tâysɨ̀ mà. Wà n-kelɨ wi ikfâ’tɨ̀ i Fɨ̂yìnì, wà n-kfâ’tɨ̀ kɨ ta wul.»
verses.niv: Jesus turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me; you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ taŋi tèyn ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ na, «À na kôŋ mɨ ndà sɨ jùmtɨ ma, wu mà’ì ngêŋ ŋweyn ɨ bèy’ì ànwâmnɨ̀ a ŋweyn ɨ jùmtɨ̀ mà.
verses.niv: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone would come after me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow me.

verses.kom: À mòmsɨ̀ mɨ ndà sɨ bœòsɨ ngêŋ ŋweyn, a wù kfɨ; ma à kfɨ̀ mɨ ndà bòm mà, a wù chî faŋ.
verses.niv: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for me will find it.

verses.kom: Wùl ti kà’ a wù sæ nô ghà ɨlvɨ ta wù kèli kɨ̀ mbzɨ ì jɨ̀m mɨtì lè àyvɨs a ŋweyn a? Wùl ɨ̀ ti kà’ a wù yuyn atu a ŋweyn nô nɨ̀ ghà?
verses.niv: What good will it be for a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his soul? Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê tèyn bòm ta Wâyn Wùl nɨn nì mûtɨ̀ kɨ tèyn ɨ̀ kàsî gvì antêynɨ̀ ìbayn i gha’nɨ-i nɨ̀ Bò ŋweyn ŋêyn nchìsɨ ŋweynsɨ ɨ̀ nà fu nô mɨ ɨ̀mwa’tɨ ɨ nda kɨ̀ ighel ta wù tî nà felà.
verses.niv: For the Son of Man is going to come in his Father's glory with his angels, and then he will reward each person according to what he has done.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na, ghelɨ ghɨ li nɨn ti kɨ nô afêyn lvɨ̂yn, ghɨ wi sɨ læò sɨ kfɨ nô sakos sɨ ya’i ta ka Wâyn Wùl kasî gvì ɨ̀ nà sa’ ɨ̀fôyn ɨ ŋweyn.»
verses.niv: I tell you the truth, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in his kingdom.”

verses.kom: A nà sɨ ghɨ ibàm i mɨ̂chi ntufa, Jisòs ɨ lì Bità nɨ̀ Jêm ŋêyn wayn-nà ŋweyn Joyn ɨ ko’ nɨ̀ àŋena atû kfɨ̀yn i gha’nɨ ì lì, yi dyêf kɨ tèyn, wùl ɨ ghɨ wi afu,
verses.niv: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James and John the brother of James, and led them up a high mountain by themselves.

verses.kom: ɨ ndù ɨ chem afu, ikê’ i ŋweyni gvɨ̀tɨ kfɨnɨ kɨ a àŋena asɨ tèyn ɨ nà sɨ bayn kɨ ta ɨchfɨ̂-iyvɨ. Ndzɨsɨ ŋweynsɨ ɨ kasi nà sɨ fɨf kɨ tèyn fî njêyntɨ̀-à.
verses.niv: There he was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and his clothes became as white as the light.

verses.kom: Kɨ̀ têyn, Mosìs ŋêyn Ìlajà ɨ fvɨ̀ a àŋena ikè’ ɨ nà sɨ taŋî sɨ̂ Jisòs.
verses.niv: Just then there appeared before them Moses and Elijah, talking with Jesus.

verses.kom: Bità ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ Jisòs na, «Yi n-jôf a Bô ta ghesɨ̀nà nɨn ghɨ afêyn. Wà kæ sɨ nà koŋà, a mà ba’lɨ mɨtwo ɨ̀n tal, a wà na kelɨ fɨ̀mò’, Mosìs ɨ kelɨ fɨ̀mò’, Ìlajà ɨ kelɨ fɨlifɨ.»
verses.niv: Peter said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you wish, I will put up three shelters –one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah.”

verses.kom: Wu nà n-bu taŋi kɨ taŋi, mbà’ sɨ lisɨ fvɨ̀, fɨfɨ kɨ tèyn mbvɨ ɨ su’i ɨ chɨytɨ àŋena. Gyà ɨ fvɨ̀ ateyn ɨ bè na, «Ɨwêyn nɨ̀n ghɨ Wayn ìkòŋ nɨ̀ mà, ma saŋlɨ̂ kûm ŋweyn sɨ a nyɨŋ. Yì na yvɨ sɨ̂ ŋweyn.»
verses.niv: While he was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, “This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased. Listen to him!”

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ Jisòs-sɨ̀ ɨ yvɨ gya nâ zɨ̀ tì ɨ nà fâyn nô sɨ a ŋaŋ ɨ felɨ a nse àkfɨ̀-akfɨ.
verses.niv: When the disciples heard this, they fell facedown to the ground, terrified.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ ndù ɨ kùm àŋena ɨ bè na, «Yì lali, ka yì fî fàyn.»
verses.niv: But Jesus came and touched them. “Get up,” he said. “Don't be afraid.”

verses.kom: Àŋena làysɨ̀ àsɨ ɨ se sɨ ki ma Jisòs sɨ ghɨ kɨ ŋweyn nìnyɨŋ.
verses.niv: When they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus.

verses.kom: Àŋena ni kasi se sɨ kàlì sɨ a kfɨyn, Jisòs ɨ tsɨ̀sɨ̀ sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Ka yi n-fè’tɨ̀ ìwo zɨ̀ a yì yeyn sɨ̂ wùl sɨ ya’i ta ka Wâyn Wùl kfɨ, a ghɨ kasî làysɨ̀ ŋweyn sɨ ikfɨ.»
verses.niv: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus instructed them, “Don't tell anyone what you have seen, until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead.”

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Bòm ghà ta ndyèynsɨ̀ sɨ isa’sɨ nɨn bê na à n-kelɨ Ìlajà sɨ gvi sɨ asɨ a?»
verses.niv: The disciples asked him, “Why then do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come first?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yi n-ghɨ kɨ nô samo’ na Ìlajà nɨn gvi-à, ghɨ sɨ ba’tɨ nô àwo à jɨ̀m.
verses.niv: Jesus replied, “To be sure, Elijah comes and will restore all things.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na Ìlajà sɨ ghɨ ma wù ti meyn gvì, ghelɨ yeyn ŋweyn, mɨtì faŋ tɨ̀ kèli ɨ̀ nà sɨ kolî mɨ ghà ta àŋena nɨn kôŋ, nî sɨ̂ ŋweyn. Àŋena nɨn nì nî kɨmɨ tì sɨ̂ Wâyn Wùl. Wu n-nì yeyn nge’ a àŋena ɨwu.»
verses.niv: But I tell you, Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but have done to him everything they wished. In the same way the Son of Man is going to suffer at their hands.”

verses.kom: Wu n-bè têyn, njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ kæ keli na wù nì nà taŋî kûm Joyn Nfû Mù.
verses.niv: Then the disciples understood that he was talking to them about John the Baptist.

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨ̂n kàsi kàli sɨ a kfɨyn ŋêyn njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweyn sìsɨ̀ sɨ̀ tal ɨ gvi koli ànôyn a ghêl a li-a. Wul ɨ̀ lvì ɨ fvɨ̀ antêynɨ̀ nɨ̀ àŋena ɨ tɨm alvɨ asɨ nɨ̀ ŋweyn,
verses.niv: When they came to the crowd, a man approached Jesus and knelt before him.

verses.kom: ɨbè na, «Bôbo, koynsɨ isuyn sɨ̂ wàyn ɨ wom ɨ lûmnɨ̀ wèyn. Wù n-gvɨ-à, yeyn nge’ nô sɨ a ŋaŋ, faŋ wi tɨ̀ fe ɨvɨ̀s kèsa antêynɨ̀ mù.
verses.niv: “Lord, have mercy on my son,” he said. “He has seizures and is suffering greatly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.

verses.kom: Ma ti meyn gvì nɨ̀ ŋweyn sɨ̂ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ vàsɨ̀, wù gha’ àŋena sɨ chu’.»
verses.niv: I brought him to your disciples, but they could not heal him.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè na, «À n-ghɨ àjâŋ a bɨ-a à kà kêyn a kɨ n-wo sɨ bɨmi teyn a? Mɨ n-chî chem ti ghesɨ̀nà jæ na yì bɨmi a?» Wu taŋi tì ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ wùl àteyn na, «Gvi nɨ̀ wayn àteyn afêyn sɨ̂ mà.»
verses.niv: “O unbelieving and perverse generation,” Jesus replied, “how long shall I stay with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring the boy here to me.”

verses.kom: Wu gvì nɨ̀ ŋweyn, Jisòs ɨ kàyntɨ̀ àwo sɨ̂ àyvɨs a bɨ-a nâ kì, kɨ fvɨ̀ sɨ ɨwuyn nɨ̀ wayn àteyn, wu to kɨ ɨlvɨ nâ ghè.
verses.niv: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, and he was healed from that moment.

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ Jisòs-sɨ̀ ɨ ni nya’tɨ gvì sɨ ŋweyn ɨ bɨf na, «Bòm ghà ta yi nì to ghà’ ghes sɨ sàŋ sɨ fvɨ̀sɨ ayvɨs a bɨ-a nâ kì a?»
verses.niv: Then the disciples came to Jesus in private and asked, “Why couldn't we drive it out?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bèynsɨ̀ na, «À n-ghɨ bòm ta ibɨmi ì zɨ-i nɨn læ. Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na yi nà n-kelɨ ibɨmi, yi læ̂ mɨ ta isɨ i ngœò mostà, yi kâ’ a yì be sɨ̂ kfɨ̀yn yêyn na yì lu sɨ alè’ ghàyn ɨ̀ ndù dzɨ afi, a yì ndu kɨ̀ tî. Yi nà n-kelɨ ibɨmi, ma iwo i nɨn to gha’ wi zɨ.
verses.niv: He replied, “Because you have so little faith. I tell you the truth, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.”

verses.kom: (Yì kà’ a yì saŋ fvɨ̀sɨ̀ ìnkì ayvɨs a bɨ-a têyn ta akeyn nâ kèynà kɨ̀ ɨlvɨ ta yi n-jêm fî bam ɨ̀chfɨ̂.»)
Jisòs ŋêyn njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ ndù ɨ chem a Galìlî, wu fi kæ be sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Ghɨ n-fu Wâyn Wùl sɨ̂ ghelɨ,
verses.niv: When they came together in Galilee, he said to them, “The Son of Man is going to be betrayed into the hands of men.

verses.kom: a ghɨ zue ŋweyn, a à na ghɨ a mɨchi ɨ̀n tal, a ghɨ kasî làysɨ̀ ŋweyn sɨ ikfɨ.» Iwo ateyn i ɨ nà fu nge’ sɨ̂ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ nô sɨ a ŋaŋ.
verses.niv: They will kill him, and on the third day he will be raised to life.” And the disciples were filled with grief.

verses.kom: Jisòs ŋêyn njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ nɨ̀n jelɨ meyn ɨ ndù ɨ chem a ntè’ Kàbanùm, ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ nà n-fsɨ ɨkwo tâks ndô Fɨ̀yìnì ɨ gvi bɨf sɨ̂ Bità na, «Ba ndyèynsɨ̀ vzɨ nɨn mâ’ tâks ndô Fɨ̀yìnì?»
verses.niv: After Jesus and his disciples arrived in Capernaum, the collectors of the two-drachma tax came to Peter and asked, “Doesn't your teacher pay the temple tax?”

verses.kom: Bità ɨ bɨmi ɨ bè na wù n-ma’à. A nà sɨ ghɨ ta wù kàsi meyn ɨ̀ zɨ a ndo, a taŋi Jisòs sɨ asɨ ɨ kæ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Wà n-kfâ’tɨ̀ na gha a Saymùn, na tɨfôyn tɨ mbzɨ tɨ nɨn fsɨ ɨ̀kwo ɨ tâks sɨ ghelɨ àŋena ma sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghɨ gvinɨ a?»
