verses.niv: “Yes, he does,” he replied. When Peter came into the house, Jesus was the first to speak. “What do you think, Simon?” he asked. “From whom do the kings of the earth collect duty and taxes –from their own sons or from others?”

verses.kom: Bità ɨ bè na àŋena nɨn fsɨ sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghɨ gvinɨ. Jisòs ɨ kæ bè na, «Yi ti n-ghɨ na ghelɨ tɨla’ nâ ghèyn nɨn kelɨ wi sɨ nà la’ tâks sɨ̂ tɨ̀fôyn tɨ àŋenatɨ.
verses.niv: “From others,” Peter answered. “Then the sons are exempt,” Jesus said to him.

verses.kom: Yi n-ghɨ kɨ nô tèyn, mɨtì yi jofɨ̀ wì na ghesɨ̀và ni, àŋena nyò’sɨ̀ ɨ̀toŋ sɨ̂ ghesɨ̀và. Ndù ɨchfɨ ɨlùe ɨ mà’ nsa’, à lî nô mɨ sfɨ ì kà ateyn sɨ asɨ, wa yàs ɨ̀chfɨ̂ ateyn a ka wà yeyn ɨkwo akas. Wà yeyn, wa fvɨ̀sɨ̀ ɨ ndu là’ ɨ̀kwo ɨ tâks nɨ̀ ghesɨ̀và ateyn sɨ̂ àŋena.»
verses.niv: “But so that we may not offend them, go to the lake and throw out your line. Take the first fish you catch; open its mouth and you will find a four-drachma coin. Take it and give it to them for my tax and yours.”

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨ̂n tàŋi mèsi tî ɨ mutɨ kɨ têyn, njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ gvì ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «À n-ngaŋtɨ̂ chwô ndà wul ɨ̀ lvì alè’ ɨfoyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì a?»
verses.niv: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?”

verses.kom: Nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, Jisòs ɨ jàŋ fɨ̀foynda têyn ɨ bè na fɨ gvi ɨ̀ tìmi a àŋena asɨ,
verses.niv: He called a little child and had him stand among them.

verses.kom: ɨ kæ bè na, «Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na, yì kæ faŋ tɨ̀ kfɨ̀nɨ sɨ nà ghɨ ndû kɨmɨ tèyn ta woyn ghɨ bolɨ, wùl ɨ̀ sɨ̂ zɨ̀ ɨ bû læò zɨ alè’ ɨfoyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì.
verses.niv: And he said: “I tell you the truth, unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.

verses.kom: Yi ti n-dyêyn na wùl vzɨ̀ a wù n-ngaŋtɨ chwô ɨ̂lvì alè’ ɨfoyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì nɨ̀n ghɨ ɨvzɨ̂ a wù ngvɨ̀mlɨ ngêŋ ŋweyn ɨ̀ nà ghɨ kɨ tèyn ta wayn wèyn.
verses.niv: Therefore, whoever humbles himself like this child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

verses.kom: Ma à tò’nɨ̀ mɨ nda nɨ̀ wayndà têyn ta ɨwêyn bòm mà, a à na ghɨ ma wù to’nɨ meyn nɨ̀ mà.
verses.niv: “And whoever welcomes a little child like this in my name welcomes me.

verses.kom: «À kæ ni mɨ ndà na fɨfoyn fɨ̀ mò’ antêynɨ̀ nɨ̀ woyn nâ ghèyn a ghɨ bɨ̀mi meyn sɨ̂ mà têyn ni mbɨ, a yi na jôf na ghɨ chfɨŋ iti a ŋweyn ɨmzɨ̀ ɨ̀ ndù mà’ ŋweyn a jvâ i gha’nɨ ta ka wù kfɨ.
verses.niv: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in me to sin, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.

verses.kom: Nge’ i gha’nɨ nɨn ghɨ sɨ̂ mbzɨ bòm àwo kì a kɨ n-nî na ghelɨ na nî mbɨ. Awo nâ kèynà nɨn kelɨ kɨ sɨ nà gaynà, mɨtì nge’ i gha’nɨ ghɨ sɨ̂ wùl vzɨ̀ a wù n-kya isas awo nâ kèynà!
verses.niv: “Woe to the world because of the things that cause people to sin! Such things must come, but woe to the man through whom they come!

verses.kom: «Awu à kya kæ nì na wà ni mbɨ kèsa à nì àvɨ, wa teyn ɨ mà’ì. Yi n-jôf na wà keli ichi zɨ̀ a yi læò mæ wi bùla awu à mò’ kèsa avɨ à mò’ chwô ta ka wà na kelɨ ɨ̀byâs ɨwùyn nâ wèyn ɨ̀ jɨ̀m, ghɨ ma’ vâ ɨvɨ̀s ghê a wu n-bali, lɨmâ wì.
verses.niv: If your hand or your foot causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life maimed or crippled than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into eternal fire.

verses.kom: À kæ ni isɨ ì zæ na wà ni mbɨ, wa bò’ ɨ fvɨ̀sɨ̀ ɨ mà’ì. Yi n-jôf na wà keli ichi zɨ̀ a yi læò mæ wi nɨ̀ ìsɨ ì mò’ i, chwô ta ka wà na kelɨ àsɨ à jɨ̀m, ghɨ ma’ vâ ɨvɨ̀s alè’ ibebsɨ.
verses.niv: And if your eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.

verses.kom: «Yì to’nɨ ka wùl nɨ̂n læò kèsɨ fɨ̀foyn fɨ̀ mò’ antêynɨ̀ woyn ghɨ telâ ghèyn. Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na à n-ghɨ iyvɨ, nchì sìsɨ̀ a sɨ n-kini woyn nâ ghèyn ɨ bêynlɨ̀ kɨ a ngùŋ nɨ̀ Bò wom.
verses.niv: “See that you do not look down on one of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of my Father in heaven.

verses.kom: (Wâyn Wùl nɨn læ gvì sɨ bœòsɨ ghelɨ ghɨ lelɨnɨ.)
«Yì kfa’tɨ na wùl ɨ̀ kæ sɨ nà kelɨ njɨ̀sɨ̀ ɨvɨ, ìmò’ ɨ lê a wù jelɨ ti a? Yi gàyn tî, a wù visi sɨ li sìsɨ̀ mɨ̀vɨm bulamò’ njvàsɨ̀ bulamò’ atû kfɨ̀yn nà jelɨ̀ kɨŋ ìlì zɨ̂ a yì lè tî.
verses.niv: “What do you think? If a man owns a hundred sheep, and one of them wanders away, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go to look for the one that wandered off?

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na, wù kæ kɨŋ ɨ̀ yeyn a wù na saŋlɨ̂ nô a jûŋ kûm njɨ̀ nâ zɨ̀ ìmò’ chwô ta wù n-saŋlɨ kûm sɨ li sìsɨ̀ mɨvɨm bulamò’ njvàsɨ̀ bulamò’ a sɨ bu tî lè tì.
verses.niv: And if he finds it, I tell you the truth, he is happier about that one sheep than about the ninety-nine that did not wander off.

verses.kom: Yi ti n-ghɨ kɨmɨ ighel ta Bò vzɨ iyvɨ nɨn kôŋ wi na nô fɨ̀foyn fɨ̀ mò’ antêynɨ̀ nɨ̀ woyn ghɨ telâ ghèyn le.»
verses.niv: In the same way your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should be lost.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ fi bè na, «Wayn-nà vâ kæ sɨ ni mbɨ sɨ̂ và, wa ndù ɨ yeyn ŋweyn ɨ fè’tɨ̀ ìwo zɨ̀ a wù bèbsɨ. Wà se sɨ fè’tɨ̀, wa taŋi kɨ zɨ̂ ŋweyn, ghɨ̀ bò. Wù kæ yvɨtɨ, a à na ghɨ ma wà ye’i meyn ŋweyn.
verses.niv: “If your brother sins against you, go and show him his fault, just between the two of you. If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.

verses.kom: Wà ndû tàŋi, wù faŋ tɨ̀ yvɨ, wa kasi ndù ɨ lì wayn-nì ɨ̂ lvì kèsa ghɨ̀ bò, zɨ̂ àŋena ndu ɨ̀ tàŋi sɨ̂ ŋweyn ta ka àŋena ndu ɨ̀ tìmi ta nchwò nsa’ sɨ iwo nâ ghè kɨ̀ ighel ta Ŋwà’lɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì bè meyn na, ‹À na ghɨ mɨ a nsa’ ì kà, nchwò nsa’ nà ghɨ ghelɨ ghɨ̀ bò kèsa ghɨ̀ tal.›
verses.niv: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that ‘every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’

verses.kom: Yi ndû ɨ̀ chɨ̀yntɨ̀ tàŋi sɨ̂ ŋweyn, wù fî teyn kɨ̀ teyn na yi n-yvɨtɨ̂ wì, wa lì ɨ ndù nɨ̀ ìwo ateyn i sɨ̂ nchɨ̀yntɨ̂ ghelɨ ghɨ bɨminɨ. Wù kæ̂ fì ndù chèm afu ɨ̀ teyn kɨ̀ teyn na yi n-yvɨtɨ̂ wì iwo zɨ̀ a nchɨ̀yntɨ nɨn bê, wa lèm na wù sɨ ghɨ kɨ sɨ̂ và tèyn ta wul vzɨ̀ a wù bû tìmî bɨ̀mi Fɨ̀yìnì. Wà kà’ a wà lem na wù sɨ ghɨ kɨmɨ tèyn ta wul vzɨ̀ a wù n-teyn tâks.
verses.niv: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church; and if he refuses to listen even to the church, treat him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.

verses.kom: «Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na, yì bɨ̀mi nô mɨ ghà a nse kèsa yi tuynsɨ̂ tùynsɨ, a Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ jemtɨ sɨ iyvɨ.
verses.niv: “I tell you the truth, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.

verses.kom: «Ma fî bê kfeynsɨ̂ sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na, yì kæ sɨ nà ghɨ ghɨ̀ bò a nse afêyn ɨ̀ jèm ɨ̀ bɨf nô mɨ ghà ɨchfɨ̂ ɨ̀ mò’, a Bò wom iyvɨ ni sɨ̂ zɨ̀.
verses.niv: “Again, I tell you that if two of you on earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by my Father in heaven.

verses.kom: Bòm ta ghelɨ dù’ì nô mɨ wo sɨ chem ghɨ̀ bò kèsa ghɨ̀ tal a ma izɨyn, a mà na ghɨ ghes àŋena.»
verses.niv: For where two or three come together in my name, there am I with them.”

verses.kom: Bità ɨ fvɨ gvì ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ Jisòs na, «Bôbo, wayn-nà wom ti kæ sɨ nà nî kɨ ni mbɨ sɨ̂ mà, ma lèsɨ fu ŋweyn aghayn à sè’ a? A mà ti kà’ a mà lesɨ̂ fu ŋweyn aghayn nsòmbo a?»
verses.niv: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, “Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother when he sins against me? Up to seven times?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ kæ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Ngaŋ, à n-ghɨ wi kɨ aghayn nsòmbo. Wà n-kelɨ sɨ lèsɨ̀ sɨ fu ŋweyn aghayn mɨvɨ̂m nsòmbo njvàsɨ̀ nsòmbo.
verses.niv: Jesus answered, “I tell you, not seven times, but seventy-seven times.

verses.kom: Yi ti n-dyêyn na Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ nɨn sa’ kɨmɨ ta fòyn ɨ̂ lvì a wu n-læ nà kɨŋ sɨ faytɨ sɨ yeyn nâ ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ nɨ̀ ŋweyn nɨn kelɨ ti ɨkwo sɨ la’ sɨ̂ ŋweyn a.
verses.niv: “Therefore, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

verses.kom: A nà sɨ ghɨ ta wù zɨ̀tɨ̀, ghɨ gvì nɨ̀ wùl ɨ̀ fèlɨnɨ ɨ̀ lvì sɨ̂ ŋweyn, wu kelɨ ɨ̀kwo sɨ là’, ghɨ taŋ lê ɨ̀tu.
verses.niv: As he began the settlement, a man who owed him ten thousand talents was brought to him.

verses.kom: Fòyn nâ vzɨ̀ ɨ bè na, ghɨ bey’lɨ ŋweyn nɨ̀ wi ŋweyn nɨ̀ woyn ŋweyn sɨ ɨkòs ba’sɨ̂ nô mɨ nɨ̀ ghà ta wù n-kelɨ ɨ̀ lì ɨ̀kwo ateyn ɨ̀ là’ zɨ̀ bòm ta wu nà n-kelɨ wi ɨkwo sɨ là’.
verses.niv: Since he was not able to pay, the master ordered that he and his wife and his children and all that he had be sold to repay the debt.

verses.kom: Wùl ɨ̀ fèlɨnɨ àteyn ɨ tɨm alvɨ a ŋweyn asɨ ɨ nà sɨ chwotɨ̂ ŋweyn bê na, ‹Kul atem kɨ̀ sɨ a fɨ̂lè’nɨ̀ tèyn, a ka mà kasi là’ nô mɨ ghà sɨ̂ và.›
verses.niv: “The servant fell on his knees before him. ‘Be patient with me,’ he begged, ‘and I will pay back everything.’

verses.kom: Fòyn nâ vzɨ̀ ɨ koynsɨ ìsuyn sɨ̂ ŋweyn ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na wu n-bu fì lâ’ wì ɨkwo ateyn, ɨ visi wu lù.
verses.niv: The servant's master took pity on him, canceled the debt and let him go.

verses.kom: «Ta wù lù tî, ɨ se sɨ ndù ɨ boŋ yeyn wul ɨ̀ lvì ta ŋêyn àŋena nà n-felɨ̀, wu kelɨ kɨ fɨ̀kwôtɨ̀ tèyn sɨ la’ sɨ̂ ŋweyn. Wu ghalɨ kɨ ŋweyn isè’ ɨ bè na wù la’ ɨkwo ɨ̀ vzɨ.
verses.niv: “But when that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii. He grabbed him and began to choke him. ‘Pay back what you owe me!’ he demanded.

verses.kom: Wùl àteyn tɨm alvɨ a nse, ɨ nà sɨ bê na, ‹Kul atem kɨ̀ sɨ a fɨ̂lè’nɨ̀ tèyn, a ka mà kasi là’ và.›
verses.niv: “His fellow servant fell to his knees and begged him, ‘Be patient with me, and I will pay you back.’

verses.kom: Wu tuynsɨ kɨ tuynsɨ ɨ nì, ghɨ kwo ghal ŋweyn ɨ fò ɨ bè na wù faŋ kɨ̀ afu sɨ chem ta ka wù la’ ɨkwo ateyn.
verses.niv: “But he refused. Instead, he went off and had the man thrown into prison until he could pay the debt.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ghɨ li ta ŋêyn àŋena nà n-fêl amo’ ɨ yeyn iwo ateyn ɨ nà saŋlɨ̂ wì nô sakos ɨ kasi ndù ɨ fè’tɨ̀ sɨ̂ fòyn vzɨ̀ a àŋena nà n-felɨ̀ sɨ̂ ŋweyn tì.
verses.niv: When the other servants saw what had happened, they were greatly distressed and went and told their master everything that had happened.

verses.kom: Wu jàŋ wul ɨ̀ fèlɨnɨ vzɨ̀ a ndo ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, ‹Wà n-ghɨ kɨ nô wul ɨ̀ fèlɨnɨ ɨ bɨ! Wà ti meyn chwòtɨ ma, ma visi ndù nɨ̀ ɨ̀kwo vzɨ̀ a wà tî nà kelɨ sɨ la’ sɨ̂ mà.
verses.niv: “Then the master called the servant in. ‘You wicked servant,’ he said, ‘I canceled all that debt of yours because you begged me to.

verses.kom: A tî gàyn ghà na ka wà boŋ kòynsɨ ìsuyn sɨ̂ wùl ɨ̀ wèyn a zɨ̂ àŋena nɨn fêl amo’ têyn kɨ̀mɨ ta mà tî kòynsɨ isuyn sɨ̂ và a?›
verses.niv: Shouldn't you have had mercy on your fellow servant just as I had on you?’

verses.kom: Ɨtoŋ ɨ fòyn nâ vzɨ̀ ɨ yaf, wu lì ɨ fu ŋweyn sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ nà n-fô ghelɨ na ghɨ fo ŋweyn fì lèŋ ŋweyn sɨ ya’i ta ka wù kasî là’ nô mɨ ghà ta wu nà n-kelɨ sɨ là’.»
verses.niv: In anger his master turned him over to the jailers to be tortured, until he should pay back all he owed.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ mò ɨ mèsì ngàyn nâ yèyn ɨ kæ bè na, «À ti ta Bò wom iyvɨ nɨn læò nî nô mɨ sɨ ndà a yi antêynɨ̀ ɨlvɨ ta wù faŋ tɨ̀ lèsɨ̀ tɨ̀ fu wayn-nà ŋweyn a ŋweyn item.»
verses.niv: “This is how my heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother from your heart.”

verses.kom: A nà sɨ ghɨ ta Jisòs tàŋi mèsì àwo nâ kèynà, wu lù sɨ a Galìlî ɨ dyàŋ ɨ ndù abàs a Jùdiyà, injɨyn i jvâ Jodàn.
verses.niv: When Jesus had finished saying these things, he left Galilee and went into the region of Judea to the other side of the Jordan.

verses.kom: Inôyn i ghêl ì ɨ nà sɨ jûmtɨ̀ ŋweyn, dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn; wu chu’ ɨghî a ghɨ nà n-ko’i antêynɨ̀ nɨ̀ àŋena.
verses.niv: Large crowds followed him, and he healed them there.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ Falàsî ghɨ li ɨ gvì sɨ yvɨtɨ ɨchfɨ ŋweyn ɨ kæ bɨf na, «Nô ìwo i li nɨn ghɨ a ghesɨ̀nà Isa’ a yi n-bê na wùl ɨ̀ kà’ a wù saŋ wî ŋweyn sɨ ateyn a?»
verses.niv: Some Pharisees came to him to test him. They asked, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any and every reason?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Ba yi jaŋ meyn ɨ̀ yvɨ a Ŋwà’lɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì na, a nà n-ghɨ a nzɨ̀tɨ̂ mbzɨ, Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ faytɨ wul ɨ lûmnɨ̀ nɨ̀ wul ɨ wi a?
verses.niv: “Haven't you read,” he replied, “that at the beginning the Creator ‘made them male and female,’

verses.kom: Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ nɨn læ faytɨ tî ɨ kæ bè na, ‹Bòm tèyn, wul ɨ lûmnɨ̀ læò nà lû sɨ a ngùŋ nɨ̀ bò ŋweyn nɨ̀ nà ŋweyn, wu ndù ɨ chɨ̀yntɨ̀ ŋêyn wî ŋweyn, àŋena ghɨ̀ bò ɨ nà sɨ kasî ghɨ kɨ sɨ afo à mò’,›
verses.niv: and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh’?

verses.kom: wùl ɨ bu fì kelɨ wi iwo i ngeŋ nɨ̀ ŋweyn. Yi ti n-dyêyn na Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ ɨ kul nô mɨ ghà, ka wùl nɨ̂n fì yàs.»
verses.niv: So they are no longer two, but one. Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”

verses.kom: Àŋena bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Yi ti n-ghɨ tèyn ta wà bè, Mosìs ɨ fi bè na wul ɨ lûmnɨ̀ se sɨ saŋ wî ŋweyn, wu nyà’ ŋwà’lɨ̀ ɨ fu sɨ̂ ŋweyn, yi dyêyn na wù saŋ meyn ŋweyn bòm ghà?»
verses.niv: “Why then,” they asked, “did Moses command that a man give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Mosìs nɨn læ bɨmi na yì kà’ a yì na sâŋ ghɨ̀kì ɨ ghi bòm ta yi n-chɨli gha’ sɨ yvɨ iwo. À n-bu nà ghɨ ìlêm i Fɨ̂yìnì sɨ a nzɨ̀tɨ.
verses.niv: Jesus replied, “Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because your hearts were hard. But it was not this way from the beginning.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na, à kæ saŋ mɨ ndà wî ŋweyn, a bu kɨ na wùl ɨ wi àteyn nɨn jelɨ̀ jelɨ, fì ndù ɨ̀lvì, a à na ghɨ ma wù kolɨ meyn ìsa’ i malâ.»
verses.niv: I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for marital unfaithfulness, and marries another woman commits adultery.”

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Iyeyn nâ yèynì kæ sɨ nà ghɨ nchînɨ̀ zɨ̀ a wul ɨ lûmnɨ̀ nɨ̀n kelɨ sɨ nà chî ŋêyn wi, a yi na jôf kɨ na wùl ɨ̀ faŋ ndù sɨ a kœò.»
verses.niv: The disciples said to him, “If this is the situation between a husband and wife, it is better not to marry.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «À n-ghɨ wi ghelɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m a ghɨ kà’ a ghɨ chi têyn ta iye’i nâ yèynì nɨn dyêyn, à kà’ a à chi kɨ̀ ghelɨ ghì a Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ fù meyn àdya’ na àŋena na chî a dzɨ nâ ghàyn.
verses.niv: Jesus replied, “Not everyone can accept this word, but only those to whom it has been given.

verses.kom: Bòm ta awo a nɨn dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn a kɨ kà’ a kɨ ni, a wùl ɨ̀ faŋ sɨ a kœò. Ghɨli nɨn nî ghɨ faŋ tɨ̀ màla ma ghɨ bzɨ kɨ̀ tî, ghɨli ghɨ ma à nì ghelɨ, àŋena faŋ sɨ a kœòsɨ̀, ghɨli ghɨ ma ghɨ lè’ malâ bòm ɨ̀foyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì. À na ghɨ ma à kà’ a à bɨmi mɨ ndà sɨ chi ta iye’i ì yemi nâ yèynì nɨn bê, wu nà tô’ ɨ yvɨtɨ-à.»
verses.niv: For some are eunuchs because they were born that way; others were made that way by men; and others have renounced marriage because of the kingdom of heaven. The one who can accept this should accept it.”

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ghɨ li ɨ li gvì nɨ̀ woynda ghɨ telâ ta ka Jisòs lem ɨwu ɨ ŋweyn a àŋena ɨtu ɨ̀ jèm sɨ̂ àŋena, mɨtì njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ nà sɨ yôl sɨ̂ ghelɨ ateyn.
verses.niv: Then little children were brought to Jesus for him to place his hands on them and pray for them. But the disciples rebuked those who brought them.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ na, «Yì visi woynda, àŋena gvi sɨ̂ mà. Ka yì fî tàmtɨ̀ àŋena bòm ta ɨfoyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì nɨn kelɨ ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-ghɨ têyn ta àŋena.»
verses.niv: Jesus said, “Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.”

verses.kom: Wu taŋi tì ɨ lèm ɨ̀wu ɨ ŋweyn a àŋena ɨtu ɨ boysɨ àŋena ɨ lù sɨ afu ɨ nà sɨ jêl ndu-à.
verses.niv: When he had placed his hands on them, he went on from there.

verses.kom: Wùl ɨ̀ lvì nɨn læ meyn gvì ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ Jisòs na, «Ndyèynsɨ̀, mà ti kà’ a mà ni nô ghà ɨ̂ jùŋ sɨ læò sɨ keli ichi zɨ̀ a yi læò mæ wi a?»
verses.niv: Now a man came up to Jesus and asked, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to get eternal life?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Bòm ghà ta wà bɨf iwo i juŋì zɨ̀ a wà kà’ a wà ni sɨ̂ mà a? À n-jôf kfeynɨ̂ kɨ Fɨ̀yìnì. Wà na kôŋ sɨ keli ichi nâ zɨ̀-ì, wa nà yvɨ ìwo zɨ̀ a tɨsa’ tɨ Fɨ̂yìnìtɨ̀ nɨn bê.»
verses.niv: “Why do you ask me about what is good?” Jesus replied. “There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, obey the commandments.”

verses.kom: Wùl àteyn ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ Jisòs na, «Wà n-bê nô tɨ̀sa’ tɨ̀ kà?» Wu bè na, «Mɨ n-bê ɨtîtɨ̀ a tɨ n-bê na, ka wùl nɨ̂n zue, ka wùl nɨ̂n chi nɨ̀ wî wùl kèsa ŋêyn lûm wùl, ka wùl nɨ̂n choŋ, ka wùl nɨ̂n tìmi nchwò nsa’ ànkaŋ,
verses.niv: “Which ones?” the man inquired. Jesus replied, “ ‘Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not give false testimony,

verses.kom: ngvɨmlɨ bò vâ nɨ̀ nà vâ, kòŋ wayn-nà vâ kɨ̀ ighel ta wà n-kôŋ ngêŋ zyâ.»
verses.niv: honor your father and mother,’ and ‘love your neighbor as yourself.’ ”

verses.kom: Wayndà ɨ̀kùŋ nâ vzɨ̀ ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Ma lem meyn tɨ̀sa’ nâ tèyntɨ̀ nô tɨ̀ jɨ̀m. À fì faŋ gha ɨ̀lvì ta ka mà ni-a?»
verses.niv: “All these I have kept,” the young man said. “What do I still lack?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Wà na kôŋ sɨ nà jôf kfeynɨ̂ asɨ nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀, wa ndù ɨ bey’lɨ ɨ̀fwo ɨ̀ va nô ɨ̀ jɨ̀m ɨ fu ɨkwo ateyn sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghɨ fɨfâ, a ka wà keli igha’ iyvɨ. Wà nî tèyn, wa gvì ɨ jùmtɨ̀ mà.»
verses.niv: Jesus answered, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.”

verses.kom: Wayndà ɨ̀kùŋ nâ vzɨ̀ ɨ yvɨ iwo nâ zɨ̀-ì ɨ lù, saŋlɨ̂ wì bòm ta wu nà n-kelɨ igha’, yi dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn.
verses.niv: When the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he had great wealth.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ na, «Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na, yi n-to ta ka wùl ɨ gha’nɨ zɨ alè’ ɨfoyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì.
verses.niv: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “I tell you the truth, it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-fì fê’tɨ̀ ìwo sɨ̂ zɨ̀. Yi n-boynɨ̂ sɨ̂ nyàm kfaŋsɨ toynɨ abù’ a nsa’ chwô ta ka wul ɨ gha’nɨ zɨ alè’ ɨfoyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì.»
verses.niv: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ yvɨ iwo nâ yèynì, ɨchfɨ̂ ɨ yum àŋena. Àŋena bɨf na, «Yi ti n-ghɨ tî, a læ bœò nô ndà?»
verses.niv: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, “Who then can be saved?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ ki àŋena têyn ɨ kæ bè na, «Iwo nâ yèynì kà’ a yi to ɨ̀ gha’ kɨ̀ wul, mɨtì awo à jɨ̀mà ɨ boynɨ̂ kɨ tèyn sɨ̂ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀.»
verses.niv: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

verses.kom: Bità ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ Jisòs nâ, ba wù yeyn meyn ta àŋena vìsi nô mɨ gha àŋena ɨ̀ nà sɨ jûmtɨ̀ kɨ ŋweyn a, nâ àŋena læò kelî ghà a.
verses.niv: Peter answered him, “We have left everything to follow you! What then will there be for us?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na, a læò nà ghɨ a mbzɨ i fɨ, ɨtu’ ɨ têyn ta Wâyn Wùl ɨ̀ dù’ì meyn achɨ a tɨ̂fòyn nɨ̀ ŋweyn antêynɨ̀ ìgha’ ghè a wù n-kelɨ, a zɨ̀ ghî a yì tî nà jûmtɨ̀ mà boŋ dù’ì a mɨchɨ mɨ̀ tɨ̀fòyn njvàsɨ̀ bò nà sa’ àsas a ndosɨ nɨ̀ Isìlæò kèyn, njvàsɨ̀ bò.
verses.niv: Jesus said to them, “I tell you the truth, at the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on his glorious throne, you who have followed me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.kom: Nô mɨ ndà vzɨ̂ a wù vìsi meyn àbe a ŋweyn, kèsa woyn-ghɨ̂nì kèsa jêmtɨ̀sɨ ŋweyn, kèsa bò ŋweyn kèsa nà ŋweyn, kèsa woyn ŋweyn kèsa gveynsɨ ŋweyn bòm mà, læò kasî kelî ghelɨ nâ ghèyn nɨ̀ ɨ̀fwo nâ wèyn ìngal ɨvɨ ɨ̀ fì kèli ìchi zɨ̀ a yi læò mæ wi.
verses.niv: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or children or fields for my sake will receive a hundred times as much and will inherit eternal life.

verses.kom: Ndvɨ̀ ghèl nɨ̀n ghɨ lvɨ̂yn, ghɨ asɨ, mɨtì ghɨ sɨ læò sɨ nà ghɨ ibàm, na ndvɨ̀ ghèl ta yì n-ghɨ ibàm na ghɨ asɨ.»
verses.niv: But many who are first will be last, and many who are last will be first.

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨ̂n fi meyn kfeynsɨ ìye’i i ŋweyn ɨ bè na, «Ɨfôyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì nɨn ghɨ kɨmɨ ta fɨ̀tɨtɨ̂ fɨ bò gvèyn ɨ̂ lvì a wù n-læ bɨs ɨ fvɨ̀ sɨ ndù sɨ kini ghelɨ na ghɨ se’ ifêl a ŋweyn a gvêyn mɨ̀tàm,
verses.niv: “For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire men to work in his vineyard.

verses.kom: ɨ kini tì ɨ yeyn ɨ tisɨ ŋêyn àŋena na yi n-lâ’ kɨ àŋena nɨ̀ ɨ̀kwo vzɨ̀ a ghɨ n-lâ’ ifêl achi ateyn, ɨ kæ tsɨynsɨ na àŋena se’ ifêl.
verses.niv: He agreed to pay them a denarius for the day and sent them into his vineyard.

verses.kom: Chùe ɨ bayntɨ gvi kɨ têyn, wu se sɨ fvɨ̀ sɨ ndù ɨchfɨ̀ afàf ɨ yeyn ghelɨ ghɨ li ghɨ ti afu, nî wì iwo.
verses.niv: “About the third hour he went out and saw others standing in the marketplace doing nothing.

verses.kom: Wu bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, ‹Yì boŋ se’ ndù nà fêl a ma gvêyn a ka yì nî se sɨ kfa, a mà la’ zɨ nô mɨ nɨ̀ ghà vzɨ̂ a kɨ n-kfeynɨ.›
verses.niv: He told them, ‘You also go and work in my vineyard, and I will pay you whatever is right.’

verses.kom: Wu bè tì, àŋena se’, chùe ɨ ni bayn to, wu fi fvɨ ndù ɨ yeyn ghelɨ ghɨ li ɨ fi be kɨ tî. A ni nà ghɨ aleŋ ɨlvɨ ɨ nfam, wu fi fvɨ̀ ɨ ndù ɨ yeyn ghelɨ ghɨ li ɨ fi be kɨ tî.
verses.niv: So they went. “He went out again about the sixth hour and the ninth hour and did the same thing.

verses.kom: A ni nà ghɨ aleŋ a mbol àbè, wu fi fvɨ̀ ɨ ndù afàf nâ ghè ɨ fi yeyn ghelɨ ghɨ li, ghɨ ti kɨ afu salû, wu bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, ‹Bòm ghà ta yì yìsi tìmi afêyn sɨ achi a fɨ̂blɨ̀-à, nî wì iwo a?›
verses.niv: About the eleventh hour he went out and found still others standing around. He asked them, ‘Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?’

verses.kom: Àŋena bè na, ‹À n-ghɨ bòm ta wùl ɨ̀ bû nì lì ghès sɨ ifèl.› Wu bè sɨ̂ àŋena na àŋena boŋ se’ ɨ̀ nà fêl a ŋweyn a gvêyn mɨ̀tàm afî.
verses.niv: “ ‘Because no one has hired us,’ they answered. “He said to them, ‘You also go and work in my vineyard.’

verses.kom: «A ni nà ghɨ aleŋ ɨlvɨ ikfa, bò gvèyn àteyn ɨ bè sɨ̂ àtu a ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ nɨ̀ ŋweyna na, ‹Jàŋ ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ ɨ là’ àŋena. Wà se sɨ là’, wa zɨ̀tɨ̀ nɨ ɨghî a mà nì lì gò’sɨ̀ ifèl, ɨ là’ ɨ ndu mèsi nɨ ɨghî a mà nì lì sɨ asɨ.›
verses.niv: “When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his foreman, ‘Call the workers and pay them their wages, beginning with the last ones hired and going on to the first.’

verses.kom: Nô mɨ ndà vzɨ̂ a ghɨ nì lì ifèl sɨ ibàm ɨ nà lî ɨ̀kwo ifèl achi.
verses.niv: “The workers who were hired about the eleventh hour came and each received a denarius.

verses.kom: Ɨghî a ghɨ nì lì ifêl sɨ asɨ ɨ gvì ɨ nà sɨ lêm kɨ na àŋena nɨn kelî ɨ̀kwo, wu dvɨ̂ chwô ɨ̀kwo ifèl achi.
verses.niv: So when those came who were hired first, they expected to receive more. But each one of them also received a denarius.

verses.kom: Ghɨ fu kɨ ɨkwo achi, àŋena nà sɨ dɨ̂mlɨ̀-à, ghâm bò gvèyn nâ vzɨ̀
verses.niv: When they received it, they began to grumble against the landowner.

verses.kom: bê na, ‹Ghelɨ ghèyn a ghɨ gvì gò’sɨ̀ têyn nì ìfêl kɨ̀ sɨ a fɨlè’nɨ̀ fɨ ɨlvɨ têyn, wà lâ’ àŋena kɨ̀mɨ ta wà là’ ghès, ma ghès ɨ yisi meyn ɨ̀ chu’ kɨ̀ isas i chûe tèyn, ɨtu’ ɨ jɨ.›
verses.niv: ‘These men who were hired last worked only one hour,’ they said, ‘and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the work and the heat of the day.’

verses.kom: Bò gvèyn nâ vzɨ̀ ɨ bè sɨ̂ wùl ɨ̀ lvì a àŋena antêynɨ̀ na, ‹Yvɨtɨ a ba, ma bû choŋ vâ. Ba ghesɨ̀và nì fàytɨ na mɨ n-lâ’ và kɨ nɨ̀ ɨ̀kwo achi?
verses.niv: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am not being unfair to you. Didn't you agree to work for a denarius?

verses.kom: Li ɨkwo ɨ̀ va, wa kfâ. À kòŋ mà sɨ là’ ɨ wul vzɨ̀ a mà nì lì gò’sɨ̀ kɨ̀mɨ ta mà là’ ɨ̀ vâ.
verses.niv: Take your pay and go. I want to give the man who was hired last the same as I gave you.

verses.kom: Ba yi ti n-ghɨ na mɨ n-kelɨ wi adya’ sɨ nì iwo zɨ̀ a mɨ n-kôŋ nɨ̀ ɨ̀kwo ɨ̀ wom ma? Mɨ n-kya na wà gvì nɨ̀ ànghè’ kèynà kɨ bòm ta mà fu ɨkwo sɨ̂ ghelɨ a dzɨ ghê a mɨ n-kôŋ ateyn.›»
verses.niv: Don't I have the right to do what I want with my own money? Or are you envious because I am generous?’

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ fè’tɨ̀ tèyn ɨ kæ bè na, «Ndvɨ̀ ghèl nɨ̀n ghɨ lvɨ̂yn, ghelɨ yeyn kɨ na àŋena nɨn ko’nɨ̂ kfeynɨ-à, àŋena ghɨ wi sɨ læò sɨ nà kfeyn iwo i li asɨ nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀. Ɨghî a ghelɨ nɨn yeyn na ghɨ n-kfeynɨ̂ wì iwo lvɨ̂yn ɨ ghɨ sɨ læò sɨ nà ko’nɨ̂ kfeynɨ-à asɨ nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀.»
verses.niv: “So the last will be first, and the first will be last.”

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨn læ meyn se sɨ ko’ a Jèlusalèm ɨ lì njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweyn njvàsɨ̀ bò ɨ nà sɨ nya’ taŋî sɨ̂ àŋena bê na,
verses.niv: Now as Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside and said to them,

verses.kom: «Yì na kya na ghesɨ̀nà nɨn ko’ ndû a Jèlusalèm lvɨ̂yn tèyn, ghɨ kelɨ sɨ ndù sɨ fu Wâyn Wùl sɨ̂ ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì sɨ gha’nɨsɨ nɨ̀ ndyèynsɨ̀ sɨ isa’sɨ na àŋena chwosɨ sɨ isa’ na wù n-kelɨ sɨ kfɨ.
verses.niv: “We are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be betrayed to the chief priests and the teachers of the law. They will condemn him to death

verses.kom: A ghɨ be tî ɨ̀ lì fu ŋweyn sɨ̂ ɨ̀tum na ghɨ lu’sɨ ŋweyn ɨ̀ lèŋ ŋweyn nɨ̀ ngvàlìsɨ̀, fì bàyntɨ ŋweyn a ànwâmnɨ̀. A à na ghɨ a mɨchi ɨ̀n tal, a ghɨ laysɨ ŋweyn sɨ ikfɨ.»
verses.niv: and will turn him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified. On the third day he will be raised to life!”

verses.kom: Wî Zebedì nɨ̂n gvi meyn sɨ̂ Jisòs nɨ̀ woyn ŋweyn, ghɨ̀ bò ɨ tɨm alvɨ asɨ nɨ̀ ŋweyn ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, wù ni iwo sɨ̂ zɨ̀.
verses.niv: Then the mother of Zebedee's sons came to Jesus with her sons and, kneeling down, asked a favor of him.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn nâ, wù n-kɨŋ na yì ni gha sɨ̂ ŋweyn a? Wu bè na, «Bɨmi na, à læò nà ghɨ ɨtu’ ta wà sɨ sa’ ɨfôyn ɨ̀ va, a wôyn ghem ghèyn, ghɨ̀ bò na du’ a wa ngùŋ, ɨ̀mò’ ɨ du’ a wa ɨkœ ɨ two, ɨ̀lvì ɨ du’ ɨkœ nɨ̂nkœò.»
verses.niv: “What is it you want?” he asked. She said, “Grant that one of these two sons of mine may sit at your right and the other at your left in your kingdom.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yi n-kya wi iwo zɨ̀ a yi n-bê,» ɨ fi kæ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «A yì ti kà’ a yì yeyn nge’ zɨ̀ a mɨ n-ghɨ sɨ yeyn a?» Àŋena bɨmi.
verses.niv: “You don't know what you are asking,” Jesus said to them. “Can you drink the cup I am going to drink?” “We can,” they answered.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Samo’, yi nì yeyn nge’ zɨ̀ a mɨ n-ghɨ sɨ yeyn, mɨtì a ghɨ wi alê’ à kema sɨ bè na wùl ɨ̀ du’i a ma ɨkœ ɨ two kèsa a ma ɨkœ nɨ̂nkœò. Ɨlwê’ ateyn nɨn ghɨ, a kelɨ ghelɨ ghì a Bò wom tî fàytɨ lèm sɨ̂ àŋena.»
verses.niv: Jesus said to them, “You will indeed drink from my cup, but to sit at my right or left is not for me to grant. These places belong to those for whom they have been prepared by my Father.”

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweyn sɨ lisɨ ìvɨm ɨ yvɨ iwo ateyn ɨ nà sɨ nyô’sɨ̀ ɨ̀toŋ sɨ̂ woyn-ghɨ̂nì nâ ghì, ghɨ̀ bò.
verses.niv: When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ yvɨ̀ŋtɨ̀ àŋena ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yi n-kya na tɨfôyn tɨ mbzɨtɨ nɨn kelɨ àdya’, sa’ ye’tɨ̂ yè’tɨ ghelɨ àŋena.
verses.niv: Jesus called them together and said, “You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.

verses.kom: Mɨtì, yi kelɨ wi sɨ nà ghɨ tî sɨ̂ zɨ̀. Nô mɨ ndà vzɨ̂ a wù n-kɨŋ sɨ nà ghɨ wul ɨ ngaŋtɨnɨ a yi antêynɨ̀ nɨ̀n kelɨ sɨ nà ghɨ wul ɨ̀ fèlɨnɨ sɨ̂ zɨ̀,
verses.niv: Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,

verses.kom: na nô mɨ ndà vzɨ̂ a wù n-ghɨ sɨ nà ghɨ wul ɨ tisɨnɨ a yi antêynɨ̀ na kwo ghɨ àkôs sɨ̂ zɨ̀.
verses.niv: and whoever wants to be first must be your slave–

verses.kom: Yi ti n-ghɨ kɨmɨ ighel ta Wâyn Wùl bu tî gvì na ghɨ na fêl sɨ̂ ŋweyn. Wù tî gvì sɨ nà fel sɨ̂ ghelɨ, sɨ fì sɨ fu ngêŋ ŋweyn sɨ kfɨ sɨ yuyn atu a ndvɨ̀ ghèl.»
verses.niv: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ŋêyn njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ nɨn læ meyn se sɨ lu sɨ a nte’ Jèlikò, ghelɨ ndù a ŋweyn ibàm, dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn,
verses.niv: As Jesus and his disciples were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed him.

verses.kom: ɨ se sɨ ndù ghelɨ ghɨ fefɨnɨ ghɨ li ghɨ̀ bò ɨ du’ a mbæò dzɨ̀. Àŋena yvɨ na à n-chwô Jisòs ɨ byal ɨ bè na, «Koynsɨ isuyn sɨ̂ ghès a Wâyn Fòyn Devìt!»
verses.niv: Two blind men were sitting by the roadside, and when they heard that Jesus was going by, they shouted, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”

verses.kom: Anôyn a ghêl kì ɨ nà sɨ chɨ̂ylɨ̀ àŋena bê na àŋena chimi moŋ, mɨtì àŋena nà tô’ ɨ̀ byaytɨ̂ ndû kɨ asɨ bê kɨ na, «Bôbo, Wâyn Fòyn Devìt, koynsɨ isuyn sɨ̂ ghès!»
verses.niv: The crowd rebuked them and told them to be quiet, but they shouted all the louder, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ timi ɨ jàŋtɨ̀ àŋena ɨ bɨf na, «Yi n-kɨŋ na mà ni gha sɨ̂ zɨ̀ a?»
verses.niv: Jesus stopped and called them. “What do you want me to do for you?” he asked.

verses.kom: Àŋena bè na, «Bôbo, ni ghès na yeyn ɨ̀lwê’.»
verses.niv: “Lord,” they answered, “we want our sight.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ koynsɨ ìsuyn sɨ̂ àŋena ɨ kùm àsɨ a àŋena. Nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, àŋena nà sɨ yeyn ɨ̀lwê’ ɨ lù ɨ nà sɨ jûmtɨ̀ ndû nɨ̀ ŋweyn.
verses.niv: Jesus had compassion on them and touched their eyes. Immediately they received their sight and followed him.

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨ̀n jelɨ meyn ŋêyn njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ ndu ba’sɨ a Jèlusalèm, ɨ ndu chem a ntè’ Betfàs a kfɨ̂yn Olìfsɨ̀ ɨ tum njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweyn sɨ̀ bò,
verses.niv: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples,

verses.kom: ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yì zɨ ndù antêynɨ̀ ntè’ afêyn a yi asɨ. Yi n-se sɨ zɨ sɨ ndu kɨ têyn ɨ̀ yeyn njàkâs ta ghɨ chfɨŋ nɨ̀ wàyn sɨ a ngùŋ àteyn. Yi yeyn, yi yàs ɨ gvì nɨ̀ nyeyn sɨ̂ mà, ba’sɨ̂ kɨ nɨ̀ wàyn.
verses.niv: saying to them, “Go to the village ahead of you, and at once you will find a donkey tied there, with her colt by her. Untie them and bring them to me.

verses.kom: Yi se sɨ yàs, à bɨf mɨ ndà iwo sɨ̂ zɨ̀ yi bè na, ‹Bôbo nɨn kelɨ ìwo sɨ ni nɨ̀ nseynsɨ,› ghɨ sɨ kasi sɨ tsɨynsɨ kɨ lvɨ̂yn.»
verses.niv: If anyone says anything to you, tell him that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away.”

verses.kom: Iwo nâ yèynì nɨn gayn kɨ têyn sɨ luynsɨ iwo zɨ̀ a Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ nɨn læ bè ɨ toynɨ a nfè’tɨ i gha’nɨ na:
verses.niv: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:

verses.kom: «Bè sɨ̂ ghelɨ nte’ Zayòn na, Yì yeyna, fòyn vzɨ weyn gvî sɨ̂ zɨ̀, boynɨ-à, wù n-gvî atû njàkâs, a ghɨ wâyn njàkâs.»
verses.niv: “Say to the Daughter of Zion, ‘See, your king comes to you, gentle and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.’ ”

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweyn nâ sìsɨ̀ nɨn læ meyn ndù ɨ ni kɨ ta wù bè,
verses.niv: The disciples went and did as Jesus had instructed them.

verses.kom: ɨ kasi gvì nɨ̀ njàkâs àteyn ba’sɨ̂ nɨ̀ wàyn ɨ zɨ̀sɨ̀ nɨ̀ ɨ̀waf ɨ àŋena, Jisòs ɨ ko’ dù’ì atu.
verses.niv: They brought the donkey and the colt, placed their cloaks on them, and Jesus sat on them.

verses.kom: Anôyn a ghêl à ɨ nà cho’tɨ̂ ɨ̀waf ɨ àŋena dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn, mâ’ a dzɨ wu dyâŋ atu. Ghɨli kôytɨ̀ tɨ̀fyas tɨ ɨnkà’, mâ’ a dzɨ.
verses.niv: A very large crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

verses.kom: Anôyn kì a kɨ nà n-ndû a ŋweyn asɨ nɨ akî a kɨ nà n-gvî ibàm ɨ zɨ̀tɨ̀ ɨ nà byal bê kɨ na, «Òsanà nɨ̀n ghɨ sɨ̂ Wâyn Fòyn Devìt! Iboysɨ i nɨn ghɨ sɨ ɨvzɨ̂ a wù n-gvî sɨ izɨyn nɨ̀ Bôbo! Òsanà nɨ̀n ghɨ sɨ̂ Fɨ̀yìnì fìfɨ̀ a fɨ n-ghɨ alè’ ghè a kɨ ngàŋtɨ meyn kfeyn!»
verses.niv: The crowds that went ahead of him and those that followed shouted, “Hosanna to the Son of David!”  “Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!”  “Hosanna in the highest!”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ ni zɨ mèsì sɨ a Jèlusalèm, yi nè’a kɨ ì jɨ̀m. Ghelɨ nà sɨ bɨf nâ, ɨweyn nâ wèyn nɨ̀n ghɨ nô ndà a.
verses.niv: When Jesus entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, “Who is this?”

verses.kom: Inôyn i ghêl zɨ̀-ì ɨ bèynsɨ kɨ na, «À n-ghɨ Jisòs ɨ nfè’tɨ i gha’nɨ zɨ̀ a yì lù a ntè’ Nazalèt ila’ i Galìlî.»
verses.niv: The crowds answered, “This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ ndu zɨ abe a ndô Fɨ̀yìnì i gha’nɨ ɨ nà sɨ sâŋ fvɨ̂sɨ̀ ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ nà n-nî mbêy’lɨ̀ afu nô ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m. Wu n-ba’lɨ meyn ɨ̀bwaŋ vzɨ̀ a ghelɨ nì nà kfɨnɨ̂ ɨ̀kwo atu àteyn, ɨ bà’lɨ̀ ɨ mà’ mɨ̀chɨ mzɨ̀ a ghelɨ nì dù’ì ateyn nà bey’lɨ̂ mɨ̀nlàynɨ̀,
verses.niv: Jesus entered the temple area and drove out all who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves.

verses.kom: ɨ bè sɨ̂ ghelɨ nâ ghì na, «Ghɨ nya’ meyn a Ŋwà’lɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì na, ‹Ghelɨ læò nà toŋtɨ̂ ndô yem na ndô ìjèm›; mɨtì yi kasi lvɨ̂yn sɨ alè’ nɨ̀ ghelɨ ghɨ choŋnɨ.»
verses.niv: “It is written,” he said to them, “ ‘My house will be called a house of prayer,’ but you are making it a ‘den of robbers.’ ”

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ghɨ fefɨnɨ nɨ̀ mɨ̀ngês ɨ nà gvî yeyn ŋweyn afu, wu chu’ àŋena.
verses.niv: The blind and the lame came to him at the temple, and he healed them.

verses.kom: Mɨtì, ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì sɨ gha’nɨsɨ nɨ̀ ndyèynsɨ̀ sɨ isa’sɨ ɨ nyò’sɨ̀ ɨ̀toŋ ta àŋena yeyn awo a kaynɨ-a kì a wu n-nî fì yvɨ ta woynda nɨn byaytɨ bê afu na, «Òsanà nɨn ghɨ sɨ̂ Wâyn Fòyn Devìt!»
verses.niv: But when the chief priests and the teachers of the law saw the wonderful things he did and the children shouting in the temple area, “Hosanna to the Son of David,” they were indignant.

verses.kom: Àŋena bɨf sɨ̂ Jisòs na, «Wà n-yvɨ ìwo zɨ̀ a woynda nɨn bê a?» Jisòs ɨ bɨmi ɨ kasi bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yi bû jàŋ àlê’ a Ŋwà’lɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì kì a ghɨ nyà’ ateyn tì na, ‹Wà ye’i meyn woynda na ghɨ na ko’sɨ̂ và kɨ̀ ta wà n-kɨŋ› â?»
verses.niv: “Do you hear what these children are saying?” they asked him. “Yes,” replied Jesus, “have you never read, “ ‘From the lips of children and infants you have ordained praise’?”

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨ̂n tàŋi tî ɨ lù sɨ afu ɨ fvɨ̀ sɨ a Jèlusalèm ɨ ndu chi a nte’ Betanì.
verses.niv: And he left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where he spent the night.

verses.kom: Ɨtu’ ɨ bɨs layn, wu nà kasî ndû a Jèlusalèm, jèŋ ɨ nà sɨ yafɨ ŋweyn.
verses.niv: Early in the morning, as he was on his way back to the city, he was hungry.

verses.kom: Wu yeyn fɨkâ’ fɨ fîksɨ̀ a dzɨ, ɨ zɨ ndù isas ateyn mɨtì ɨ faŋ tɨ̀ yeyn afo atû àteyn a bu kɨ tɨ̀fvɨ ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ fɨ̀kâ’ fɨ ateyn fɨ na, «Wà læò bu fì kolâ wì mɨtam!» Nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, fɨ yum kɨ yum.
verses.niv: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. Then he said to it, “May you never bear fruit again!” Immediately the tree withered.

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ yeyn iwo nâ yèynì ɨ nà ghɨ nɨ̀ ìkayn i ɨ kæ bɨf sɨ̂ Jisòs na, «Fɨkâ’ nâ fèynfɨ̀ jèl ti sɨ yum kɨ sɨ ɨlvɨ teyn a?»
verses.niv: When the disciples saw this, they were amazed. “How did the fig tree wither so quickly?” they asked.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bèynsɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na, yi nà n-ghɨ ma yi bɨmi meyn, kfâ’ wì kfa’, yi kâ’ a yì ni iwo zɨ̀ a mà nì sɨ̂ fɨ̀kâ’ fèynfɨ̀ ɨ̀ fì bè nô sɨ̂ kfɨyn ì gha’nɨ yèyn na, ‹Cho’a ɨ ndu chà’ a jvâ i gha’nɨ,› a yì ni kɨ̀ tî ta yì bè.
verses.niv: Jesus replied, “I tell you the truth, if you have faith and do not doubt, not only can you do what was done to the fig tree, but also you can say to this mountain, ‘Go, throw yourself into the sea,’ and it will be done.

verses.kom: Yì kæ sɨ nà jemà bɨf nô mɨ ghà sɨ̂ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀, a fɨ fu sɨ̂ zɨ̀ ɨlvɨ ta yì bɨ̀mi.»
verses.niv: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ kasi ɨ ndu zɨ a ndô Fɨ̀yìnì ɨ nà sɨ ye’î ghelɨ afu, ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì sɨ gha’nɨsɨ nɨ̀ chye’sɨ ila’sɨ ɨ gvì ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Wà n-nî àwo kèynà nɨ̀ àdya’ a ma kɨ lù wo? À fu nda adya’ nâ kèynà sɨ̂ và a?»
verses.niv: Jesus entered the temple courts, and, while he was teaching, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him. “By what authority are you doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave you this authority?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Mɨ n-boŋ bɨf ìwo sɨ̂ zɨ̀, yi kæ bèynsɨ̀, a mà kæ fè’tɨ wul ɨ vzɨ̀ sɨ̂ zɨ̀ a wù fu adya’ na mà na nî àwo nâ kèynà ateyn.
verses.niv: Jesus replied, “I will also ask you one question. If you answer me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.

verses.kom: Joyn nà n-fu mu ma wù lì wo adya’ a? A n-fu Fɨ̀yìnì adya’ sɨ̂ ŋweyn ma, à n-fù ghelɨ a?» Àŋena zɨ̀tɨ̀ sɨ nà gûmnɨ̀-à a àŋena antêynɨ̀ bê na, «Ghesɨ̀nà kæ bè na, ‹A n-fu Fɨ̀yìnì adya’ sɨ̂ ŋweyn,› a wù bɨf na, ‹Yi sæ faŋ tɨ̀ bɨ̀mi iwo zɨ̀ a wu nà n-bê bòm ghà?›,
verses.niv: John's baptism –where did it come from? Was it from heaven, or from men?” They discussed it among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask, ‘Then why didn't you believe him?’

verses.kom: ma ghesɨ̀nà kæ bè na, ‹A n-fu ghelɨ adya’ sɨ̂ ŋweyn,› ghelɨ kâ’ a ghɨ mom iwo sɨ̂ ghesɨ̀nà bòm ta àŋena ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m nà n-kfâ’ kɨ na Joyn nà n-ghɨ nfè’tɨ i gha’nɨ.»
verses.niv: But if we say, ‘From men’ –we are afraid of the people, for they all hold that John was a prophet.”

verses.kom: Àŋena kfà’tɨ̀ tì ɨ be kɨ sɨ̂ Jisòs na, «Ghès nɨn kya wi.» Jisòs ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Mâ mà ti n-boŋ fê’tɨ̀ wì alê’ kì a mà lì adya’ sɨ nà ni awo nâ kèynà ateyn.»
verses.niv: So they answered Jesus, “We don't know.” Then he said, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ fi bè sɨ̂ ghelɨ nâ ghì na, àŋena kfa’tɨ iwo kûm ngàyn ta wu nà n-kɨŋ sɨ mò ɨ kæ bè na, «Wùl ɨ̂ lvì nɨn læ meyn nà kelɨ woyn ghɨ lûmnɨ̀ nɨ̀ ŋweyn, ghɨ̀ bò ɨ ndù sɨ ɨwû àsɨ ɨ tum ŋweyn ɨ bè na, ‹Se’ fèl a gvêyn mɨ̀tàm layn a wayn wom.›
verses.niv: “What do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first and said, ‘Son, go and work today in the vineyard.’

verses.kom: Wayn àteyn ɨ be kɨ itim sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, ‹Mɨ n-se’ wi.› Mɨtì ɨ ni kasi kfà’tɨ kɨ sɨ a ŋweyn a ngeŋ na yi n-jôf na yì se’, ɨ se’.
verses.niv: “ ‘I will not,’ he answered, but later he changed his mind and went.

verses.kom: Bò ŋweyn ɨ fi ndù sɨ̂ ànkùmtɨ̀ a wayn nɨ̀ ŋweyna ɨ fi tum kɨmɨ ŋweyn tì ta wù nì tum ɨwû àsɨ ɨ nà tum gvî tèyn, wu bɨmi kɨ bɨmi, mɨtì ɨ faŋ tɨ̀ se’.»
verses.niv: “Then the father went to the other son and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I will, sir,’ but he did not go.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ taŋi tì ɨ kæ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «À ti n-læ ni wayn ɨ̀ kfà iwo zɨ̀ a bò ŋweyn nà n-kɨŋ a?» Àŋena bèynsɨ̀ na, «A n-ni ɨwû àsɨ.» Jisòs ɨ kæ bè na, «Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na, ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-teyn tâks ŋêyn ɨ̀kfàlà nɨn zɨ̂ alè’ ɨfoyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì sɨ a yi asɨ.
verses.niv: “Which of the two did what his father wanted?” “The first,” they answered. Jesus said to them, “I tell you the truth, the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God ahead of you.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê tèyn bòm ta Joyn Nfû Mù nɨn læ meyn gvì ɨ nà dyêyn dzɨ àtì-ati zɨ̀ a ka yì na jêl ateyn asɨ nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀, yi faŋ tɨ̀ bɨ̀mi. Mɨtì, ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-teyn tâks ŋêyn ɨ̀kfàlà ɨ bɨmi. Yi yeyn mèsi kɨ nô tèyn ɨ fi teyn kɨ teyn na yi n-bêynsɨ̀ wì mɨtêm mzɨ̂ sɨ bɨmi iwo zɨ̀ a Joyn Nfû Mù ɨ nà n-bê.»
verses.niv: For John came to you to show you the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes did. And even after you saw this, you did not repent and believe him.

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨ̀n fi meyn bè na ghelɨ ghì yvɨtɨ kfèynsɨ ngàyn yèyn na, «Bò gvèyn ɨ̂ lvì nɨn læ meyn dzɨ̀sì gvêyn mɨ̀tam mɨ̀ gɨ̀leb nɨ̀ ŋweyn ɨ tɨm ɨ jɨŋ kal nɨ̀ mbàyn, ɨ tɨm ibɨ zɨ̀ a ka ghɨ na nû’ mɨ̀tam ateyn faytɨ̂ mɨ̀lû’, ɨ fi tɨm abaŋ a nchì antêynɨ̀ gvèyn ɨ kæ fu gveyn àteyn na ghelɨ na felà, gwôtɨ̀ fu ŋweyn nɨ̀ ɨ̀fwo vzɨ̀ a wu n-fvɨ̂ ateyn. Wu fu tî ɨ lù ɨ ndù ìjêl ila’ i li.
verses.niv: “Listen to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it and built a watchtower. Then he rented the vineyard to some farmers and went away on a journey.

verses.kom: Ɨlvɨ ɨ kfinɨ ɨ læ kfeyn, wu tum ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ nɨ̀ ŋweyn ghɨ li na ghɨ ndu ɨ̀ bè sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghì a wù tî fù gveyn nâ zɨ̀ sɨ̂ àŋena na ghɨ fu ɨmɨ̂ ŋweyn mɨtam.
verses.niv: When the harvest time approached, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his fruit.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ nâ ghèyn ɨ ndu ghal ɨghî a wù tùm tî ɨ leŋ ɨ̀mò’, ɨ zue ànkùmtɨ̀, ɨ fi tɨmlɨ ɨ̀lvì nɨ̀ ngò’sɨ̀.
verses.niv: “The tenants seized his servants; they beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.

verses.kom: Bò gvèyn àteyn ɨ fi tum kfeynsɨ ghelɨ ghɨ li ghɨ dvɨ̂ chwô ɨghî a wù nì tum, ghelɨ ghì a gvêyn ɨ fi ni kɨ ta àŋena nì nì sɨ̂ ghɨli ghì.
verses.niv: Then he sent other servants to them, more than the first time, and the tenants treated them the same way.

verses.kom: Wu tum gò’sɨ̀ wayn lûmnɨ̀ nɨ̀ ŋweyn sɨ̂ àŋena, kfâ’ kɨ sɨ a ŋweyn a ngeŋ na, ‹Àŋena nɨn ndû fâyn wayn wom.›
verses.niv: Last of all, he sent his son to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.

verses.kom: Mɨtì, ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ nâ ghì ɨ ndu yeyn wâyn ŋweyn nâ vzɨ̀, ɨ kfà’tɨ̀ sɨ̂ àŋena ngeŋsɨ na, ‹Ɨwêyn nɨ̀n ghɨ kɨ nô yɨndo nɨ̀ bò gvèyn nâ wèyn tèyn. Ghesɨ̀nà ghal ɨ̀ zùe ŋweyn ɨ̀ kèli ɨ̀fwo vzɨ̀ a wù tî nà ghɨ sɨ læò sɨ keli.›
verses.niv: “But when the tenants saw the son, they said to each other, ‘This is the heir. Come, let's kill him and take his inheritance.’

verses.kom: Àŋena bè tì ɨ ghalɨ kɨ ghalɨ ŋweyn ɨ fvɨ̀ nɨ̀ ŋweyn sɨ a gvêyn afu ɨ ndu zue.»
verses.niv: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ kæ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yi ti gàyn têyn, bò gvèyn nâ wèyn kasi ɨ̀ gvì, a wù ni nô ghà sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ nâ ghì a?»
verses.niv: “Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants?”

verses.kom: Àŋena bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, yi gàyn têyn a bò gvèyn àteyn zuetɨ ghelɨ ghɨ bɨ nâ ghèyn ɨ̀ fu fvɨ̀sɨ̀ gveyn àteyn sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghɨlû, a àŋena na felà, fu ɨwu ŋweyn ɨfwo kɨ̀ nô ɨlvɨ.
verses.niv: “He will bring those wretches to a wretched end,” they replied, “and he will rent the vineyard to other tenants, who will give him his share of the crop at harvest time.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ kæ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yi ti n-ghɨ na yi bû tìmi ɨ̀ jàŋ yvɨ alê’ a Ŋwà’lɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì kèyn a kɨ n-bê têyn na: ‹Ngò’ zɨ̀ a ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ tî mà’ì kasi meyn sɨ a ngò’ ìbvɨ i ndo. À n-ghɨ ìfêl i Bô tèyn; iwo i lù wo a yi n-jôf têyn› a?»
verses.niv: Jesus said to them, “Have you never read in the Scriptures: “ ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the capstone; the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bɨf têyn ɨ fi kæ bè na, «Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na ghɨ læò fsɨ ɨ̀foyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì sɨ̂ zɨ̀ ɨ̀ fù sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghì a ka ghɨ na kolâ mɨ̀tam mɨ̀ àteyn ta Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ nɨn kɨŋ.
verses.niv: “Therefore I tell you that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruit.

verses.kom: [À ti dyàmtɨ mɨ ndà a ngò’ ìbvɨ i ndo nâ ghàyn, a wù fe tèyntɨ kɨ̀ a mɨ̂ntɨ̀mlɨ a mɨ̂ntɨ̀mlɨ, ma yì fe nô mɨ a ndà atu, a yì gvasɨ kɨ̀ gvasɨ ŋweyn.»]
verses.niv: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed.”

verses.kom: Ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì sɨ gha’nɨsɨ nɨ̀ ghelɨ Falàsî nɨn læ yvɨ ngàynsɨ Jisòs nâ sèynsɨ̀, ɨ keli kɨ keli na wù n-taŋî kûm àŋena,
verses.niv: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard Jesus' parables, they knew he was talking about them.

verses.kom: ɨ nà sɨ kɨŋ dzɨ sɨ ghal ŋweyn mɨtì ɨ fàyn kɨ anôyn kì a kɨ nà n-ghɨ afu, bòm ta ghelɨ anòyn nâ ghì ɨ nà n-lî ŋweyn sɨ a nfè’tɨ i gha’nɨ.
verses.niv: They looked for a way to arrest him, but they were afraid of the crowd because the people held that he was a prophet.

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨn fi meyn mò ngàyn ì lì sɨ̂ àŋena ɨ bè na,
verses.niv: Jesus spoke to them again in parables, saying:

verses.kom: «Ghɨ kà’ a ghɨ fe’nɨ ɨfoyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì nɨ̀ fɨ̀tɨtɨ̂ fɨ fòyn ɨ̀ lvì a wù n-læ ba’tɨ ayɨ a malâ nɨ̀ wayn ŋweyn ɨ lûmnɨ̀
verses.niv: “The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son.

verses.kom: ɨ tum ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ nɨ̀ ŋweyn na ghɨ ndu ɨ jàŋtɨ̀ ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ tî là’ì, mɨtì ghelɨ ateyn ɨ teyn na ghɨ n-gvî wì.
verses.niv: He sent his servants to those who had been invited to the banquet to tell them to come, but they refused to come.

verses.kom: Wu fi tum kfeynsɨ ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ nɨ̀ ŋweyn ghɨ li na ghɨ ndu ɨ̀ bè sɨ̂ ghelɨ ateyn na ghɨ ba’tɨ meyn mèsì ìyɨ zɨ̀-ì, ɨ̀ tèyntɨ mbòŋsɨ̀ nɨ̀ ɨ̀chô’ ɨ nyâmsɨ̀ ɨ lvi, nô mɨ gha ɨ na sɨ ghɨ kɨ iyɨ, na àŋena gvi læ̂ alè’ a yɨnɨ-a.
verses.niv: “Then he sent some more servants and said, ‘Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my dinner: My oxen and fattened cattle have been butchered, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.’

verses.kom: Àŋena ndù ɨ là’ì, wùl ɨ faŋ tɨ̀ lèm atu iwo nâ ghè, nô mɨ ndà ɨ nà fvɨ̂ ndû kɨ a ŋweyn alè’. Wùl ɨ̀ lvì ɨ se’ a gvêyn, ɨ̀lvì ɨ lù ɨ nà faytɨ̂ ndû nɨ̀ àwo a ŋweyna.
verses.niv: “But they paid no attention and went off –one to his field, another to his business.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ntum nɨ̀ fòyn nâ ghì ɨ ndù sɨ ghɨli, ghɨ ghal àŋena ɨ nyàblɨ̀ nɨ̀ àŋena, ɨ zuetɨ.
verses.niv: The rest seized his servants, mistreated them and killed them.

verses.kom: Fòyn ɨ yvɨ iwo ateyn, yi yaf ɨ ŋweyn nô a bɨ, wu tum sugèy’sɨ ŋweyn na sɨ ndu ɨ̀ zùetɨ ghelɨ nâ ghì fì nyò’ ntè’ àŋena.
verses.niv: The king was enraged. He sent his army and destroyed those murderers and burned their city.

verses.kom: Wu kæ be sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ nɨ̀ ŋweyn ghɨ li na, ‹Ghɨ ba’tɨ meyn mèsì ìyɨ i malâ yèynì, mɨtì ghelɨ ghì a mà tî là’ì ɨ na kfeynɨ̂ wì sɨ gvì.
verses.niv: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited did not deserve to come.

verses.kom: Yì fvɨ ndù ɨfyàf ɨ dzɨsɨ tosɨ ɨ̀ là’ì nô mɨ ndà vzɨ̂ a yì yeyn.›
verses.niv: Go to the street corners and invite to the banquet anyone you find.’

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ nâ ghì ɨ fvɨ̀ ɨ ndu jàŋtɨ̀ nô mɨ ndà ta àŋena yeyn, ghelɨ ghɨ bɨ nɨ̀ ghɨ jûŋ ɨ gvì a ndô malâ ɨ luyn.
verses.niv: So the servants went out into the streets and gathered all the people they could find, both good and bad, and the wedding hall was filled with guests.

verses.kom: «Fòyn ɨ gvì sɨ toŋtɨ ghelɨ, ɨ yeyn wul wu du’ afu bùla wù faytɨ̂ laf
verses.niv: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he noticed a man there who was not wearing wedding clothes.

verses.kom: ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, ‹Wà jèl ti sɨ nà ghɨ afêyn a ba, kê’ tèyn a?› Wùl àteyn ɨ chimi kɨ têyn moŋ.
verses.niv: ‘Friend,’ he asked, ‘how did you get in here without wedding clothes?’ The man was speechless.

verses.kom: Fòyn ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ nɨ̀ ŋweyn na, ‹Yì kul akœ a ŋweyn ɨ̀ kul afyeyn ɨ̀ mà’ fvɨ̀sɨ̀ ndù nɨ̀ ŋweyn abe a fɨmnɨ-a, alè’ ghè a ghɨ n-luŋlɨ dzɨ̂ afu.›»
verses.niv: “Then the king told the attendants, ‘Tie him hand and foot, and throw him outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ taŋi tèyn ɨ kæ bè na, «Ghɨ n-jâŋ ghelɨ sɨ idvɨ̀, mɨtì cho’tɨ̂ kɨ sɨ ilæ.»
verses.niv: “For many are invited, but few are chosen.”

verses.kom: Ghelɨ Falàsî ghɨ li nɨ̂n yvɨŋtɨ meyn ɨ ba’tɨ dzɨ sɨ nì na Jisòs taŋi ɨ̀ jas, ghɨ ghal ŋweyn,
verses.niv: Then the Pharisees went out and laid plans to trap him in his words.

verses.kom: ɨ kæ tum tɨbam tɨ àŋena nɨ̀ ghelɨ abàs nɨ̀ Helòd ghɨ li ɨ bè na àŋena ndu ɨ̀ bè sɨ̂ Jisòs na, «Ndyèynsɨ̀, ghès nɨn kya na wà n-taŋî kɨ samo’, ye’î kɨ ìwo zɨ̀ a yi n-ghɨ samo’ kûm Fɨ̀yìnì, kfɨlà wì na ghelɨ nɨn kfâ’tɨ̀ na gha a, bòm ta à n-ghɨ sɨ̂ và, ghelɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m ɨ ghɨ kɨ ighel.
verses.niv: They sent their disciples to him along with the Herodians. “Teacher,” they said, “we know you are a man of integrity and that you teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. You aren't swayed by men, because you pay no attention to who they are.

verses.kom: Fè’tɨ sɨ̂ ghès nâ à n-ghɨ a wa ikfà’tɨ̀ isa’ i bɨmî na ghɨ na mâ’ tâks sɨ̂ fòyn ɨ gha’nɨ a Rome ma, yi n-bɨmî wì a?»
verses.niv: Tell us then, what is your opinion? Is it right to pay taxes to Caesar or not?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ keli mɨ̀nàŋ mzɨ̂ a àŋena bà’tɨ ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Zɨ̀ ghêyn a yi kem kem nî awo tèyn! Yi n-gyâ ɨ̀chfɨ̂ wom bòm ghà?
verses.niv: But Jesus, knowing their evil intent, said, “You hypocrites, why are you trying to trap me?

verses.kom: Yì dyeyn gvì nɨ̀ ɨ̀kwo akas vzɨ̀ a ghɨ n-mâ’ tâks ateyn tì sɨ̂ mà.» Nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, ghɨ gvì nɨ̀ ɨ̀kwo akas nâ vzɨ̀ sɨ̂ ŋweyn.
verses.niv: Show me the coin used for paying the tax.” They brought him a denarius,

verses.kom: Wu bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «À n-ghɨ àlɨŋsɨ ikè’ nɨ̀ ndà kèyn ateyn tèyn nɨ̀ ìzɨyn i a?»
verses.niv: and he asked them, “Whose portrait is this? And whose inscription?”

verses.kom: Àŋena bè na, «À n-ghɨ ìkê’ i fòyn ɨ gha’nɨ a Rome nɨ̀ ìzɨyn i ŋweyni.» Jisòs ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yi na ghɨ tì, yi nà fu kɨ ɨ̀fwo ɨ fòyn sɨ̂ fòyn, fu kɨ ɨ̀fwo ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì sɨ̂ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀.»
verses.niv: “Caesar's,” they replied. Then he said to them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's.”

verses.kom: Àŋena yvɨ ta wù bèynsɨ̀ tî, achfɨ̂ a àŋena yum, àŋena lù ɨ visi ŋweyn.
verses.niv: When they heard this, they were amazed. So they left him and went away.

verses.kom: À nà n-ghɨ kɨmɨ achi nâ ghè, ghelɨ Sadùsî ɨ gvì sɨ̂ Jisòs, a ghɨ ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-bɨmi wi na wùl ɨ̀ læò lalì sɨ ikfɨ, ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na,
verses.niv: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.

verses.kom: «Ndyèynsɨ̀, ba Mosìs nɨ̂n læ bè sɨ̂ ghesɨ̀nà na, ‹Wayn-nà wùl kæ kfɨ, kelɨ wi mɨtì kelɨ wi woyn, a wayn-nà wùl ɨ kfɨnɨ na kelɨ sɨ li wî nkfɨ àteyn, na ŋêyn ŋweyn bzɨ woyn sɨ̂ wayn-nà ŋweyn ɨ kfɨnɨ nâ vzɨ̀› a?
verses.niv: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses told us that if a man dies without having children, his brother must marry the widow and have children for him.

verses.kom: Woyn-ghɨ̂nì ghɨ li nɨ̂n læ meyn nà ghɨ afêyn nsòmbo, ɨwû àsɨ ɨ ndù wi ɨ kfɨ kelɨ wi woyn, ɨ visi wi àteyn sɨ̂ wayn-nà ŋweyn.
verses.niv: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married and died, and since he had no children, he left his wife to his brother.

verses.kom: Wayn-nà ŋweyn nâ vzɨ̀ ɨ fi kfɨ ɨ visi wul ɨ wi àteyn kɨ̀ tî, ànkùmtɨ̀ à ɨ fi lì ɨ fi boŋ kfɨ kɨ tî. A nà sɨ lî mɨ ndà kfɨ kɨ tì. Àŋena læ kfɨtɨ kɨ têyn ɨ ndu mèsì.
verses.niv: The same thing happened to the second and third brother, right on down to the seventh.

verses.kom: Sɨ ibàm ateyn wùl ɨ wi àteyn ɨ boŋ kfɨ.
verses.niv: Finally, the woman died.

verses.kom: À ti læò nà ghɨ achi nâ ghè a ghɨ n-lalì sɨ ikfɨ, a wul ɨ wi àteyn na ghɨ wî ndà, bòm ta woyn-ghɨ̂nì nâ ghì ɨ nà n-kelɨ kɨ ŋweyn sɨ a wi ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m a?»
verses.niv: Now then, at the resurrection, whose wife will she be of the seven, since all of them were married to her?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yi n-jay-jây taŋî tèyn bòm ta yi n-kya wi iwo zɨ̀ a Ŋwà’lɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì nɨ̀n bê, fî kya wi iwo zɨ̀ a Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ kà’ a fɨ ni.
verses.niv: Jesus replied, “You are in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.

verses.kom: À læò nà ghɨ ta ghelɨ làlì sɨ ikfɨ, a wùl na ndû wì wi, wùl ɨ bɨmî wì lum. Ghelɨ læò nà ghɨ kɨmɨ tèyn ta nchìsɨ Fɨ̂yìnìsɨ̀ nɨn ghɨ iyvɨ.
verses.niv: At the resurrection people will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.

verses.kom: Ba yi ti n-ghɨ na yi bû jàŋ ɨ̀ yvɨ iwo zɨ̀ a Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ bè sɨ̂ zɨ̀ kûm ìlalì sɨ ikfɨ ma? Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ nɨn læ bè na,
verses.niv: But about the resurrection of the dead –have you not read what God said to you,

verses.kom: ‹Mɨ n-ghɨ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ Abɨ̀làhâm, ghɨ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ Yisàk, ghɨ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ Jàkôb.› Fɨ n-ghɨ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-chi, a ghɨ wi Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ ghelɨ ghɨ kfɨtɨnɨ.»
verses.niv: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? He is not the God of the dead but of the living.”

verses.kom: Anôyn nâ kì nɨ̂n læ meyn yvɨ iye’i nâ yèynì ɨ nà ghɨ nɨ̀ ìkayn i.
verses.niv: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at his teaching.

verses.kom: A nà n-ghɨ ta ghelɨ Falàsî ɨ̀ yvɨ na Jisòs chɨmsɨ meyn àchfɨ̂ a ghelɨ Sadùsî, àŋena yvɨ̀ŋtɨ̀ ɨ gvì.
verses.niv: Hearing that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, the Pharisees got together.

verses.kom: Wùl ɨ̀ mò’ a àŋena antêynɨ̀, a ghɨ ndyèynsɨ̀ ìsa’ ɨ mòm ŋweyn ɨ bɨf na,
verses.niv: One of them, an expert in the law, tested him with this question:

verses.kom: «Ndyèynsɨ̀, à n-ghɨ ìsa’ ì kà antêynɨ̀ tɨ̀sa’ nɨ̀ Mosìs a yi n-to chwô nô tɨ̀ jɨ̀m a?»
verses.niv: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the Law?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bèynsɨ̀ ɨ bè na, «À n-ghɨ izɨ̂ a yi n-bê na, ‹Wà n-kelɨ sɨ nà koŋ Bôbo Fɨ̀yìnì fyafɨ nɨ̀ àtem à kya à jɨ̀mà, nɨ̀ àyvɨs à kya à jɨ̀mà, nɨ̀ ìkfâ’tɨ̀ ì zæ ì jɨ̀mì.›
verses.niv: Jesus replied: “ ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’

verses.kom: À ti isa’ zɨ̀ a yi n-chwô nô tɨ̀sa’ tɨ̀ jɨ̀m.
verses.niv: This is the first and greatest commandment.

verses.kom: Ànkùmtɨ̀ à ɨ ghɨ ndû kɨmɨ tì na, ‹Wa kôŋ wayn-nà vâ kɨ̀ ighel ta wà n-kôŋ ngêŋ zyâ.›
verses.niv: And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’

verses.kom: Tɨsa’ tɨ Mosìs tɨ̀ nô tɨ̀ jɨ̀m nɨ̀ ìye’i i nfè’tɨ̀ sɨ gha’nɨsɨ nô ì jɨ̀m nɨ̀n ti kɨ atû tɨ̀sa’ nâ ghàyn tɨ̀ bò.»
verses.niv: All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments.”

verses.kom: Ghelɨ Falàsî ɨ nà bu ghɨ kɨ sɨ àŋena anòyn, Jisòs ɨ kæ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na,
verses.niv: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

verses.kom: «Yi n-kfâ’tɨ̀ na gha kûm Christ, ɨvzɨ̂ a ghɨ cho’ meyn lèm a? Ghɨ n-kya na wù n-ghɨ wâyn ndà?» Àŋena bè na wù n-ghɨ wâyn Devìt.
verses.niv: “What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is he?” “The son of David,” they replied.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yi ti n-ghɨ tì, Ayvɨs a Ŋwa’nɨ-a ɨ jèl ti sɨ fì sɨ nì na wù toŋtɨ wâyn ŋweyn nâ wèyn na Bôbo a? Mɨ n-bɨf tèyn bòm ta Devìt nɨn læ bè na:
verses.niv: He said to them, “How is it then that David, speaking by the Spirit, calls him ‘Lord’? For he says,

verses.kom: ‹Bô Fɨ̀yìnì nɨ̂n bè sɨ̂ Bôbo wom na, Dù’i abàs ɨkœ ɨ two nɨ̀ mà sɨ chem ta ka mà lem mbàynɨ̀ shyasɨ isas i ɨvɨ nɨ̀ và.›
verses.niv: “ ‘The Lord said to my Lord: “Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet.” ’

verses.kom: À ti kæ sɨ nà ghɨ ma Devìt nɨ̂n toŋtɨ meyn ŋweyn na Bôbo, wu nà fî ghɨ ti wayn sɨ̂ Devìt a?»
verses.niv: If then David calls him ‘Lord,’ how can he be his son?”

verses.kom: Wùl ɨ faŋ tɨ̀ fì tɨ̀ gàyn sɨ bèynsɨ̀ iwo ateyn. Sɨ zɨ̀tɨ̀ achi nâ ghè, wùl ɨ læ faŋ tɨ̀ fì tɨ̀ mòmsɨ̀ sɨ bɨf iwo sɨ̂ ŋweyn.
verses.niv: No one could say a word in reply, and from that day on no one dared to ask him any more questions.

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨ̂n kasi meyn ɨ nà sɨ taŋî sɨ̂ ìnôyn i ghêl i li nɨ̀ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ,
verses.niv: Then Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:

verses.kom: bê na, «Ndyèynsɨ̀ sɨ isa’sɨ nɨ̀ ghelɨ Falàsî nɨn ghɨ ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-kelɨ adya’ sɨ nà ye’i Isa’ i Mosìs.
verses.niv: “The teachers of the law and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat.

verses.kom: Yi ti n-dyêyn na yi n-kelɨ kɨ nô sɨ nà ni nô mɨ ghà ta àŋena nɨn bê na yì na ni-à. Mɨtì, ka yi n-læò sɨ̀nɨ nchînɨ̀sɨ àŋena bòm ta àŋena nɨn nî wì awo kì a àŋena nɨn ye’i.
verses.niv: So you must obey them and do everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.

verses.kom: Àŋena nɨn tosɨ̂ na ghelɨ na nî àwo, kɨ to gha’ àŋena, ghɨ ta abey’i kɨ dɨ̂l kɨ tèyn, mɨtì kôŋ wì sɨ gàmtɨ̀ nô sakos.
verses.niv: They tie up heavy loads and put them on men's shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them.

verses.kom: Àŋena nɨn nî nô mɨ ghà, kɨ̀ sɨ idyèyn i ɨwùyn. Àŋena nɨn lî mɨ̀fôlɨ̀ mzɨ̀ a ghɨ n-we mɨ̀ŋwà’lɨ̀ mzɨ̀ a ghɨ nyà’ Isa’ i Fɨ̂yìnì ateyn, kul ɨchfɨ̀ atu, ghɨ nì mɨ nà gha’lɨ̂ kɨ tèyn; ɨ̀ lì mɨ̀bâynɨ̀ mɨ̀ ndzɨsɨ mzɨ̀ a ghɨ n-kelɨ sɨ nà kul achfɨ̀ a ndzɨsɨ, ghɨ nì mɨ nà dyêblɨ̀ kɨ tèyn.
verses.niv: “Everything they do is done for men to see: They make their phylacteries wide and the tassels on their garments long;

verses.kom: Àŋena nɨn ndû alè’ ayɨ, ghɨ nà kôŋ kɨ sɨ ko’ sɨ dù’ì alè’ a ngaŋtɨnɨ-a, ɨ̀ ndù a ndosɨ nchɨ̀yntɨ, ghɨ ko’ dù’i kɨ asɨ.
verses.niv: they love the place of honor at banquets and the most important seats in the synagogues;

verses.kom: Wùl ɨ̀ sɨ ateyn nɨn nî wu nà kôŋ na ghɨ na toŋtɨ̂ kɨ zɨ̀ nà, ‹Ndyèynsɨ̀,› ɨ̀ nì fvɨ̀ ndù afàf, wu nà kôŋ na ghelɨ na nyɨŋ gvî toŋtɨ̂ zɨ̀.
verses.niv: they love to be greeted in the marketplaces and to have men call them ‘Rabbi.’

verses.kom: Yi n-ghɨ kɨ woyn-ghɨ̂nì ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m, kelɨ kɨ Ndyèynsɨ̀ ɨ̀ mò’. Ka yì visi ghɨ na toŋtɨ̂ wul ɨ sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na ndyèynsɨ̀.
verses.niv: “But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have only one Master and you are all brothers.

verses.kom: Ka yì læ̂ tòŋtɨ wul a nse afêyn na, ‹Bô,› bòm ta yi n-kelɨ kɨ Bæ ɨ̀ mò’, wu ghɨ iyvɨ.
verses.niv: And do not call anyone on earth ‘father,’ for you have one Father, and he is in heaven.

verses.kom: Yi n-kelɨ wi meyn sɨ visi na ghɨ na toŋtɨ̂ wul sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na wul ɨ tisɨnɨ bòm ta Wùl ɨ Tisɨnɨ nɨn gô’ ɨ̀mò’, a ghɨ mà Christ.
verses.niv: Nor are you to be called ‘teacher,’ for you have one Teacher, the Christ.

verses.kom: Wùl vzɨ̀ a wù ngàŋtɨ ɨ̀ chwò nô mɨ ndà a yi antêynɨ̀ nɨ̀n kelɨ sɨ nà ghɨ wul ɨ̀ fèlɨnɨ nɨ̀ zɨ̀.
verses.niv: The greatest among you will be your servant.

verses.kom: À kò’sɨ mɨ ndà ngêŋ ŋweyn iyvɨ, a Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ su’sɨ ŋweyn a nse; à lî mɨ ndà ngêŋ ŋweyn a nse, a Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ ko’sɨ ŋweyn iyvɨ.»
verses.niv: For whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ kasi nà sɨ taŋî sɨ̂ ndyèynsɨ̀ sɨ isa’sɨ nɨ̀ ghelɨ Falàsî bê na, «Zɨ̀ ghêyn a yi n-kem kem nî têyn, nge’ i gha’nɨ nɨn ghɨ sɨ̂ zɨ̀! Yi n-kôŋ wì sɨ zɨ alè’ ɨfòyn nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀, tâmtɨ̀ ghelɨ ghɨ li, àŋena kôŋ sɨ zɨ.
verses.niv: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You shut the kingdom of heaven in men's faces. You yourselves do not enter, nor will you let those enter who are trying to.

verses.kom: «Nge’ i gha’nɨ nɨn ghɨ sɨ̂ zɨ̀ a ndyèynsɨ̀ sɨ isa’sɨ nɨ̀ ghelɨ Falàsî, zɨ̀ ghêyn a yi n-kem kem nî awo tèyn! Yi nî yi jèl ndyèynsɨ̀ ɨ dyàŋ jvasɨ tosɨ kɨ̀ sɨ nì na wùl ɨ̀ yvɨ ɨ̀ bɨ̀mi ìwo zɨ̀ a yi n-ye’i. Wù se sɨ bɨmi sɨ mèsì, yi fi kasi nì wu nà sɨ kfeynɨ̂ chwô zɨ̀ sɨ zɨ alè’ ibebsɨ.
verses.niv: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You travel over land and sea to win a single convert, and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of hell as you are.

verses.kom: «Nge’ i gha’nɨ nɨn ghɨ sɨ̂ zɨ̀ ghêyn a yi n-tisɨ ghelɨ ma yi fef meyn tèyn! Yi n-bê na wùl ɨ̀ kæ chfɨ̀nɨ iwo, ɨ̀ kàyn ndô Fɨ̀yìnì i gha’nɨ, nì faŋ tɨ̀ nì iwo ateyn, nge’ bu nà ghɨ. Mɨtì, a fî ye’î kɨmɨ zɨ̀ na wùl ɨ̀ kæ chfɨ̀nɨ̀ iwo ɨ̀ kæ kwo kàyn ɨ̀fwo vzɨ̀ a wu n-ghɨ a ndô Fɨ̀yìnì ma ghɨ tsɨ nɨ̀ àso ɨkwo, a wù na kelɨ sɨ nì iwo nâ zɨ̀-ì.
verses.niv: “Woe to you, blind guides! You say, ‘If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gold of the temple, he is bound by his oath.’

verses.kom: ƗÌngù wêyn a wu fèf têyn! À n-ko’nɨ̂ chwô ɨ̀fwo nâ wèyn a ghɨ tsɨ ɨ̀ lèm tèyn ma, à n-ko’nɨ̂ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì zɨ̀ a yì n-nî na wu na ghɨ nɨ̀ ìlayn i a?
verses.niv: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes the gold sacred?

verses.kom: Yi n-ye’î kɨmɨ na wùl ɨ̀ kæ sɨ chfɨ̀nɨ̀ na yi nî ìwo, ɨ̀ kàyn àbaŋ ifu, a nge’ na ghɨ wi nô mɨ ɨlvɨ ta wù faŋ tɨ̀ nì iwo ateyn, mɨtì ma wù chfɨ̀nɨ̀ iwo ɨ̀ kwo kàyn ìfu zɨ̀ a yi n-ghɨ atû àbaŋ, a wù na kelɨ sɨ ni iwo ateyn.
verses.niv: You also say, ‘If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gift on it, he is bound by his oath.’

verses.kom: Zɨ̀ ghêyn a yì fèf têyn! À n-chwô ìfu ma nô àbaŋ kì a kɨ n-nî na ifu ateyn i na ghɨ nɨ̀ ìlayn i a?
verses.niv: You blind men! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes the gift sacred?

verses.kom: Yi ti n-dyêyn na à kæ kayn nô mɨ ndà abaŋ ifu, a à na ghɨ ma wù kàyn bà’sɨ nô mɨ ghà vzɨ̂ a kɨ n-ghɨ atû àteyn.
verses.niv: Therefore, he who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.

verses.kom: Wù kæ kayn ndô Fɨ̀yìnì, a à na ghɨ ma wù kàyn bà’sɨ kɨ nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fìfɨ̀ a fɨ n-ghɨ ateyn.
verses.niv: And he who swears by the temple swears by it and by the one who dwells in it.

verses.kom: Ma ɨlvɨ ta wù kæ kàyn iyvɨ, a à na ghɨ ma wù kayn meyn àchɨ a tɨ̂fòyn nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ ba’sɨ̂ kɨ nɨ̀ nfeynfɨ ta fɨ n-du’ ateyn.
verses.niv: And he who swears by heaven swears by God's throne and by the one who sits on it.

verses.kom: «Nge’ i gha’nɨ nɨn ghɨ sɨ̂ zɨ̀ a ndyèynsɨ̀ sɨ isa’sɨ nɨ̀ ghelɨ Falàsî! Zɨ̀ ghêyn a yi n-kem kem nî awo tèyn. Yi n-lî mɨ̀fôlɨ̀ ɨ̀n lɨ̀mtɨnɨ̂ mzɨ̀ a ghɨ n-we antêynɨ̀ ɨfwo ɨ yɨnɨ, yi gwòtɨ̀ ɨlwê’ ìvɨm ɨ fu alê’ à mò’ sɨ̂ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀, kɨ̀ ta Isa’ i Mosìs i nɨn dyêyn, mɨtì chas àwo kì a kɨ n-ghɨ isa’, to chwô iyeyn nâ yèynì têyn ta akî a kɨ n-bê na, wùl nɨ̀n kelɨ sɨ nà ni awo, kɨ ghɨ àtì-ati sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghɨ li, koynsɨ̂ ìsuyn sɨ̂ àŋena fî bɨmî kɨ sɨ̂ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀. Yì nì nà ghɨ sɨ nà ni awo nâ kèynà, chas wi ali-a.
verses.niv: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You give a tenth of your spices –mint, dill and cummin. But you have neglected the more important matters of the law –justice, mercy and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.

verses.kom: Zɨ̀ ghêyn a yi n-tisɨ ghelɨ ma yi fefɨ meyn tèyn! Yi nî yi nà yelî fvɨ̂sɨ̀ fɨ̀yvɨk-ayvɨk sɨ a yi a mɨ̂lù’, yi ni fi mzɨ̀ nyam kfaŋ!
verses.niv: You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.

verses.kom: «Nge’ i gha’nɨ nɨn ghɨ sɨ̂ zɨ̀ a ndyèynsɨ̀ sɨ isa’sɨ nɨ̀ ghelɨ Falàsî. Zɨ̀ ghêyn a yi n-kem kem nî awo tèyn! Yi n-lî ɨ̀kfaŋ ɨ̀ vzɨ nɨ̀ bom ɨ̀ sisɨ, yi tò’ ɨ su kɨ jɨmsɨ, mɨtì ɨfwo vzɨ̀ a yì we antêynɨ̀ àteyn ɨ ghɨ ma yì ghal ɨ̀ fsɨ kɨ̀ sɨ̂ ghelɨ sɨ adya’ bòm àsɨ a fvɨnɨ-a.
verses.niv: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.

verses.kom: Zɨ̀ ghelɨ Falàsî ghèyn a yì fèf meyn tèyn! Yì su ɨ̀ntwêynɨ̀ ɨkfaŋ nɨ̀ zɨ̀ nɨ̀ ɨ̀ntwêynɨ̀ ɨ bomsɨ meyn, a ka jɨmsɨ ateyn sɨ na boŋ ghɨ nɨ̀ ìlayn i.
verses.niv: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, and then the outside also will be clean.

verses.kom: «Nge’ i gha’nɨ nɨn ghɨ sɨ̂ zɨ̀ a ndyèynsɨ̀ sɨ isa’sɨ nɨ̀ ghelɨ Falàsî. Zɨ̀ ghêyn a yi n-kem kem nî awo tèyn! Yi n-ghɨ ta tɨsê ɨlvɨ ta ghɨ fàytɨ bom ɨ̀ yo’, tɨ na fɨf jôf kɨ tèyn abe, mɨtì a ghɨ kɨ ɨ̀vɨf ɨ ghêl antêynɨ̀, nɨ̀ ɨ̀fwo ilɨŋ ɨ lvi.
verses.niv: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of dead men's bones and everything unclean.

verses.kom: Yi ti n-ghɨ kɨmɨ ighel ta yi n-jôf kɨ a njwòsɨ ɨwùyn, mɨtì ghɨ antêynɨ̀ ma yi luyn kɨ nɨ̀ ìkem-kem i nì ì, nɨ̀ àwo a bɨ-a a li-a.
verses.niv: In the same way, on the outside you appear to people as righteous but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.

verses.kom: «Nge’ i gha’nɨ nɨn ghɨ sɨ̂ zɨ̀ a ndyèynsɨ̀ sɨ isa’sɨ nɨ̀ ghelɨ Falàsî. Zɨ̀ ghêyn a yi n-kem kem nî awo tèyn! Yi n-bom tɨ̀sê tɨ nfè’tɨ̀ sɨ gha’nɨsɨ fî bâ’lɨ̀ tɨ̀sê tɨ ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-læ nà chi nchînɨ̀sɨ àtì-ati,
verses.niv: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the graves of the righteous.

verses.kom: bê na, ‹A nà n-ghɨ na ghèsɨ̀ na ghɨ ɨtu’ nɨ̀ ghɨ̀bò ɨ ghesɨ, ma ghès nɨn bu læ gàmtɨ sɨ zuetɨ nfè’tɨ̀ sɨ gha’nɨ nâ sèynsɨ̀.›
verses.niv: And you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our forefathers, we would not have taken part with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’

verses.kom: Yi ti n-dyêyn na yi n-bɨmî mbɨ̂ zɨ samo’ ta yi n-bɨmi na yi n-ghɨ woyn ghêl nâ ghì a ghɨ n-læ zuetɨ nfè’tɨ̀ sɨ gha’nɨ nâ sìsɨ̀.
verses.niv: So you testify against yourselves that you are the descendants of those who murdered the prophets.

verses.kom: Yì ndu læ̂ kɨ̀ asɨ ɨ̀ nì mèsì ìfêl i mbɨ zɨ̀ a ghɨ̀bò ɨ ghi nɨn læ zɨ̀tɨ.
verses.niv: Fill up, then, the measure of the sin of your forefathers!

verses.kom: Mbam sèynsɨ̀! Mbamsɨ bɨ sèynsɨ̀! Yì ti læò nî nô ghà na ka Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ læ̂ sà’ zɨ ɨ̀ tum zɨ alè’ ibebsɨ a?
verses.niv: “You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape being condemned to hell?

verses.kom: Ma kæ sɨ nà be sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na, mɨ nì tum nfè’tɨ̀sɨ̀ nɨ̀ ghelɨ ghɨ tofɨnɨ nɨ̀ ndyèynsɨ̀sɨ̀, kya na yi nì zuetɨ̂ ghɨli fì bàyntɨ ghɨli, ɨ̀ leŋ ghɨli a yi a ndosɨ nchɨ̀yntɨ, ɨ̀ nà fî fu nge’ sɨ ghɨli kɨ̀ a ntè’ a ntè’.
verses.niv: Therefore I am sending you prophets and wise men and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify; others you will flog in your synagogues and pursue from town to town.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-tum àŋena, a yì ni têyn ta ka mɨ̀lûŋ mɨ̀ ghelɨ àtì-ati ghì a yì zùetɨ meyn a nse faŋ a yi atu, kɨ̀ sɨ zɨ̀tɨ̀ nɨ̀ Abèl vzɨ̀ a ghɨ n-læ zue bùla wù bebsɨ ìwo, sɨ ko’ sɨ chem a Sàkàliyà, ɨ wâyn Bàlàkayà vzɨ̀ a yi n-læ zue a nfaynɨsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì nɨ̀ àbaŋ ifu a.
verses.niv: And so upon you will come all the righteous blood that has been shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berekiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na, nge’ zɨ̀ a yì n-gvî bòm àwo a bɨ-a nâ kèynà nô à jɨ̀m nɨn nì fê kɨ atu nɨ̀ àjâŋ nâ kèynà.»
verses.niv: I tell you the truth, all this will come upon this generation.

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨn fi meyn taŋi ɨ bè na, «Womê, zɨ̀ ghelɨ Jèlusalèm ghèyn a yi n-zuetɨ nfè’tɨ̀ sɨ gha’nɨsɨ têyn, tɨmlɨ̂ zuetɨ̂ ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ tùm sɨ̂ zɨ̀! Ma momsɨ meyn kɨ̀ aghayn aghayn sɨ yvɨ̀ŋtɨ zɨ têyn ta nà ngvɨ nɨn nî yi yvɨtɨ woyn ŋweyn isas i tɨ̂wò, mɨtì yi le’ kɨ̀ le’!
verses.niv: “O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were not willing.

verses.kom: Lvɨ̂yn tèyn, Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ nɨn kenɨ̂ ntè’ ɨ zɨ, a yì bef.
verses.niv: Look, your house is left to you desolate.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na, yì læò bu fì yeyn wi ma, a bu kɨ na à læò gvì àchi kì a ka yì na bê ateyn na, ‹Iboysɨ i nɨn ghɨ sɨ̂ ɨvzɨ̂ a wù n-gvî sɨ izɨyn nɨ̀ Bôbo.›»
verses.niv: For I tell you, you will not see me again until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.’ ”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ fvɨ̀ sɨ abe a ndô Fɨ̀yìnì ɨ nà sɨ lu-à, njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ fi jèl ɨ ba’sɨ ndù nô a ŋweyn a ngùŋ ɨ kæ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, ba wù yeyn meyn dzɨ zɨ̀ a ghɨ bà’lɨ̀ abe a ndô Fɨ̀yìnì ateyn a.
verses.niv: Jesus left the temple and was walking away when his disciples came up to him to call his attention to its buildings.

verses.kom: Wu bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yi n-yeyn àbe nâ kèynà têyn, ma bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na ɨlvɨ nɨn ba’sɨ̂ gvi-à ta ka ghɨ bɨytɨ ndosɨ ateyn nô tèyn a ngò’ na bu du’ wi atu nɨ̀ ìlì.»
verses.niv: “Do you see all these things?” he asked. “I tell you the truth, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ ni ko’ ɨ ndù ɨ dù’ì a kfɨ̂yn Olìfsɨ̀, njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ gvì ɨ dù’ì a ŋweyn a ngùŋ ɨ kæ nya’tɨ sɨ be sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Fè’tɨ sɨ̂ ghès na awo nâ kèynà læò gâyn ɨtu’ ɨ gha a? Wà læò se sɨ kasi sɨ gvì, a nchwæ na ghɨ ghà? Ghɨ ti læò kelî nô sɨ a gha na ngò’sɨ̂ mbzɨ gvi meyn a?»
verses.niv: As Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately. “Tell us,” they said, “when will this happen, and what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the age?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yì na tô’nɨ̀-à ka wùl nɨ̂n læò jɨ̀ŋsɨ̀ zɨ̀.
verses.niv: Jesus answered: “Watch out that no one deceives you.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ læò nà gvi-à, dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn, ghɨ na ghɨ n-gvî a ma izɨyn, a gvî mɨ ndà bê na, ‹À n-ghɨ kɨ nô ma Christ nâ vzɨ̀!› Ghɨ læò jɨ̂ŋsɨ̀ ndvɨ̀ ghèl a dzɨ nâ ghàyn.
verses.niv: For many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will deceive many.

verses.kom: Yì læò yvɨ àwo kûm tɨ̀woŋ a ndyèynsɨ̀, ɨ̀ fì yvɨ na tɨlitɨ nɨn ba’sɨ̂ gvi-à. Yi yvɨ tì, ka yi n-fàyn bòm ta awo nâ kèynà nɨn kelɨ sɨ gàyn, mɨtì ngò’sɨ bu ghɨ sɨ jæ gvì.
verses.niv: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come.

verses.kom: Tɨla’ tɨ læò nà nû tɨlitɨ, tɨfôyn tɨ̀ ɨ nû tɨlitɨ, kfɨ̀msɨ̀ ɨ seynlɨ-à, a jèŋ fî ku kɨ̀ ɨlwè’ ɨlwè’.
verses.niv: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.

verses.kom: Awo nâ kèynà nô à jɨ̀m læò nà gâyn tèyn, a bu ghɨ kɨ mɨ̀lɨ̂m mɨ̀ nge’ i gha’nɨ.
verses.niv: All these are the beginning of birth pains.

verses.kom: «Ghelɨ læò ghal zɨ̀ ɨ̀ fù sɨ̂ ghelɨ, a ghɨ fu nge’ sɨ̂ zɨ̀, fì zùetɨ zɨ̀. Nô ghelɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m læò nà bâyn zɨ̀ kɨ bòm mà.
verses.niv: “Then you will be handed over to be persecuted and put to death, and you will be hated by all nations because of me.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ghɨ dvɨnɨ læò fê sɨ a àŋena ibɨmi ɨtu’ nâ ghè ɨ̀ kàsi nà bâyn woyn-ghɨ̂nì, bey’lɨ̂ àŋena,
verses.niv: At that time many will turn away from the faith and will betray and hate each other,

verses.kom: a nfè’tɨ̀sɨ ànkaŋsɨ fvɨ, dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn, jɨ̀ŋsɨ̀ ghelɨ, ghɨ dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn.
verses.niv: and many false prophets will appear and deceive many people.

verses.kom: Awo a bɨ-a læò dvɨ̂ chem aleŋ a li-a, a ghelɨ ghɨ dvɨnɨ na bu fì tô’ kôŋ wì ghɨli.
verses.niv: Because of the increase of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold,

verses.kom: Mɨtì, ma à wèynsɨ mɨ ndà sɨ chem a ngò’sɨ, a wù bœ.
verses.niv: but he who stands firm to the end will be saved.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ læò fê’tɨ̀ ntum ì jùŋ kûm ɨ̀foyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì kɨ̀ mbzɨ yèyn ì jɨ̀m ta ka ghelɨ tɨ̂la’ tɨ̀ jɨ̀m na kya samo’, a à na ghɨ ibàm ateyn, a ngò’sɨ ɨ̀ mbzɨ gvi.»
verses.niv: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in the whole world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.

verses.kom: (Wul ɨ̀ jaŋnɨ to’ yvɨ̀tɨ iyeyn nâ yèynì.) «Yi læ̂ kæ yeyn ngòŋ-ngòŋ i bemnɨ ì lì, yi lɨŋ ɨ̀lwê’, ti alè’ a laynɨ-a, a ghɨ kɨ ìwo zɨ̀ a nfè’tɨ̀ Danyèl nɨn læ taŋi kûm à,
verses.niv: “So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination that causes desolation,’ spoken of through the prophet Daniel –let the reader understand–

verses.kom: nô mɨ ndà a Jùdiyà ɨ le’ ko’ a kfɨynsɨ.
verses.niv: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

verses.kom: Yi gâyn, wùl ɨ ghɨ mɨ atû ndo, ka wu n-fì kàsî sù’i sɨ lì afo a ndo.
verses.niv: Let no one on the roof of his house go down to take anything out of the house.

verses.kom: Wùl ɨ̀ na ghɨ mɨ a gvêyn, ka wu n-fì kàsi ɨ̀ kfa sɨ lì awaf a ŋweyn a ndo.
verses.niv: Let no one in the field go back to get his cloak.

verses.kom: Mɨ̀chi nâ mzɨ̀ læò nà bem sɨ a nyɨŋ sɨ̂ ghɨ̀kì ghî a ghɨ n-ghɨ mɨlɨ̂ nɨ̀ ɨghî a ghɨ n-lî woyn!
verses.niv: How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers!

verses.kom: Yì na jêm na ka yi n-læò gàyn na yì na ghɨ sɨ le’ ma bèŋ chfɨ meyn ɨ̀ tèmnɨ̀ kèsa a achi ɨtu’ ila’,
verses.niv: Pray that your flight will not take place in winter or on the Sabbath.

verses.kom: bòm ta ɨlvɨ nâ vzɨ̀ læò kfeyna, a nge’ i gha’nɨ na ghɨ bùla wùl ɨ̀ timi yeyn nô sɨ ɨtu’ ta mbzɨ nɨ̀n læ zɨ̀tɨ, bu ghɨ wi sɨ læò sɨ fì sɨ yeyn.
verses.niv: For then there will be great distress, unequaled from the beginning of the world until now –and never to be equaled again.

verses.kom: Yi n-ghɨ kɨ na Bôbo sɨ ghɨ ma wù fabtɨ meyn mɨ̀chi mɨ̀ nge’ nâ mèyn, a bu tì, wùl ɨ̀ bû læò bœò. Wu n-fâbtɨ̀ mɨ̀chi mɨ̀ àteyn kɨ bòm ghelɨ ŋweyn ghì a ghɨ sɨ ghɨ ma wù cho’ meyn sɨ bœòsɨ̀.
verses.niv: If those days had not been cut short, no one would survive, but for the sake of the elect those days will be shortened.

verses.kom: «À læ̂ nà ghɨ a mɨchi nâ ghè, wùl ɨ̀ bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na, ‹Yì yeyna, Christ wèyn afêyn!› kèsa wù bè na, ‹Wù vzɨ afi!› ka yi n-bɨ̀mi ìwo zɨ̀ a wù n-bê,
verses.niv: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There he is!’ do not believe it.

verses.kom: bòm ta Christ sɨ ànkaŋsɨ nɨ̀ nfè’tɨ̀sɨ ànkaŋsɨ læò fvɨ̂ ɨtu’ nâ ghè ɨ̀ nà dyêyn nchwæsɨ bemnɨsɨ, môm àwo a kaynɨ-a kɨ̀ sɨ mòmsɨ̀ sɨ yeyn nâ a àŋena ti kà’ a ghɨ jɨŋsɨ nô mɨ ghelɨ ghì a Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ sɨ ghɨ ma fɨ cho’ meyn sɨ bœòsɨ̀-a.
verses.niv: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and miracles to deceive even the elect –if that were possible.

verses.kom: Yì to’ yvɨ̀tɨ! Ma teynɨ meyn fè’tɨ̀ àwo nâ kèynà sɨ̂ zɨ̀, kɨ bu ghɨ sɨ læò sɨ jæ gàyn.
verses.niv: See, I have told you ahead of time.

verses.kom: «À læ̂ kæ̂ be mɨ ndà sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na, ‹À n-ghɨ ŋweyn a nse iyum ti,› ka wùl nɨ̂n fvɨ̀ ndù afu. Wùl ɨ̀ læ̂ kæ̂ bè na, ‹Wù wèyn antêynɨ̀ ndo afêyn,› ka yi n-bɨ̀mi,
verses.niv: “So if anyone tells you, ‘There he is, out in the desert,’ do not go out; or, ‘Here he is, in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.

verses.kom: bòm ta igvî i Wâyn Wùl ì læò nà kê’ kɨ a ndayn têyn ta ivɨ i nɨn se sɨ myàyn, yi nà bayn kɨ iyvɨ ì jɨ̀m.
verses.niv: For as lightning that comes from the east is visible even in the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.

verses.kom: «Wâyn Wùl ɨ̀ læò se sɨ gvì, a nô mɨ ndà na kya kɨmɨ ighel ta afo a kfɨnɨ-a nɨn ghɨ mɨ wo, a ɨ̀ŋwò’ingumi na kya, yvɨ̂ŋtɨ̀ afu.
verses.niv: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.

verses.kom: «Nge’ i gha’nɨ nâ yèyn læò nà gâyn mesì gvî kɨ tèyn nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, a ɨchfɨ̂-iyvɨ i kasi fɨ̀m, a njoŋ na bu fì bayn wi, a mɨ̀njèyn chemlɨ sɨ iyvɨ, a nô ɨ̀fwo ɨ lvi vzɨ̀ a wu n-ghɨ iyvɨ ne’a, kɨ ɨ̀ jɨ̀m.
verses.niv: “Immediately after the distress of those days “ ‘the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from the sky, and the heavenly bodies will be shaken.’

verses.kom: Sɨ ibàm ateyn, a nchwæ ìgvì nɨ̀ Wâyn Wùl fvɨ iyvɨ, a ghelɨ tɨla’ tɨ mbzɨ nô ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m na luŋlɨ̂ dzɨ-à ɨlvɨ ta ghɨ yeyn Wâyn Wùl, wu su’î gvî antêynɨ̀ mbà’sɨ̀ iyvɨ, kelɨ àdya’ nɨ̀ ìbayn i gha’nɨ-i.
verses.niv: “At that time the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky, and all the nations of the earth will mourn. They will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky, with power and great glory.

verses.kom: Ghɨ læò toŋ ìsoŋ nô sɨ a ŋaŋ, a wù tum nchìsɨ ŋweyn kɨ̀ a tɨghaŋ tɨ iyvɨ nɨ̀ nse tɨ̀ jɨ̀m na sɨ jel yvɨ̀ŋtɨ̀ ghelɨ ghì a Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ chò’ meyn sɨ bœòsɨ̀.
verses.niv: And he will send his angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather his elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.

verses.kom: «Yì ye’i iwo sɨ̂ fɨ̀kâ’ fɨ fîksɨ̀. Yi n-yeyn nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha ta fɨ sɨ yvɨ gvî, yi nà kya na bèŋ sɨ chfɨ-à.
verses.niv: “Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its twigs get tender and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.

verses.kom: Yi ti n-ghɨ kɨmɨ ighel ta yì læò yeyn awo nâ kèynà nô à jɨ̀m ta kɨ n-gâyn. Yi yeyn, yi nà kya na ɨlvɨ igvì nɨ̀ Wâyn Wùl ɨ ba’sɨ meyn.
verses.niv: Even so, when you see all these things, you know that it is near, right at the door.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na, ghelɨ mbzɨ ghèyn lvɨ̂yn kà’ ghɨ bû læò kfɨ̀tɨ mèsì tà ka awo nâ kèyna gâyn nô à jɨ̀m.
verses.niv: I tell you the truth, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.

verses.kom: Iyvɨ i læò chwô, a nse chwo, mɨtì a iwo i faŋ tɨ̀ kfɨ̀nɨ antêynɨ̀ àwo ghè a mà bè.
verses.niv: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.

verses.kom: «Nô wùl ɨ̀ mò’ nɨn kya wi achi kèsa ɨlvɨ vzɨ̀ a ka awo nâ kèynà læ̂ gàyn ateyn. Nô mɨ nchìsɨ Fɨ̂yìnìsɨ̀ sɨ iyvɨ nɨ̀ Wàyn nɨn kya wi, a bu kɨ Bô.
verses.niv: “No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

verses.kom: Wâyn Wùl nɨn læò se sɨ gvì, a awo a na gâyn kɨmɨ ta kɨ n-læ nà gâyn ɨtu’ nɨ̀ Nuwà.
verses.niv: As it was in the days of Noah, so it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.

verses.kom: A nà n-ghɨ kɨmɨ a mɨchi nâ ghè jæ na ànkuŋ a gvi, ghelɨ yɨ-a, nyvɨ-a, ndû ghɨ̀kì, bɨmî ghɨ̀lum, fî fu woyn sɨ̂ ghɨ̀lum, sɨ ko’ sɨ chem achi ghè a Nuwà nɨn zɨ a abaŋ.
verses.niv: For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark;

verses.kom: Àŋena nà n-nî tì, kya wi iwo zɨ̀ a yi n-ghɨ sɨ gàyn sɨ chem achi ghè a ka ànkuŋ ateyn a gvi zùetɨ àŋena kɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m. Awo a læò nà gâyn kɨ tèyn ɨtu’ ta Wâyn Wùl nɨ̀n gvî.
verses.niv: and they knew nothing about what would happen until the flood came and took them all away. That is how it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.

verses.kom: À læò nà ghɨ ɨtu’ nâ ghè, a ghɨ̀lûmnɨ̀ na fêl a gvêyn ghɨ̀ bò, a ghɨ gvi lì ɨ̀mò’ ɨ̀ vìsi ɨ̀mò’.
verses.niv: Two men will be in the field; one will be taken and the other left.

verses.kom: Ghɨ̀ki læò nà gvâ àbayn iti ghɨ̀ bò, a ghɨ gvi lì ɨ̀mò’ ɨ̀ vìsi ɨ̀lvì.
verses.niv: Two women will be grinding with a hand mill; one will be taken and the other left.

verses.kom: Yì na du’ læ̂ gvɨ̂tɨ̀-à, bòm ta yi n-kya wi achi kì a Bôbo vzɨ læò gvî ateyn.
verses.niv: “Therefore keep watch, because you do not know on what day your Lord will come.

verses.kom: Yì na kya na bò ndo kæ sɨ nà kya ɨlvɨ vzɨ̀ a wùl ɨ choŋnɨ nɨn ghɨ sɨ gvì ateyn nɨ̀ntu’, wù bû bùni, a wù du’i kɨ̀ iyvɨ nà gvɨ̂tɨ̀-à, ka wu gvi kòl ndô ŋweyn.
verses.niv: But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what time of night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.

verses.kom: Yi ti n-dyêyn na nô zɨ̀ nɨn kelɨ sɨ nà du’ nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, gvɨ̂tɨ̀ kɨmɨ tì bòm ta Wâyn Wùl læò kasî gvî ɨlvɨ, yi kfâ’tɨ̀ wì na wù kà’ a wù gvi ateyn.»
verses.niv: So you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him.

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨ̀n fi meyn bɨf na, «Wùl ɨ̀ fèlɨnɨ vzɨ̀ a wù n-yvɨnɨ bò ìfèl nɨ̀ ŋweyn fî tofa nɨn ghɨ ɨ̀kfà? À n-ghɨ ɨvzɨ̂ a bò ìfèl nɨ̀ ŋweyn se sɨ ndù ijêl, ɨ̀ lèm ŋweyn asɨ ɨ̀ fu adya’ ta ka wù na tô’nɨ̀ nɨ̀ ndô ŋweyn, fu ɨ̀fwo ɨ yɨnɨ sɨ̂ ghelɨ ɨlvɨ ghè a àŋena nɨn kɨŋ ateyn.
verses.niv: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of the servants in his household to give them their food at the proper time?

verses.kom: Wùl ɨ̀ fèlɨnɨ àteyn nɨn nî wu nà saŋlɨ-à ɨlvɨ ta bò ìfèl nɨ̀ ŋweyn kàsi se sɨ gvì, wu nî ìwo zɨ̀ a wù tî bè.
verses.niv: It will be good for that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na, yi gàyn têyn, a bò ìfèl nâ vzɨ̀ lem ŋweyn na wù na tô’nɨ̀ nɨ̀ ɨ̀fwo ɨ ŋweyn nô ɨ̀ jɨ̀m.
verses.niv: I tell you the truth, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.

verses.kom: Mɨtì wùl nâ wèyn kæ sɨ nà ghɨ wul ɨ bɨ, ɨ̀ dù’ì ɨ̀ kfà’tɨ̀ kɨ̀ sɨ a ŋweyn a ngeŋ na, bò ìfèl nɨn lama jæ kasi sɨ kfa,
verses.niv: But suppose that servant is wicked and says to himself, ‘My master is staying away a long time,’

verses.kom: ɨ̀ zɨ̀tɨ̀ nà sɨ leŋ kɨ leŋ ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ ghɨ li ghì, yɨ-a, ŋêyn ɨ̀kôs ɨ mɨ̂lù’ ɨ nyvɨ-a,
verses.niv: and he then begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.

verses.kom: a bò ìfèl nɨ̀ ŋweyn læ̂ kàsi gvì achi a li-a, ɨlvɨ, wu kfâ’tɨ̀ wì na wù kà’ a wù kasî gvì ateyn,
verses.niv: The master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he is not aware of.

verses.kom: ɨ̀ fù nge’ sɨ̂ ŋweyn nô sɨ a ŋaŋ, fì we ŋweyn anòyn nɨ̀ ghɨ̀ kem kem nì ghɨli, a ŋêyn àŋena na luŋlɨ̂ dzɨ-à.»
verses.niv: He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
