verses.kom: Jisòs nɨ̀n fi meyn mò ngàyn ì lì ɨ bè na, «Wâyn Wùl ɨ̀ læò kasî gvi-à, a ɨfoyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì na ghɨ kɨmɨ ta fɨ̀tɨtɨ̂ fɨ ngòyn sɨ lisɨ ìvɨm a sɨ n-læ kfa ndù a ndô wi sɨ nà chitɨ lûm wùl ìjèl nɨ̀ àŋena ta wu nà n-gvî. Àŋena se sɨ gvì, ɨ lì lâm sɨ àŋena kɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m.
verses.niv: “At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

verses.kom: A ghɨ tì, àŋena ghɨ li, ghɨ̀ tâyn, ɨ tofa, ghɨli jɨ̂ŋtɨ̀-à.
verses.niv: Five of them were foolish and five were wise.

verses.kom: Ghɨ jɨŋtɨnɨ ghì ɨ se sɨ li lâm sɨ̂ àŋena ɨ faŋ tɨ̀ li kèlàsî na yì dvɨ.
verses.niv: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take any oil with them.

verses.kom: Mɨtì, ghɨ tofɨnɨ ghì ɨ lì ncheŋsɨ ɨ we kfeynsɨ kèlàsî ateyn.
verses.niv: The wise, however, took oil in jars along with their lamps.

verses.kom: Lûmwi lala chwòsɨ̀ ɨ̀ ni se sɨ gvì ma àŋena ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m sɨ buni-à, nê’ ɨ̀tu.
verses.niv: The bridegroom was a long time in coming, and they all became drowsy and fell asleep.

verses.kom: «Wù n-se sɨ gvi tî, ma à sɨ ghɨ nô antêynɨ̀ àsɨ, ghɨ nà sɨ jâŋ be na, ‹Lûmwi vzɨ̀ sɨ gvi-à, yì gvi yeyn ŋweyn!›
verses.niv: “At midnight the cry rang out: ‘Here's the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!’

verses.kom: Woynda ngòynsɨ̀ nâ ghì ɨ làli kɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m, ɨ ko’sɨ lâm sɨ̂ àŋena.
verses.niv: “Then all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps.

verses.kom: Ghɨ jɨŋtɨnɨ ghì ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ ghɨ tofɨnɨ ghì na, ‹Yì fu ghes nɨ̀ kèlàsî zɨ ì lì, lâm seysɨ sɨ lɨmâ ndu-à.›
verses.niv: The foolish ones said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil; our lamps are going out.’

verses.kom: Àŋena tuynsɨ ɨ bè na, ‹Kèlàsî àteyn kà’ yi bû kfeyn sɨ̂ ghesɨ̀nà ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m, yì kwo ndù alè’ a bey’lɨnɨ-a, ɨ̀ yuyn ɨzɨ̂ afu.›
verses.niv: “ ‘No,’ they replied, ‘there may not be enough for both us and you. Instead, go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.’

verses.kom: Àŋena se sɨ ndù, lûmwi ɨ gvì, ŋêyn ɨghî a ghɨ nì nà sɨ du’a, ma ghɨ ba’tɨ meyn ɨ ndù ɨ zɨ sɨ a ndo ghè a ghɨ nà n-yɨ malâ àteyn, ɨ kɨ̀ŋ ɨ fò ɨ̀chfɨ̂ ɨ ndo.
verses.niv: “But while they were on their way to buy the oil, the bridegroom arrived. The virgins who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet. And the door was shut.

verses.kom: «Ngòynsɨ li sìsɨ̀ a sɨ nì ndù sɨ yuyn kèlàsî tì ɨ ni kasi gvì ɨ nà sɨ jaŋà bê na, ‹Bô, Bôbo, cho’ ɨchfɨ ndo sɨ̂ ghès.›
verses.niv: “Later the others also came. ‘Sir! Sir!’ they said. ‘Open the door for us!’

verses.kom: Lûmwi vzɨ̀ ɨ bèynsɨ kɨ na, ‹Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’, mɨ n-kya wi zɨ.›»
verses.niv: “But he replied, ‘I tell you the truth, I don't know you.’

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ taŋi tèyn ɨ kæ bè na, «Yì na du’ læ̂ gvɨ̂tɨ̀-à, bòm ta yi n-kya wi achi kèsa ɨ̀lvɨ vzɨ̀ a Wâyn Wùl læò kasi gvî ateyn.»
verses.niv: “Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour.

verses.kom: Jisòs nɨ̀n fi meyn mò ngàyn ì lì ɨ bè na, «Ɨfoyn ɨ Fɨ̂yìnì læò nà ghɨ kɨmɨ tèyn ta fɨ̀tɨtɨ̂ fɨ wûl ɨ̀ lvì a wu n-læ nà ndû ijêl ɨ jàŋ ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ nɨ̀ ŋweyn ɨ fu ɨfwo ɨ ŋweyn na àŋena yisi nà kini-à.
verses.niv: “Again, it will be like a man going on a journey, who called his servants and entrusted his property to them.

verses.kom: Wù n-fu meyn nkamsɨ ɨkwo sɨ̀ tâyn sɨ̂ wùl ɨ̀ lvì, ɨ fu sɨ̀ bò sɨ̂ ɨ̀lvì, ɨ fi fu ìmò’ sɨ̂ ɨ̀lvì, fu nô mɨ sɨ ndà, kɨ̀ ighel ta wu nà n-yeyn na wù kà’ a wù to’nɨ nɨ̀ ɨ̀ŋweyn, ɨ fu tî ɨ lù ɨ ndù ìjêl i ŋweyn.
verses.niv: To one he gave five talents of money, to another two talents, and to another one talent, each according to his ability. Then he went on his journey.

verses.kom: Nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, wùl ɨ̀ fèlɨnɨ vzɨ̀ a ghɨ n-fu nkam sɨ̀ tâyn sɨ̂ ŋweyn tì ɨ se’ alè’ a mbêy’lɨ̀, sæ læ fvɨ̀ atu ɨ̀kwo nɨ̀ ŋweyn kɨ̀mɨ nkam sɨ̀ tâyn.
verses.niv: The man who had received the five talents went at once and put his money to work and gained five more.

verses.kom: Ɨvzɨ̂ a ghɨ n-fu nkam sɨ̀ bò sɨ̂ ŋweyn tì ɨ fèl ɨ boŋ keli sæ, kɨ̀mɨ nkam sɨ̀ bò.
verses.niv: So also, the one with the two talents gained two more.

verses.kom: Mɨtì, ɨvzɨ̂ a ghɨ n-fu nkam ì mò’ sɨ̂ ŋweyn tì ɨ ndù ɨ tɨm ibɨ ɨ lèytɨ̀ nkam ɨ̀kwo nɨ̀ bò ìfèl nɨ̀ ŋweyn zɨ̀ ateyn.
verses.niv: But the man who had received the one talent went off, dug a hole in the ground and hid his master's money.

verses.kom: «Bò ìfèl nâ vzɨ̀ ɨ chi nô sɨ a ndyèyn ɨ læ kasi kfa gvì ɨ jàŋtɨ̀ àŋena sɨ yvɨ nâ, àŋena tî yìsi ɨ̀ fèlɨ̀ ti nɨ̀ ɨ̀kwo ɨ̀ vzɨ a.
verses.niv: “After a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.

verses.kom: Wùl ɨ̀ nkam sɨ̀ tâyn vzɨ̀ ɨ se sɨ gvì ɨ lì ɨ ba’sɨ nkam sɨ̀ tâyn sìsɨ̀ a wù tî sæ atu ɨ̀kwo ghè a ghɨ tî fu sɨ̂ ŋweyn ɨ gvì ɨ bè na, ‹Bô, yeyna! Wà tî fu nkamsɨ ɨkwo sɨ̂ mà sɨ̀ tâyn. Ma fi meyn kèli kɨ̀mɨ nkam sɨ̀ tâyn atu àteyn sɨ a sæ.›
verses.niv: The man who had received the five talents brought the other five. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with five talents. See, I have gained five more.’

verses.kom: Bò ìfèl nɨ̀ ŋweyn nâ vzɨ̀ ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, ‹Wà ni meyn kɨ̀ nô a jûŋ. Wà n-ghɨ kɨ nô wul ɨ̀ fèlɨnɨ ɨ̀ jùŋ, fi tô’nɨ̀-à. Wà ti meyn tò’nɨ̀ nɨ̀ mɨ̀fôlɨ̀ ɨ̀n telâ. Mà ti n-lêm và lvɨ̂yn atu ɨ̀fwo ɨ dvɨnɨ. Gvi, zɨ̂ bò ìfèl nɨ̀ và na dêŋsɨ̀-à.›
verses.niv: “His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Come and share your master's happiness!’

verses.kom: Wùl ɨ fèlɨnɨ vzɨ̀ a ghɨ n-fu nkamsɨ ɨkwo sɨ̂ ŋweyn sɨ̀ bò tî ɨ boŋ gvì ɨ bè na, ‹Bô, wà tî fu nkamsɨ ɨkwo sɨ̂ mà sɨ̀ bò. Yeyna, ma keli meyn sɨ̀ bò atu àteyn sɨ a sæ.›
verses.niv: “The man with the two talents also came. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with two talents; see, I have gained two more.’

verses.kom: Bò ìfèl nɨ̀ ŋweyn nâ vzɨ̀ ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, ‹Wà ni meyn kɨ̀ nô a jûŋ. Wà n-ghɨ kɨ nô wul ɨ̀ fèlɨnɨ ɨ̀ jùŋ, fi tô’nɨ̀-à. Wà ti meyn tò’nɨ̀ nɨ̀ mɨ̀fôlɨ̀ ɨ̀n telâ. Mà ti n-lêm và lvɨ̂yn atû ɨ̀fwo ɨ dvɨnɨ. Gvi, zɨ̂ bò ìfèl nɨ̀ và na dêŋsɨ̀-à.›
verses.niv: “His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Come and share your master's happiness!’

verses.kom: Wùl vzɨ̀ a wu n-fsɨ nkam ì mò’ tî ɨ gvì ɨ bè ɨ ndu kɨ na, ‹Bô, mɨ n-kya na wà n-ghɨ tèyn bema, faŋ wi tɨ̀ ghayn bùla wà tî fèl, faŋ wi tɨ̀ kfì bùla wà tî tò’.
verses.niv: “Then the man who had received the one talent came. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘I knew that you are a hard man, harvesting where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed.

verses.kom: À ti iwo zɨ̀ a mà tî fàyn vâ, ɨ̀ lì nkam ɨ̀ zyâ ɨ̀ tɨm alê’ ɨ̀ lèytɨ̀ ateyn. Kasi kù ɨkwo ɨ̀ va.›
verses.niv: So I was afraid and went out and hid your talent in the ground. See, here is what belongs to you.’

verses.kom: Bò ìfèl nɨ̀ ŋweyn nâ vzɨ̀ ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, ‹Wà n-ghɨ kɨ nô wul ɨ̀ fèlɨnɨ ɨ bɨ, fî yoli-à! Wà tî nà kya kɨ nô tèyn na mɨ n-ghayna tɨ̀ fèl, kfi-à tɨ̀ tò’,
verses.niv: “His master replied, ‘You wicked, lazy servant! So you knew that I harvest where I have not sown and gather where I have not scattered seed?

verses.kom: à tî nì ghà na ka wà lem ɨkwo ɨ̀ wom a ndo ɨ̀kwo, mà læ̂ gvì se sɨ lì, lì bà’sɨ nɨ̀ sæ a?›
verses.niv: Well then, you should have put my money on deposit with the bankers, so that when I returned I would have received it back with interest.

verses.kom: Wu taŋi tèyn, ɨ kasi ɨ be kɨ sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghɨ felɨnɨ nɨ̀ ŋweyn ghɨ li na, ‹Yì fsɨ nkam àteyn sɨ̂ ŋweyn ɨ̀ fu kfèynsɨ sɨ̂ wùl vzɨ̀ a wù n-kelɨ nkamsɨ ìvɨm tì.
verses.niv: “ ‘Take the talent from him and give it to the one who has the ten talents.

verses.kom: Bòm ta, à sɨ kelɨ mɨ ndà, a ghɨ fu kfèynsɨ sɨ̂ ŋweyn, a wù na tô’ kelɨ-a, à na wo mɨ ndà, a ghɨ fsɨ nô mɨ atelâ kì a wù n-kelɨ.
verses.niv: For everyone who has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken from him.

verses.kom: Yi fsɨ ɨ̀kwo ateyn, yi làŋ ɨ fvɨ̀sɨ ndù nɨ̀ àfo ateyn a abe a fɨmnɨ-a, alè’ ghè a ghɨ n-luŋlɨ dzɨ̂ afu tì.›
verses.niv: And throw that worthless servant outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

verses.kom: «À læò nà ghɨ ta Wâyn Wùl nɨ̀n gvî ta fòyn ŋêyn nchìsɨ Fɨ̂yìnìsɨ̀ nô sɨ̀ jɨ̀m, a wù du’i achɨ a tɨ̂fòyn nɨ̀ ŋweyn antêynɨ̀ ìbayn i gha’nɨ-i ghê a yi n-ghɨ iyvɨ.
verses.niv: “When the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the angels with him, he will sit on his throne in heavenly glory.

verses.kom: A ghelɨ tɨla’ tɨ mbzɨ gvi yvɨ̀ŋtɨ̀ a ŋweyn asɨ, kɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m, a wù gwosɨ àŋena inôyn ì bò, kɨ̀mɨ ta nchì bzɨsɨ nɨn nî yi gwòsɨ̀ njɨ̀sɨ̀ nɨ̀ bzɨsɨ ndoŋ, ɨ̀ lèm ghelɨ àtì-ati abàs ɨkœ ɨ two ɨ̀ lèm ghelɨ ghɨ bɨ abàs ɨkœ nɨ̂nkœò.
verses.niv: All the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate the people one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
He will put the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.

verses.kom: A Fòyn kæ be sɨ̂ ghelɨ àtì-ati ghì a ghɨ n-ti a ŋweyn ɨkœ ɨ two na, ‹Zɨ̀ ghêyn a Bò wom bòysɨ meyn tèyn, yì zɨ gvì isas isa’ nɨ̀ ŋweyn, nà yɨ njùŋ zɨ̀ a wu n-læ faytɨ sɨ̂ zɨ̀ kɨ̀ ta mbzɨ nɨ̀n læ zɨ̀tɨ.
verses.niv: “Then the King will say to those on his right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by my Father; take your inheritance, the kingdom prepared for you since the creation of the world.

verses.kom: Bòm ta a nà n-ghɨ ta jèŋ nɨn yafɨ ma, yi fu afo ma yɨ, ɨtoŋ mu ɨ nà yum mà, yi fu mu, ma nyvɨ. Mɨ nà n-ghɨ wul ɨ̀ gvinɨ, yi lì mà a yi a ndosɨ.
verses.niv: For I was hungry and you gave me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me something to drink, I was a stranger and you invited me in,

verses.kom: Mɨ nà n-ghɨ nɨ̀ ìsas iyum i, yi fu ndzɨsɨ na mà tam, ɨ nà ko’i-à, yi tò’nɨ̀ nɨ̀ mà, ghɨ fò mà a ncha’, yi nà kinî mà.›
verses.niv: I needed clothes and you clothed me, I was sick and you looked after me, I was in prison and you came to visit me.’

verses.kom: A ghelɨ àtì-ati nâ ghèyn kæ bɨf na, ‹Bô, ghès nɨn læ yeyn wo vâ, jèŋ ɨ yafɨ và, ghès ɨ fu afo na wà yɨ-a, ɨ yeyn wo vâ, ɨtoŋ mu ɨ yum và, ɨ fu mu na wà nyvɨ-a?
verses.niv: “Then the righteous will answer him, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you something to drink?

verses.kom: Wa nà n-ghɨ wo wul ɨ̀ gvinɨ, ghès ɨ lì và a ghès a ndosɨ a, ɨ nà ghɨ wo nɨ̀ ìsas iyum i, ghès ɨ fu ndzɨsɨ na wà tam a?
verses.niv: When did we see you a stranger and invite you in, or needing clothes and clothe you?

verses.kom: Wa nà n-ko’î wo, ghès ɨ gvì sɨ tò’nɨ nɨ̀ và a, ghɨ wo a ndô ncha’, ghès ɨ gvì sɨ kini vâ a?›
verses.niv: When did we see you sick or in prison and go to visit you?’

verses.kom: A fòyn kæ bè na, ‹Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na, nô mɨ ghà vzɨ̂ a yi n-læ ni sɨ̂ ɨ̀mò’ vzɨ̂ a wù læ ɨ̀ gò’sɨ̀ antêynɨ̀ nɨ̀ woyn-nà ghem afêyn nɨn ghɨ ma yi n-læ nì sɨ̂ mà.›
verses.niv: “The King will reply, ‘I tell you the truth, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of mine, you did for me.’

verses.kom: «A fòyn taŋi tî ɨ̀ kæ be sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghɨ bɨ ghì a ŋweyn ɨkœ nɨ̂nkœò na, ‹Yì le’ sɨ a ma asɨ, zɨ̀ ghêyn a Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ tè meyn tèyn. Yì ndu ɨ̀ zɨ ɨvɨ̀s ghê a wu n-bali, ghɨ wi sɨ læò sɨ lɨma, ma ghɨ fàytɨ sɨ̂ dêblɨ̀ ŋêyn nchìsɨ ŋweynsɨ.
verses.niv: “Then he will say to those on his left, ‘Depart from me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.

verses.kom: Bòm ta a nà n-ghɨ ta jèŋ nɨn yafɨ ma, yi teyn na yi n-fu wi afo na mà yɨ, ɨtoŋ mu ɨ nà yum mà, yi teyn na yi n-fu wi mu sɨ̂ mà.
verses.niv: For I was hungry and you gave me nothing to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me nothing to drink,

verses.kom: Mɨ nà n-ghɨ wul ɨ̀ gvinɨ, yi teyn na yi n-lî wì ma a yi a ndosɨ. Mɨ nà n-ghɨ nɨ̀ ìsas iyum i, yi teyn na yi n-fu wi ndzɨsɨ na mà tam, ɨ nà ko’i-à, yi teyn na yi n-tô’nɨ̀ wi nɨ̀ mà, ghɨ fò mà a ncha’, yi teyn na yi n-gvî kinî wì ma.›
verses.niv: I was a stranger and you did not invite me in, I needed clothes and you did not clothe me, I was sick and in prison and you did not look after me.’

verses.kom: A ghelɨ ghɨ bɨ nâ ghì boŋ ɨ̀ bɨf na, ‹Bô, ghès nɨn læ yeyn wo vâ, jèŋ ɨ yafɨ và, ɨtoŋ mu ɨ yumî và, wa ghɨ wul ɨ̀ gvinɨ, ghɨ nɨ̀ ìsas iyum i, ko’i-à, ghɨ a ndô ncha’, ghès ɨ faŋ tɨ̀ gàmtɨ vâ a?›
verses.niv: “They also will answer, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or needing clothes or sick or in prison, and did not help you?’

verses.kom: A wù be na, ‹Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na, nô mɨ ghà vzɨ̂ a yi n-læ teyn na yi nî wì sɨ̂ ɨ̀mò’ vzɨ̂ a wù læ gò’sɨ̀ antêynɨ̀ nɨ̀ woyn-nà ghem ghèyn nɨn ghɨ ma yi n-læ teyn na yi nî wì sɨ̂ mà.›
verses.niv: “He will reply, ‘I tell you the truth, whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for me.’

verses.kom: A fòyn taŋi têyn ɨ̀ kæ bè na, àŋena lu ɨ̀ ndù ɨ zɨ antêynɨ̀ nge’ ghè a yì faŋ meyn kɨ̀ samo’, ghelɨ àtì-ati ghì keli ichi zɨ̀ a yi læò mæ wi.»
verses.niv: “Then they will go away to eternal punishment, but the righteous to eternal life.”

verses.kom: A nà n-ghɨ ta Jisòs yè’i meyn mèsì àwo nâ kèynà, wu bè sɨ̂ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ na,
verses.niv: When Jesus had finished saying all these things, he said to his disciples,

verses.kom: «Yi n-kya na à faŋ kɨ̀ mɨchi ɨ̀m bò lvɨ̂yn ta ka ghɨ zɨtɨ sɨ yɨ mɨchi mɨ̀ Ìyà’sɨ, ghɨ ghɨ sɨ ghal sɨ fu Wâyn Wùl, na ghɨ bayntɨ a ànwâmnɨ̀.»
verses.niv: “As you know, the Passover is two days away –and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified.”

verses.kom: A nà n-ghɨ tì, ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì sɨ gha’nɨsɨ ŋêyn chye’sɨ ila’sɨ ɨ ghal nchɨ̀yntɨ abe nɨ̀ ngàŋ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì i ngaŋtɨnɨ zɨ̀ a ghɨ nà n-toŋtɨ na Kàyafàs,
verses.niv: Then the chief priests and the elders of the people assembled in the palace of the high priest, whose name was Caiaphas,

verses.kom: sɨ ba’tɨ dzɨ sɨ nya’tɨ sɨ ghal Jisòs ateyn sɨ zue.
verses.niv: and they plotted to arrest Jesus in some sly way and kill him.

verses.kom: Àŋena ba’tɨ mèsì, ɨ fi kasi be kɨ̀ sɨ̂ àŋena ngeŋsɨ na, «Ka ghesɨ̀nà nɨ̂n ghàl ŋweyn a mɨchi mɨ̀ Ìyà’sɨ afêyn bu tì, a ghelɨ yeyn ɨ̀ làysɨ̀ ìnû.»
verses.niv: “But not during the Feast,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ ndù a Betanì ɨ nà ghɨ a ndo nɨ̀ wùl, ghɨ toŋtɨ̂ na Saymùn, ma wu n-læ meyn ko’i nɨ̀ ànsàsì à,
verses.niv: While Jesus was in Bethany in the home of a man known as Simon the Leper,

verses.kom: wùl ɨ wi ɨ̀ lvì ɨ gvì nɨ̀ fɨ̀nshɨ̀ŋ fɨ li fɨ, ma ghɨ fàytɨ nɨ̀ ngò’ ì lì ghɨ toŋtɨ̂ na àlàbastà, ayisi a lɨmtɨnɨ-a ɨ ghɨ ateyn, to ɨkwo nô a jûŋ, ɨ bò atu nɨ̀ Jisòs, wu du’ alè’ a yɨnɨ-a.
verses.niv: a woman came to him with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume, which she poured on his head as he was reclining at the table.

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ Jisòs-sɨ̀ ɨ yeyn tî, iwo ateyn i ɨ nà sɨ yaf àŋena, ghɨ bɨf na, «Wù ti n-bebsɨ ti ayisi tèyn a?
verses.niv: When the disciples saw this, they were indignant. “Why this waste?” they asked.

verses.kom: Ghɨ nà n-kâ’ a ghɨ bey’lɨ ayisi nâ kèynà sɨ ɨkwo, wu dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn, ɨ̀ fu ɨkwo ateyn sɨ̂ ghelɨ ànfɨf.»
verses.niv: “This perfume could have been sold at a high price and the money given to the poor.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ keli ìwo zɨ̀ a àŋena nɨn kfâ’tɨ̀ ɨ kæ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yi n-fu nge’ ɨ̀ ghà sɨ̂ wùl ɨ wi wèyn a? Wù ni meyn ìwo sɨ̂ mà, yi jôf kɨ tèyn.
verses.niv: Aware of this, Jesus said to them, “Why are you bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful thing to me.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ànfɨf na lum ghɨ kɨ ghɨ a yi antêynɨ̀, mɨtì ma ghɨ wi sɨ faŋ kɨ ghesɨ̀nà amo’.
verses.niv: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have me.

verses.kom: Wù bò àyisi nâ kèynà a ma ɨwùyn têyn sɨ faytɨ ma na mà kfeyn igvɨ̀mì.
verses.niv: When she poured this perfume on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na ghɨ na fê’tɨ̀ nô mɨ wo ntum ì jùŋ a mbzɨ, ghɨ boŋ fè’tɨ̀ ìwo nâ yèynì a wùl ɨ wi nâ wèyn nì têyn, ta ka ghelɨ na kfâ’tɨ̀ ŋweyn.»
verses.niv: I tell you the truth, wherever this gospel is preached throughout the world, what she has done will also be told, in memory of her.”

verses.kom: Wul ɨ̀ mò’ antêynɨ̀ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ Jisòs njvàsɨ̀ bò, ghɨ toŋtɨ na Judas Ìskalìyòt ɨ lù ɨ ndù ɨ yeyn ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì sɨ gha’nɨsɨ
verses.niv: Then one of the Twelve –the one called Judas Iscariot –went to the chief priests

verses.kom: ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Mà ti kæ gàmtɨ̀, yi ghal Jisòs, a yì fu gha sɨ̂ mà a?» Àŋena taŋtɨ fu asɨ ɨkwo ɨ silvà sɨ ŋweyn, mɨ̀vɨm ɨ̀n tal.
verses.niv: and asked, “What are you willing to give me if I hand him over to you?” So they counted out for him thirty silver coins.

verses.kom: Judàs ɨ zɨ̀tɨ kɨ ɨlvɨ nâ ghè ɨ nà sɨ kɨŋ dzɨ sɨ bey’lɨ Jisòs.
verses.niv: From then on Judas watched for an opportunity to hand him over.

verses.kom: A nà n-bu ghɨ kɨ achi a kɨ asɨ-a, a mɨchi ghè a ghɨ nà n-yɨ abayn ateyn bùla fɨ̀shɨ̀k, njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ Jisòs-sɨ̀ ɨ gvi bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Wà n-kɨŋ na ghès ndu ɨ̀ fàytɨ wo ɨfwo ɨ yɨnɨ Iya’sɨ sɨ̂ và a?»
verses.niv: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Where do you want us to make preparations for you to eat the Passover?”

verses.kom: Wu bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yì zɨ ndù antêynɨ̀ ntè’ ɨ̀ yèyn wul ɨ̀ lvì afu ɨ̀ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, ‹Ndyèynsɨ̀ bè na ɨlvɨ ikfɨ nɨ̀ zɨ̀ ɨ ba’sɨ meyn, ŋêyn njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ ghɨ sɨ yɨ achi Iya’sɨ a wa ndo.›»
verses.niv: He replied, “Go into the city to a certain man and tell him, ‘The Teacher says: My appointed time is near. I am going to celebrate the Passover with my disciples at your house.’ ”

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ Jisòs-sɨ̀ ɨ ni kɨ ta wù bè, ɨ zɨ ndù antêynɨ̀ ntè’ ɨ faytɨ ɨ̀fwo ɨ yɨnɨ Iya’sɨ afu.
verses.niv: So the disciples did as Jesus had directed them and prepared the Passover.

verses.kom: A ni nà ghɨ aleŋ ɨlvɨ ikfa, Jisòs ŋêyn njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ njvàsɨ̀ bò ɨ dù’ì ɨ se sɨ yɨ,
verses.niv: When evening came, Jesus was reclining at the table with the Twelve.

verses.kom: wu bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ samo’ na wùl ɨ̀ mò’ nɨn ghɨ antêynɨ̀ nɨ̀ zɨ̀, ghɨ sɨ bey’lɨ ma.»
verses.niv: And while they were eating, he said, “I tell you the truth, one of you will betray me.”

verses.kom: Iwo ateyn i ɨ fu nge’ sɨ̂ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ nô sɨ a ŋaŋ, àŋena nà sɨ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn kɨ fɨ̀mo’ fɨ̀mò’ na, «Bô, à n-ghɨ mà ma?»
verses.niv: They were very sad and began to say to him one after the other, “Surely not I, Lord?”

verses.kom: Wu bè na, «À n-ghɨ kɨ nô wul ma ghesɨ̀ ŋweyn yɨ meyn akaŋ à mò’, wu ghɨ sɨ bey’lɨ ma.
verses.niv: Jesus replied, “The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with me will betray me.

verses.kom: Wâyn Wùl nɨn ndû kɨ ighel ta ghɨ sɨ ghɨ ma ghɨ nya’ meyn a Ŋwà’lɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì. Mɨtì, nge’ i gha’nɨ ghɨ sɨ̂ wùl vzɨ̀ a wu n-bey’lɨ ŋweyn! Yi nà n-kâ’ a yi na kwo jofà, ɨlvɨ ta ghɨ nà n-faŋ tɨ̀ bzɨ ŋweyn sakos.»
verses.niv: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about him. But woe to that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would be better for him if he had not been born.”

verses.kom: Nô Judàs vzɨ̀ a wu nà n-ghɨ sɨ bey’lɨ ŋweyn ɨ boŋ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Ndyèynsɨ̀, à n-ghɨ mà ma?» Wu bè na, «Yi n-ghɨ kɨ tì ta wà bè.»
verses.niv: Then Judas, the one who would betray him, said, “Surely not I, Rabbi?” Jesus answered, “Yes, it is you.”

verses.kom: Àŋena ni se sɨ yɨ, Jisòs ɨ lì àbayn ɨ fu àyòŋnɨ̀ sɨ̂ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ ɨ be’lɨ ɨ fu sɨ̂ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ bè na, «Yì ku ɨ̀ yɨ. Ɨwêyn nɨn ghɨ ɨ̀wûyn wom.»
verses.niv: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to his disciples, saying, “Take and eat; this is my body.”

verses.kom: Wu fi lì bôm mɨ̀lù’ ɨ fu àyòŋnɨ̀ sɨ̂ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ ɨ fu sɨ̂ àŋena, ɨ bè na, «Yì nyvɨ nô zɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m.
verses.niv: Then he took the cup, gave thanks and offered it to them, saying, “Drink from it, all of you.

verses.kom: À n-ghɨ mɨ̀lûŋ mêm mzɨ̀ a mà sfɨ̀s sɨ̂ ndvɨ̀ sɨ chɨl mɨkâyn mɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì ta ka fɨ lesɨ ɨ̀ fu mbɨsɨ àŋena.
verses.niv: This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.

verses.kom: Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na mà læò bu fì nyvɨ wi mɨlû’ nâ mèyn sɨ chem achi ghè a ka mà kasî nyvɨ̀ sɨ a nfɨ ghesɨ̀nà alè’ ɨfòyn nɨ̀ Bò wom.»
verses.niv: I tell you, I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father's kingdom.”

verses.kom: Àŋena yɨ mèsì, ɨ yem njàŋ ɨ fvɨ ko’ atû kfɨ̂yn Olìfsɨ̀.
verses.niv: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ kæ bè na, «A nì nà ghɨ nɨ̀ntu’ kɨ̀ nô layn, a nô zɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m le’ vìsi mà, kɨ̀ ighel ta ghɨ sɨ ghɨ ma ghɨ nya’ meyn a Ŋwà’lɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì na, ‹Mɨ nì zue nchì bzɨsɨ, a sɨ gwosɨ.›
verses.niv: Then Jesus told them, “This very night you will all fall away on account of me, for it is written: “ ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’

verses.kom: Mɨtì, a à na ghɨ ta ghɨ làysɨ ma sɨ ikfɨ, a mà ndu a Galìlî sɨ a yi asɨ.»
verses.niv: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”

verses.kom: Bità ɨ bè na, «Ghɨ n-ghɨ sɨ le’ sɨ visi mɨ và ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m, ma bû læò mòm sɨ ateyn.»
verses.niv: Peter replied, “Even if all fall away on account of you, I never will.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ và samo’ na lûm ngvɨ nɨn nì se sɨ toŋ nɨ̀ntu’ layn ma wà mo meyn mà ìngal ì tal.»
verses.niv: “I tell you the truth,” Jesus answered, “this very night, before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times.”

verses.kom: Bità ɨ fi bè na, «Mɨ n-ghɨ mɨ sɨ kfɨ kfɨ ghesɨ̀và, ma bu læò mò vâ.» Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ boŋ be ndu kɨ tî sɨ̀ jɨ̀m.
verses.niv: But Peter declared, “Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you.” And all the other disciples said the same.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ lù ŋêyn njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ ndù alè’, ghɨ toŋtɨ̂ na Gètsemanì, ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yì du’i afêyn, mà ndu afi ɨ̀ jèm.»
verses.niv: Then Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and he said to them, “Sit here while I go over there and pray.”

verses.kom: Wu bè tì, ɨ se sɨ ndù ɨ lì Bità ŋêyn woyn Zebedì, ghɨ̀ bò, ɨ nà sɨ ndu-à; awo a zɨ̀tɨ̀ sɨ nà fu nge’ a ŋweyn ikfà’tɨ̀ nô sɨ a ŋaŋ.
verses.niv: He took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee along with him, and he began to be sorrowful and troubled.

verses.kom: Wu kæ be sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Awo a li-a nɨn fu nge’ a ma ikfà’tɨ̀ nô sɨ a ŋaŋ, ma kɨ kà’ a kɨ zue ma. Yì du’i kɨ̀ afêyn, nà boŋ gvɨ̂tɨ̀-à, mà gvi.»
verses.niv: Then he said to them, “My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with me.”

verses.kom: Wu bè tì, ɨ fi kɨŋtɨ ɨ ndù asɨ sɨ ilæ tèyn ɨ nyɨ̀ŋi ndù àkfɨ̀-akfɨ ɨ nà sɨ jemà, bê na, «Bò wom, yi na boynɨ-à wa fsɨ bôm nge’ yèyn sɨ a ma awu. Nô mɨ tì, ni kɨ iwo zɨ̀ a yi n-kfeynɨ sɨ̂ và, ka wa n-nì iyemi.»
verses.niv: Going a little farther, he fell with his face to the ground and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, may this cup be taken from me. Yet not as I will, but as you will.”

verses.kom: Wu jèm ɨ mèsì ɨ se sɨ ndù ma njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweyn sìsɨ̀ sɨ̀ tal sɨ buni-à. Wu bɨf sɨ̂ Bità na, «Ba yi ti n-ghɨ na yi nà n-kâ’ yi bû boŋ dù’ì iyvɨ ghesɨ̀nà ɨ̀ nà gvɨ̂tɨ̀ kɨ sɨ a fɨ̂lè’nɨ̀ tèyn ma?
verses.niv: Then he returned to his disciples and found them sleeping. “Could you men not keep watch with me for one hour?” he asked Peter.

verses.kom: Yì na gvɨ̂tɨ̀-à, jemà ka imôm ì gvi sɨ̂ zɨ̀. Mɨ n-kya na à n-ghɨ a yi ikfà’tɨ̀, yi kôŋ sɨ ni ta mà bè, mɨtì a bu àdya’ a yi ɨwùyn.»
verses.niv: “Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the body is weak.”

verses.kom: Wu fi kasi lù ɨ ndù ɨ nà sɨ jemà bê na, «Bò wom, wà na ghɨ wi sɨ fsɨ bôm nge’ yèyn sɨ̂ mà, ma wà ti n-bê na, mɨ n-kelɨ kɨ sɨ nyvɨ, wa nì, yi kfeyn kɨ̀ ta wà n-kɨŋ.»
verses.niv: He went away a second time and prayed, “My Father, if it is not possible for this cup to be taken away unless I drink it, may your will be done.”

verses.kom: Wu jèm tì, ɨ se sɨ kasi sɨ gvì ɨ fi yeyn àŋena, ghɨ bunî kɨ buni bòm ta mbunisɨ nà n-sû ghɨ kɨ nô ghɨ a àŋena asɨ.
verses.niv: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy.

verses.kom: Wu fi kasi ɨ lu kɨ lu ɨ ndu ɨ nà sɨ fì jemà, na à na sɨ ghɨ ìngal ì tal, bê kɨ àwo kì a wù nì be sɨ asɨ.
verses.niv: So he left them and went away once more and prayed the third time, saying the same thing.

verses.kom: Wu n-jem meyn mèsì ɨ kasi ndù ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Ba yi ti n-ghɨ na yi bu tô’ bunî kɨ buni, yvɨ̂tɨ̀-à? Yì na kya na ɨlvɨ kfeyn meyn. Ghɨ sɨ kɨŋ sɨ fu Wâyn Wùl sɨ̂ ghelɨ awo a bɨ-a.
verses.niv: Then he returned to the disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Look, the hour is near, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

verses.kom: Yì lali ghɨ lu. Yì yeyna. Ɨwêyn nɨ̀n gvî wul vzɨ̀ a wù n-bey’lɨ ma.»
verses.niv: Rise, let us go! Here comes my betrayer!”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ nà bu taŋî kɨ taŋi, Judàs vzɨ̀ a à nà n-ghɨ kɨmɨ wul ɨ̀ mò’ antêynɨ̀ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweyn njvàsɨ̀ bò tî, ɨ ko’ ɨ gvì ŋêyn ànôyn a ghêl à, kɨ dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn, ghɨ kelɨ tɨ̀fô nɨ̀ mbàŋsɨ̀. A ghɨ tì, ma à tum ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì sɨ gha’nɨsɨ nɨ̀ chye’sɨ ila’sɨ, tum àŋena,
verses.niv: While he was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived. With him was a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and the elders of the people.

verses.kom: ghɨ gvî tì wùl vzɨ̀ a wù n-bey’lɨ ŋweyn ɨ ghɨ ma wù fu meyn nchwæ sɨ̂ ànoyn ateyn a ɨ bè na, «Ma nî bà’nɨ nô mɨ ndà, yi keli na à n-ghɨ wul ɨ vzɨ̀ a yi n-kɨŋ, yi ghal kɨ ghal.»
verses.niv: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The one I kiss is the man; arrest him.”

verses.kom: Judàs ɨ gvì tì ɨ nayn ndu kɨ sɨ̂ Jisòs ɨ bè na, «Mà weyn n-toŋtɨ a Ndyèynsɨ̀!» nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha ɨ ba’nɨ kɨ ba’nɨ ŋweyn.
verses.niv: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Ni kɨ iwo zɨ̀ a wà gvì sɨ nì a ba.» Nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, ghelɨ nâ ghì ɨ gvi ghal kɨ ghalɨ ŋweyn.
verses.niv: Jesus replied, “Friend, do what you came for.” Then the men stepped forward, seized Jesus and arrested him.

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀ ìbam nɨ̀ Jisòs ì lì ɨ cho’ ifô i ŋweyn ɨ ka’ teyn atuŋlɨ a wul ɨ̀ fèlɨnɨ nɨ̀ ngàŋ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì i ngaŋtɨnɨ.
verses.niv: With that, one of Jesus' companions reached for his sword, drew it out and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Kasi we ifô ì zæ sɨ abu’lɨ. À n-ka’lɨ mɨ ndà ghelɨ, a wù læ̂ kfɨ, ma ghɨ ka’ kɨ̀mɨ ka’ ŋweyn.
verses.niv: “Put your sword back in its place,” Jesus said to him, “for all who draw the sword will die by the sword.

verses.kom: Ba yi n-kya na a nà n-ghɨ inû, ma kâ’ a mà chwotɨ, a Bò wom fu nchìsɨ ŋweyn na sɨ nu sɨ̂ mà, sɨ bɨm dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn.
verses.niv: Do you think I cannot call on my Father, and he will at once put at my disposal more than twelve legions of angels?

verses.kom: Mɨtì, ma mà nì têyn, yi bû lùynsɨ ìwo zɨ̀ a ghɨ sɨ ghɨ ma ghɨ nya’ meyn a Ŋwà’lɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì.»
verses.niv: But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen in this way?”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ kasi bɨf sɨ̂ ànôyn kì na, «A yì ti fvɨ̀ gvì nɨ̀ tɨ̀fô tɨ̀ nɨ̀ mbàŋsɨ̀ têyn ta yi n-nyɨŋ ibam nɨ̀ wùl ɨ choŋnɨ kɨ̀ nô sɨ ghal ma? Ba mà tî nà yisî du’ kɨ ghesɨ̀nà a ndô Fɨ̀yìnì i gha’nɨ, ye’î ghelɨ afu, yi ghal wi ma?
verses.niv: At that time Jesus said to the crowd, “Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come out with swords and clubs to capture me? Every day I sat in the temple courts teaching, and you did not arrest me.

verses.kom: Nô mɨ tì, awo nâ kèynà nɨn kelɨ sɨ gàyn sɨ luynsɨ ntûm Fɨ̀yìnì zɨ̀ a nfè’tɨ̀ sɨ gha’nɨsɨ nɨn læ nyà’.» Nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ɨ le’ visi ŋweyn nô sɨ̀ jɨ̀m.
verses.niv: But this has all taken place that the writings of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples deserted him and fled.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-ghal Jisòs nɨ̂n li meyn ɨ ndù nɨ̀ ŋweyn abe nɨ̀ Kàyafàs, ɨ ngàŋ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì i ngaŋtɨnɨ, asɨ nɨ̀ ndyèynsɨ̀ sɨ isa’sɨ nɨ̀ chye’sɨ ila’sɨ ta sɨ yvɨ̀ŋtɨ̀ afu.
verses.niv: Those who had arrested Jesus took him to Caiaphas, the high priest, where the teachers of the law and the elders had assembled.

verses.kom: Ghɨ se sɨ ndù, Bità ɨ nà sɨ jûmtɨ̀ ndû nɨ̀ ŋweyn nô sɨ aghaf, ɨ ndù ɨ zɨ abe nɨ̀ ngàŋ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì i ngaŋtɨnɨ nâ zɨ̀ ɨ dù’ì ŋêyn nchì sìsɨ̀ a sɨ nà n-fêl abe afu sɨ yeyn nâ, a nì gâyn gô’sɨ̀ ghà sɨ̂ Jisòs a.
verses.niv: But Peter followed him at a distance, right up to the courtyard of the high priest. He entered and sat down with the guards to see the outcome.

verses.kom: Ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì sɨ gha’nɨsɨ, nô nɨ̀ ànôyn a ghêl a sa’nɨ-a à jɨ̀m ɨ nà sɨ kɨŋ ghelɨ na ghɨ gvi ɨ̀ bè ìwo i ànkaŋ kûm Jisòs ta ka ghɨ zue ŋweyn,
verses.niv: The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for false evidence against Jesus so that they could put him to death.

verses.kom: mɨtì ɨ faŋ tɨ̀ yeyn nô ìwo ì mò’. Ghelɨ nɨ̂n fvɨ meyn nô sɨ idvɨ̀ ɨ nà sɨ wam ànkaŋ, kɨ kôynɨ̀ wì. Ghelɨ ghɨ li ni ghaŋ awo, ɨ fvɨ̀ ghɨ̀ bò
verses.niv: But they did not find any, though many false witnesses came forward. Finally two came forward

verses.kom: ɨ kæ bè na, «Wùl ɨ̀ wèyn tî bè na, yì kà’ a yì bɨytɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì i gha’nɨ ɨ̀ kàsî bà’lɨ̀ kɨ̀ a mɨchi ɨ̀n tal.»
verses.niv: and declared, “This fellow said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.’ ”

verses.kom: Ngàŋ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì i ngaŋtɨnɨ ɨ làlì ɨ bè sɨ̂ Jisòs na, «Wà n-taŋî wì â? Wà n-kelɨ wi iwo sɨ bè kûm àwo kèynà a ghɨ n-ghâm vâ sɨ ateyn tèyn â?»
verses.niv: Then the high priest stood up and said to Jesus, “Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?”

verses.kom: Mɨtì, Jisòs ɨ chimi kɨ moŋ. Ngàŋ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì i ngaŋtɨnɨ nâ zɨ̀ ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ và na wà taŋi kɨ̀ samo’ sɨ izɨyn nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fìfɨ̀ a fɨ n-chi. Fè’tɨ sɨ̂ ghès nâ, a wà ti n-ghɨ kɨ nô Christ a, kɨ nô Wâyn Fɨ̀yìnì a?»
verses.niv: But Jesus remained silent. The high priest said to him, “I charge you under oath by the living God: Tell us if you are the Christ, the Son of God.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ bɨmi ɨ bè na, «Yi n-ghɨ kɨ tì ta wà bè,» ɨ fi kæ bè na, «Mɨ n-bê sɨ̂ zɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m na, yì læò yeyn Wâyn Wùl, wu du’ ɨkœ ɨ two nɨ̀ Bò ɨ̀dwa’ ɨ̀ jɨ̀m, su’î gvî antêynɨ̀ mbà’sɨ̀ iyvɨ.»
verses.niv: “Yes, it is as you say,” Jesus replied. “But I say to all of you: In the future you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven.”

verses.kom: Ngàŋ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì i ngaŋtɨnɨ nâ zɨ̀ ɨ kasi ghal ɨ bàs ndzɨsɨ ŋweyn kɨ̀ sɨ a ŋweyn a ngeŋ ɨ bè na, «Wù telɨ meyn Fɨ̀yìnì! Ghesɨ̀nà nɨn fî kɨŋ nô sɨ ni gha nɨ̀ nchwò nsa’ a? Ba yi yvɨ meyn ta wù bè awo a bɨ-a kûm Fɨ̀yìnì?
verses.niv: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Look, now you have heard the blasphemy.

verses.kom: Yi n-kôŋ na ghɨ jel ti nɨ̀ ŋweyn a?» Àŋena be kɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m na, «Wù n-kelɨ sɨ kfɨ.»
verses.niv: What do you think?” “He is worthy of death,” they answered.

verses.kom: Ta àŋena tàŋi tî, ɨ nà sɨ chfɨlɨ̂ kɨ mɨ̀nchya a ŋweyn ikè’, leŋ ŋweyn, ghɨli kfɨ̂ynlɨ̀-à,
verses.niv: Then they spit in his face and struck him with their fists. Others slapped him

verses.kom: bê na, «Fè’tɨ læ̂ sɨ̂ ghès a Christ nâ à n-leŋ ndà vâ a?»
verses.niv: and said, “Prophesy to us, Christ. Who hit you?”

verses.kom: Bità nà n-bu du’ kɨ ɨwe tî ta wù nì gvì dù’ì, wayn wi ɨ̀ lvì a wu nà n-fêl abe afu ɨ gvì ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Wà ti meyn nà boŋ jêl kɨmɨ ibam nɨ̀ Jisòs, ɨ wul ɨ̀ Galìlî nâ wèyn.»
verses.niv: Now Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, and a servant girl came to him. “You also were with Jesus of Galilee,” she said.

verses.kom: Mɨtì, wu tuynsɨ kɨ asɨ nɨ̀ àŋena ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m ɨ bè na, «Mɨ n-yvɨ kelî wì iwo zɨ̀ a wà n-bê.»
verses.niv: But he denied it before them all. “I don't know what you're talking about,” he said.

verses.kom: Wu bè tì, ɨ lù ɨ fvɨ ndù dzɨ a ɨchfɨ abe afu. Wayn wi ɨ̀ lvì ɨ fi yeyn ŋweyn ɨ bè kɨ sɨ̂ ghelɨ ghì a ghɨ n-ti afu na, «Wùl ɨ̀ wèyn ti meyn nà jêl ŋêyn Jisòs, ɨ wûl ɨ̀ Nazalèt nâ wèyn.»
verses.niv: Then he went out to the gateway, where another girl saw him and said to the people there, “This fellow was with Jesus of Nazareth.”

verses.kom: Bità ɨ fi tuynsɨ kɨ̀ nô sɨ ikàyntɨ̀ ɨ bè na, «Mɨ n-bê samo’ na mɨ n-kya wi wul àteyn!»
verses.niv: He denied it again, with an oath: “I don't know the man!”

verses.kom: Ghɨ fi mùtɨ kɨ têyn, ghelɨ nâ ghì a ghɨ nì nà ti afu tì ɨ ndu bè sɨ̂ Bità na, «Yi n-ghɨ kɨ nô samo’ na wà n-ghɨ wul ɨ̀ mò’ anòyn nɨ̀ Jisòs bòm ta wà n-lofɨ taŋî kɨ ta wul ɨ̀ Galìlî.»
verses.niv: After a little while, those standing there went up to Peter and said, “Surely you are one of them, for your accent gives you away.”

verses.kom: Bità ɨ bè na, «Ma na wam wam, Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ fu nge’ sɨ̂ mà. Mɨ n-kya wi wul àteyn!» Ta wù n-taŋi gvî kɨ têyn, lûm ngvɨ ɨ toŋ.
verses.niv: Then he began to call down curses on himself and he swore to them, “I don't know the man!” Immediately a rooster crowed.

verses.kom: Wu kasi kfà’tɨ̀ ta Jisòs nì bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Lûm ngvɨ ɨ nì se sɨ toŋ ma wà mo meyn mà ìngal ì tal.» Nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, Bità ɨ fvɨ̀ ɨ ndù abe ɨ dzɨ̀ nô sɨ a ŋaŋ.
verses.niv: Then Peter remembered the word Jesus had spoken: “Before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times.” And he went outside and wept bitterly.

verses.kom: Ɨtu’ ɨ bɨs layn, ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì sɨ gha’nɨsɨ nô sɨ̀ jɨ̀m nɨ̀ chye’sɨ ila’sɨ sɨ̀ jɨ̀m ɨ ba’tɨ sɨ zue Jisòs,
verses.niv: Early in the morning, all the chief priests and the elders of the people came to the decision to put Jesus to death.

verses.kom: ɨ kul ŋweyn ɨ lì ɨ ndu fu ŋweyn sɨ̂ Balèt vzɨ̀ a ghɨ n-tum a Rome na wù na sa’ àbâs ila’ nâ kì.
verses.niv: They bound him, led him away and handed him over to Pilate, the governor.

verses.kom: Judàs vzɨ̀ a wu n-bèy’lɨ Jisòs ɨ yvɨ na ghɨ sɨ ghɨ sɨ zue Jisòs ɨ nà kumî ɨ̀wuyn nô sɨ a ŋaŋ, ɨ lì fɨ̀kwôtɨ̀ fìfɨ̀ a ghɨ tî fù sɨ̂ ŋweyn ɨ kasi ndù sɨ fu sɨ̂ ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì sɨ gha’nɨsɨ nɨ̀ chye’sɨ ila’sɨ.
verses.niv: When Judas, who had betrayed him, saw that Jesus was condemned, he was seized with remorse and returned the thirty silver coins to the chief priests and the elders.

verses.kom: Ta wù ndù tî ɨ se sɨ fu ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Ma ni meyn mbɨ bòm ta mà bèy’lɨ wul, ghɨ na sɨ ghɨ sɨ zue ŋweyn, bùla wù bebsɨ ìwo.» Àŋena bèynsɨ kɨ sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Ghès ɨ kfɨ gha ateyn a? À n-gô’ nsa’ ɨ̀ zyâ.»
verses.niv: “I have sinned,” he said, “for I have betrayed innocent blood.” “What is that to us?” they replied. “That's your responsibility.”

verses.kom: Nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, Judàs ɨ mà’ ɨ zɨsɨ nɨ̀ ɨ̀kwo ateyn a ndô Fɨ̀yìnì i gha’nɨ ɨ ndu shɨ̀ŋsɨ̀.
verses.niv: So Judas threw the money into the temple and left. Then he went away and hanged himself.

verses.kom: Ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì sɨ gha’nɨsɨ ɨ boŋtɨ ɨ̀kwo ateyn ɨ bè na, «Ɨwêyn nɨn ghɨ ɨ̀kwo ɨ mɨ̂lùŋ, isa’ i ghesɨ̀nà i bɨmî wì na ghɨ we a bò ndô Fɨ̀yìnì,»
verses.niv: The chief priests picked up the coins and said, “It is against the law to put this into the treasury, since it is blood money.”

verses.kom: ɨ lèm na ghɨ n-lî ɨ̀kwo ateyn ɨ̀ ndù yuyn alê’ a nse sɨ̂ wùl, wu bom ntòynsɨ̀, nà gvɨmì ghelɨ atum ateyn.
verses.niv: So they decided to use the money to buy the potter's field as a burial place for foreigners.

verses.kom: À ti iwo zɨ̀ a ghɨ bu toŋtɨ kɨ ale’ nâ kì na Gvêyn Mɨ̀lùŋ, sɨ chem layn.
verses.niv: That is why it has been called the Field of Blood to this day.

verses.kom: Yi n-gàyn têyn ɨ luynsɨ ntûm Fɨ̀yìnì zɨ̀ a nfè’tɨ̀ Jèlìmayà nɨn læ nyà’ na, «Ghɨ n-li meyn ɨ̀kwo ɨ silvà vzɨ̀, mɨ̀vɨm ɨ̀n tal a ghelɨ Isìlæò bɨ̀mi na ghɨ yuyn ŋweyn ateyn,
verses.niv: Then what was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled: “They took the thirty silver coins, the price set on him by the people of Israel,

verses.kom: ɨ yuyn alê’ a nse ateyn sɨ̂ wùl, wu bom ntòynsɨ̀, a ghɨ kɨ ìwo zɨ̀ a Bôbo nɨn læ bè sɨ̂ mà na mà ni.»
verses.niv: and they used them to buy the potter's field, as the Lord commanded me.”

verses.kom: A nà n-ghɨ ta ghɨ lì ndù nɨ̀ Jisòs sɨ̂ Balèt, wu bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Wà n-ghɨ fòyn sɨ̂ ghelɨ Jûsɨ̀ â?» Jisòs ɨ bè na, «Yi n-ghɨ kɨ tì ta wà bè.»
verses.niv: Meanwhile Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?” “Yes, it is as you say,” Jesus replied.

verses.kom: Mɨtì, ɨ teyn na yi n-bê wì iwo kûm àwo kì a ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì sɨ gha’nɨsɨ ŋêyn chye’sɨ nà n-ghâm ŋweyn sɨ ateyn.
verses.niv: When he was accused by the chief priests and the elders, he gave no answer.

verses.kom: Balèt ɨ kæ bɨf sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Wà n-yvɨ àwo kèynà a ghɨ n-ghâm vâ sɨ ateyn tèyn a?»
verses.niv: Then Pilate asked him, “Don't you hear the testimony they are bringing against you?”

verses.kom: Mɨtì, Jisòs ɨ teyn na yi n-bu bêynsɨ̀ wì nô ìwo ì mò’, iwo ateyn i nà bem kɨ tèyn sɨ̂ Balèt.
verses.niv: But Jesus made no reply, not even to a single charge –to the great amazement of the governor.

verses.kom: A nà n-gvî chem ɨlvɨ ta ghɨ n-yɨ ayɨ Iya’sɨ, gômnæò Rome a Jùdiyà ɨ bè ghelɨ cho’ wul vzɨ̀ a àŋena nɨn kôŋ na wù fvɨsɨ sɨ a ncha’, wu fvɨ̀sɨ̀.
verses.niv: Now it was the governor's custom at the Feast to release a prisoner chosen by the crowd.

verses.kom: A nà n-ghɨ tì, wul ɨ̀ lvì ɨ ghɨ a ncha’, ghɨ toŋtɨ̂ ŋweyn na Bàlabàs, ghelɨ kya ŋweyn nô a jûŋ.
verses.niv: At that time they had a notorious prisoner, called Barabbas.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ni gvì ɨ yvɨ̀ŋ sɨ cho’ wul na ghɨ fvɨsɨ sɨ a ncha’, Balèt ɨ kæ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yi n-kôŋ na mà fvɨsɨ nda sɨ̂ zɨ̀ a, ɨ Bàlabàs ma Jisòs wèyn a ghɨ n-toŋtɨ na Christ tèyn a?»
verses.niv: So when the crowd had gathered, Pilate asked them, “Which one do you want me to release to you: Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”

verses.kom: Wu n-bɨf tî bòm ta wu nà n-kya na à nì kɨ ànghè’, ghelɨ ghal gvì nɨ̀ Jisòs sɨ̂ zɨ̀.
verses.niv: For he knew it was out of envy that they had handed Jesus over to him.

verses.kom: Balèt nà n-bu sa’ kɨ nsâ’ Jisòs nâ zɨ̀, wî ŋweyn ɨ tum ntum sɨ̂ ŋweyn ɨ bè na, «Ka wâ n-we àwu à kya iwo nɨ̀ wùl ɨ̀ wèyn a wù n-kfɨ salû tèyn, bòm ta ma ti meyn kfa yeyn nge’ i kaynɨ a jem layn bòm ŋweyn.»
verses.niv: While Pilate was sitting on the judge's seat, his wife sent him this message: “Don't have anything to do with that innocent man, for I have suffered a great deal today in a dream because of him.”

verses.kom: Ta Balèt bɨf iwo zɨ̀-ì tî, ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì sɨ gha’nɨsɨ nɨ̀ chye’sɨ ila’sɨ ɨ chfɨtɨ ghelɨ na àŋena be kɨ̀ na, Balèt fvɨsɨ Bàlabàs ɨ̀ kwo fu Jisòs, àŋena zue.
verses.niv: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus executed.

verses.kom: Balèt ɨ fi bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Na yì bè na yi n-kôŋ na mà fvɨsɨ nda antêynɨ̀ nɨ̀ ghelɨ ghèyn, ghɨ̀ bò â?» Àŋena be kɨ na, «Fvɨ̀sɨ Bàlabàs.»
verses.niv: “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” asked the governor. “Barabbas,” they answered.

verses.kom: Balèt ɨ bɨf sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yi n-sæ̂ kɨŋ na mà fvɨsɨ ŋweyn ɨ̀ nì gha nɨ̀ Jisòs wèyn a ghɨ n-toŋtɨ na Christ tèyn a?» Àŋena be kɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m na, «Ghɨ bayntɨ ŋweyn a ànwâmnɨ̀!»
verses.niv: “What shall I do, then, with Jesus who is called Christ?” Pilate asked. They all answered, “Crucify him!”

verses.kom: Balèt ɨ fi bɨf na, «Bòm ghà, wù bèbsɨ nô ghà?» Àŋena fi byal ɨ ndù kɨ asɨ na, «Ghɨ bayntɨ ŋweyn a ànwâmnɨ̀!»
verses.niv: “Why? What crime has he committed?” asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify him!”

verses.kom: Balèt ɨ yeyn na yì sɨ yeyn kɨ nge’ salû ma inu ì kà’ a yi fî làlì, ɨ kæ li mu sɨ su ɨwu ɨ ŋweyn ateyn kɨ̀ asɨ nɨ̀ ghelɨ nâ ghì ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Mɨ n-kelɨ wi iwo kûm ìkfɨ i wûl wèyn. Nsâ’ zɨ.»
verses.niv: When Pilate saw that he was getting nowhere, but that instead an uproar was starting, he took water and washed his hands in front of the crowd. “I am innocent of this man's blood,” he said. “It is your responsibility!”

verses.kom: Àŋena bèynsɨ kɨ ghɨ̀ jɨ̀m na, «Visi, nge’ ìkfɨ nɨ̀ ŋweyn faŋ sɨ̂ ghès nɨ̀ woyn ɨ̀ ghesɨ!»
verses.niv: All the people answered, “Let his blood be on us and on our children!”

verses.kom: Balèt ɨ fvɨ̀sɨ̀ Bàlabàs sɨ a ncha’ ɨ fu Jisòs na ghɨ leŋ nɨ̀ ngvàlìsɨ̀ jæ na wù visi, ghɨ li ndù bàyntɨ a ànwâmnɨ̀.
verses.niv: Then he released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.

verses.kom: Sugèy’sɨ Balètsɨ̀ ɨ lì ɨ zɨ nɨ̀ Jisòs antêynɨ̀ nto’, nô sugèy’ sɨ̀ jɨ̀m sɨ gvì ɨ yvɨ̀ŋtɨ̀ a ŋweyn a ngùŋ.
verses.niv: Then the governor's soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company of soldiers around him.

verses.kom: Àŋena cho’tɨ ndzɨ sìsɨ̀ a wù nì mà’, ɨ mà’ ndzɨsɨ tɨ̂fòyn sɨ baŋnɨsɨ a ŋweyn ɨwùyn.
verses.niv: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him,

verses.kom: Àŋena nɨn bo meyn kɨmɨ àfol nɨ̀ ɨ̀tu ɨfwo, wu kelɨ sùnjoŋnjoŋsɨ ɨ sù a ŋweyn atu ɨ fi fu mbàŋ i nyamnɨ a ŋweyn awu, ɨ nà sɨ gvî ngu’tɨ̂ a ŋweyn asɨ, lû’sɨ̀ ŋweyn bê na, ‹Ɨchfɨ̂-iyvɨ i salɨnɨ-i nɨ̀ ghelɨ Jûsɨ̀!»
verses.niv: and then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on his head. They put a staff in his right hand and knelt in front of him and mocked him. “Hail, king of the Jews!” they said.

verses.kom: A ni chem aleŋ a li-a, àŋena nà sɨ chfɨlɨ̂ mɨ̀nchya a ŋweyn ɨwùyn, ɨ fi kasi fsɨ mbàŋ zɨ̀ sɨ a ŋweyn awu ɨkœ ɨ two ɨ nà sɨ leŋ ŋweyn kɨ̀ atu, mûtɨ̀ kɨ tèyn, fî leŋa.
verses.niv: They spit on him, and took the staff and struck him on the head again and again.

verses.kom: Ghɨ ni lù’sɨ mèsì ŋweyn, ɨ cho’ ndzɨsɨ baŋnɨ sìsɨ̀ a ghɨ nì mà’ a ŋweyn ɨwùyn tî, ɨ kasi mà’ ɨsɨ ŋweynsɨ jæ na ghɨ li fvɨ̀ nɨ̀ ŋweyn sɨ ndù sɨ bayntɨ a ànwâmnɨ̀.
verses.niv: After they had mocked him, they took off the robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him away to crucify him.

verses.kom: Ghɨ n-se sɨ ndù sɨ bayntɨ ŋweyn tì, ɨ yeyn wul ɨ̀ Sìlên ɨ̀ lvì a dzɨ, ghɨ toŋtɨ̂ na Saymùn, ɨ kàyn na wù bey’i ànwâmnɨ̀ a Jisòs.
verses.niv: As they were going out, they met a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross.

verses.kom: A nà sɨ ghɨ ta àŋena ndù meyn ɨ̀ chem alè’ ghè a ghɨ nà n-toŋtɨ na Golgatà, ma à ti Alè’ Iwò’ Atu,
verses.niv: They came to a place called Golgotha (which means The Place of the Skull).

verses.kom: ɨ fu mɨlû’ sɨ̂ ŋweyn afu, ma ghɨ we meyn gvɨ ateyn. Wu mom kɨ mom ɨ teyn na yi n-nyvɨ wi.
verses.niv: There they offered Jesus wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, he refused to drink it.

verses.kom: Ghɨ ni bayntɨ mèsì ŋweyn ɨ lèm ndzɨsɨ ŋweyn ɨ nà sɨ tɨm bèy’, gwôtɨ̀-à,
verses.niv: When they had crucified him, they divided up his clothes by casting lots.

verses.kom: ɨ ni mèsì ɨ dù’ì afu ɨ nà sɨ chî ŋweyn.
verses.niv: And sitting down, they kept watch over him there.

verses.kom: Ghɨ n-læ meyn nya’ kɨmɨ ìwo zɨ̀ a ghɨ nà n-bê na wù bebsɨ meyn abàŋ afo ɨ bayntɨ a ŋweyn atu ànwâmnɨ̀. Ghɨ n-nyà’ na, «ƗWÊYN NƗÌN GHƗ JISÒS, Ɨ FÒYN GHELƗ JÛSƗÌ.»
verses.niv: Above his head they placed the written charge against him: THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

verses.kom: Ghɨ n-bayntɨ meyn kɨmɨ ghelɨ ghɨ choŋnɨ ghɨ li ghɨ̀ bò a ngùŋ nɨ̀ Jisòs, ɨ bayntɨ ɨ̀mò’ a ànwâmnɨ̀ dzɨ a ɨkœ ɨ two, ɨ bayntɨ ɨ̀lvì ateyn nɨ ali-a ɨkœ nɨ̂nkœò.
verses.niv: Two robbers were crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.

verses.kom: Ghelɨ nà sɨ chwô a dzɨ, nê’ ɨ̀tu, telɨ̂ ŋweyn
verses.niv: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads

verses.kom: bê na, «Ba wà tî bè na wà kà’ a wà bɨytɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì i gha’nɨ ɨ̀ kàsi ɨ̀ bà’lɨ̀ a mɨchi ɨ̀n tal? Bœòsɨ læ̂ ngêŋ zyâ lvɨ̂yn! Wà na ghɨ kɨ nô Wâyn Fɨ̀yìnì, wa su’i sɨ atu ànwâmnɨ̀ afî, ghèsɨ̀ yeyn.»
verses.niv: and saying, “You who are going to destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! Come down from the cross, if you are the Son of God!”

verses.kom: A nà n-ghɨ tì, ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì sɨ gha’nɨsɨ nɨ̀ ndyèynsɨ̀ sɨ isa’sɨ nɨ̀ chye’sɨ ila’sɨ ɨ boŋ lû’sɨ̀ kɨmɨ ŋweyn,
verses.niv: In the same way the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders mocked him.

verses.kom: bê na, «Wù tî nà bœ̂sɨ̀ kɨ ghelɨ, lvɨ̂yn na sɨ ghɨ ma wù kà’ wu bû bœòsɨ̀ ngêŋ ŋweyn. Wù n-ghɨ tèyn bê na yi n-ghɨ fòyn Isìlæò. Wù su’i læ̂ lvɨ̂yn sɨ atu ànwâmnɨ̀ afêyn, a ka ghèsɨ̀ bɨmi sɨ̂ ŋweyn.
verses.niv: “He saved others,” they said, “but he can't save himself! He's the King of Israel! Let him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in him.

verses.kom: Wù n-ghɨ kɨ na yi n-ye’tɨ̂ ɨwùyn nɨ̀ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀, fî bê na yi n-ghɨ kɨ nô Wâyn Fɨ̀yìnì. Ghesɨ̀nà yeyn læ̂ nâ Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ̀ ti n-gâmtɨ̀ ŋweyn lvɨ̂yn a.»
verses.niv: He trusts in God. Let God rescue him now if he wants him, for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’ ”

verses.kom: Nô mɨ ghelɨ ghɨ choŋnɨ ghì a ghɨ n-bàyntɨ ŋêyn ŋweyn tì ɨ nà sɨ boŋ telɨ̂ kɨmɨ ŋweyn.
verses.niv: In the same way the robbers who were crucified with him also heaped insults on him.

verses.kom: Chùe ɨ ni bayn to, kɨ̀ têyn, ɨlwê’ ɨ kasi ɨ fɨ̀m kɨ ɨ̀ jɨ̀m ɨ ni fi kasi ɨ bayn kɨ aleŋ a chûe sɨ̀ tal a mbol àbè.
verses.niv: From the sixth hour until the ninth hour darkness came over all the land.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ byal ɨ bè nô nɨ̀ gya i to ɨlvɨ nâ ghè na, «Eli, Eli, lema sabatani?»  ma wù ti n-bê na, «Fɨ̀yìnì femfɨ, Fɨ̀yìnì femfɨ, bòm ghà ta wà mà’ì ma a?»
verses.niv: About the ninth hour Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” –which means, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

verses.kom: Ghelɨ ghɨ li ghì a ghɨ nà n-ti afu ɨ yvɨ tî ɨ bè na, «Wùl wèyn sɨ jâŋ Ìlajà.»
verses.niv: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, “He's calling Elijah.”

verses.kom: Nô mɨ ɨlvɨ gha, wùl ɨ̀ lvì a àŋena antêynɨ̀ ɨ nyɨŋ ndù ɨ lì nkùnchæ̂ ɨ chfɨ̀ a mɨ̂lù’, ma mɨ̀ to meyn ɨ fal ichɨ i fɨ̂kà’ ɨ nà sɨ fu ko’sɨ̂ na wù nyvɨ.
verses.niv: Immediately one of them ran and got a sponge. He filled it with wine vinegar, put it on a stick, and offered it to Jesus to drink.

verses.kom: Mɨtì, ghelɨ ghɨ li bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Yì te’ têyn, ghesɨ̀nà yeyn nâ, a Ìlajà ti n-gvî bœ̂sɨ̀ ŋweyn a.»
verses.niv: The rest said, “Now leave him alone. Let's see if Elijah comes to save him.”

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ ni fi dzɨ̀ nô nɨ̀ gya i to ɨ kæ kfɨ.
verses.niv: And when Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, he gave up his spirit.

verses.kom: Kɨ̀ ɨlvɨ nâ ghè, abâs a ndzɨsɨ kì a ghɨ n-ghàŋsɨ na kɨ gwosɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì i gha’nɨ ɨbyâs ɨ̀ bwò ɨ bàsa kɨ antêynɨ̀ àntêynɨ̀, sɨ zɨ̀tɨ kɨ ikùe sɨ kàlì sɨ fvɨ̀ itsɨyn, ɨlwê’ ɨ nà chɨŋa, ngò’sɨ̀ ɨ kfɨlɨ-à,
verses.niv: At that moment the curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook and the rocks split.

verses.kom: tɨfô tìtɨ̀ a ghɨ nà n-gvɨmì ghelɨ ateyn ɨ seynlɨ-à. Ghelɨ Fɨ̂yìnì ɨ kasi ɨ làlì sɨ ikfɨ, dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn,
verses.niv: The tombs broke open and the bodies of many holy people who had died were raised to life.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ læ kasi làlì sɨ ikfɨ, ŋêyn àŋena ɨ zɨ a Ntè’ i Ŋwa’nɨ ɨ ndù ɨ dyèyn ngeŋsɨ àŋena sɨ̂ ghelɨ, ghɨ dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn.
verses.niv: They came out of the tombs, and after Jesus' resurrection they went into the holy city and appeared to many people.

verses.kom: Atu a sugèy’sɨ̀ kì a kɨ nà n-chi Jisòs ŋêyn sugèy’sɨ li sìsɨ̀ ɨ yeyn tî ta ɨlwê’ ɨ̀ nè’à nɨ̀ àwo a kaynɨ-a a li-a kì a kɨ gàyn ɨ bè na, «Samo’, wùl wèyn tî nà ghɨ kɨ nô Wâyn Fɨ̀yìnì!»
verses.niv: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened, they were terrified, and exclaimed, “Surely he was the Son of God!”

verses.kom: Awo nâ ki nà n-gâyn tì, ghɨ̀kì ghɨ li ki-a, dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn, ti kɨ sɨ a nje, a ghɨ tì ma àŋena nɨn læ lù a Galìlî ɨ nà jêl ibam nɨ̀ Jisòs, gâmtɨ̀ gvî nɨ̀ ŋweyn.
verses.niv: Many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to care for his needs.

verses.kom: A nà n-ghɨ antêynɨ̀ nɨ̀ ghɨ̀kì nâ ghì, Mèli ɨ wû Màtalà ɨ ghɨ, nɨ̀ Mèli ɨ nà Jêm ŋêyn Josèf, nɨ̀ wul ɨ wi vzɨ̀ a wù n-læ bzɨ woyn Zebedì.
verses.niv: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's sons.

verses.kom: Wul ɨ gha’nɨ ɨ̀ lvì ɨ ni gvì aleŋ ɨlvɨ ikfa, a ghɨ wul ɨ̀ nte’ Àlimàtiyà, izɨyn i ŋweyni ɨ ghɨ Josèf, a ghɨ kɨmɨ wul ànòyn nɨ̀ Jisòs,
verses.niv: As evening approached, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph, who had himself become a disciple of Jesus.

verses.kom: ɨ ndù ɨ bè sɨ̂ Balèt na yi n-kɨŋ sɨ li igvɨyn i Jisòs sɨ gvɨ̀mì. Balèt ɨ bè na ghɨ fu sɨ̂ ŋweyn.
verses.niv: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus' body, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.

verses.kom: Ghɨ fu igvɨyn i Jisòs, wu lɨmtɨ nɨ̀ àmbalaŋ a,
verses.niv: Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

verses.kom: ɨ ndu gvɨ̀mì ŋweyn isè i fɨ-i i li ma wù chùf iwu ɨ̀ nà lêm na ghɨ læò gvɨ̂mì zɨ̀ ateyn. Wu gvɨ̀mì tì, ɨ bɨŋ ngò’, yi gha’ kɨ tèyn ɨ lèm ɨchfɨ̀ ateyn jæ na wù lu.
verses.niv: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut out of the rock. He rolled a big stone in front of the entrance to the tomb and went away.

verses.kom: A ghɨ tì, ma Mèli ɨ wû Màtalà nɨ̀ Mèli ɨ̀ lvì vzɨ̂ du’i meyn nà ki ndûsɨ̀ nɨ̀ ìsê ateyn i.
verses.niv: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.

verses.kom: Ghɨ n-gvɨ̀mi Jisòs achi ghè a ghɨ nà n-yisi ghɨ ba’tɨ àchi ɨtu’ ila’ ateyn. Ɨtu’ ɨ layn achi ɨtu’ ila’, ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì sɨ gha’nɨsɨ ŋêyn ghelɨ Falàsî ɨ ndù sɨ̂ Balèt
verses.niv: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees went to Pilate.

verses.kom: ɨ bè sɨ̂ ŋweyn na, «Ghèsɨ kasi meyn bètɨ̀ a Bô na à tî nà ghɨ ta wùl ànkaŋ wèyn bu ghɨ ɨtwo, wu bê na, ‹Mà læò kfɨ-a ɨ̀ kàsi làlì a mɨchi ɨ̀n tal.›
verses.niv: “Sir,” they said, “we remember that while he was still alive that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise again.’

verses.kom: Tum, ghɨ ndu nà chî ìsê i ŋweyn sɨ a mɨchi ɨ̀n tal, bu tì a njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ ndu choŋ igvɨyn i ŋweyn ɨ̀ nà jêl wam ndû sɨ̂ ghelɨ na Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ laysɨ meyn ŋweyn sɨ ikfɨ. Àŋena fì wam ìnki ànkaŋ nâ yèynì, ghelɨ bɨmi, a iwo ateyn i na bem chwô iyi asɨ-i.»
verses.niv: So give the order for the tomb to be made secure until the third day. Otherwise, his disciples may come and steal the body and tell the people that he has been raised from the dead. This last deception will be worse than the first.”

verses.kom: Balèt ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yì li sugèy’sɨ̀ ɨ̀ ndù lèm a dzɨ, ta ka sɨ na faytɨ̂ chî ìsê ateyn.»
verses.niv: “Take a guard,” Pilate answered. “Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how.”

verses.kom: Àŋena ndù ɨ lèm àlâŋ a ngò’ ghè ɨchfɨ isè afu, ɨ lèm sugèy’sɨ̀ na sɨ na chî ìsê ateyn.
verses.niv: So they went and made the tomb secure by putting a seal on the stone and posting the guard.

verses.kom: Ghɨ n-yìsi yɨ achi ɨtu’ ila’, ɨtu’ ɨ layn achi a kɨ asɨ-a ɨwe, Mèli, ɨ wû Màtalà ŋêyn Mèli ɨ̀ lvì vzɨ̂ ɨ kasi ndù ɨchfɨ isè nɨ̀ Jisòs.
verses.niv: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to look at the tomb.

verses.kom: A ghɨ ti ma nchì Bôbo ni meyn sù’i gvì iyvɨ, ɨlwê’ ɨ ne’à nô sɨ a ŋaŋ, yì ndû ɨchfɨ isè nɨ̀ Jisòs ɨ bɨŋ lìsì ngò’ zɨ̀ a yi nà n-ghɨ ɨchfɨ ateyn, ɨ̀ ko’ dù’ì atu àteyn.
verses.niv: There was a violent earthquake, for an angel of the Lord came down from heaven and, going to the tomb, rolled back the stone and sat on it.

verses.kom: Ikê’ i nchì Bôbo nâ zɨ̀-ì ɨ nà n-bayn kɨ tèyn ta ivɨ i myaynɨ-i, ndzɨsɨ ŋweynsɨ ɨ fɨf kɨ tèyn ncheŋ.
verses.niv: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.

verses.kom: Ta ɨlwê’ nè’à tî, sugèy’ sìsɨ̀ a sɨ nì nà chi isê zɨ̀-ì ɨ nà sɨ fâyn nchì àteyn, ɨ chɨŋtɨ kɨ têyn ɨ felɨ a nse ma sɨ kfɨ meyn sayn.
verses.niv: The guards were so afraid of him that they shook and became like dead men.

verses.kom: Ghɨ̀kì ghî ɨ gvì, nchì àteyn ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Ka yi n-fàyn. Mɨ n-kya na yi n-kɨŋ Jisòs vzɨ̀ a ghɨ tî bàyntɨ a ànwâmnɨ̀.
verses.niv: The angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.

verses.kom: Wù n-ghɨ wi afêyn, wù lali meyn sɨ ikfɨ kɨ̀ ighel ta wù tî bè. Yì gvi læ̂ ɨ̀ zɨ yeyn alê’ kì a wù tî nà nyɨŋ ateyn.
verses.niv: He is not here; he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay.

verses.kom: Yi yeyn, yi nyàŋsɨ ndu fè’tɨ̀ sɨ̂ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ na, wù lali meyn sɨ ikfɨ ɨ̀ nà kalì ndû a àŋena asɨ a Galìlî, na àŋena ndu ɨ̀ yeyn ŋweyn afu. Ba yi yvɨ meyn ta mà bè.»
verses.niv: Then go quickly and tell his disciples: ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him.’ Now I have told you.”

verses.kom: Ghɨ̀kì ghî ɨ nyàŋsɨ lù sɨ isè ɨ nà sɨ nyɨŋ ndû sɨ fè’tɨ sɨ̂ njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ Jisòs-sɨ̀. Àŋena nà n-ndû tì, bu fâyn kɨ fayn, mɨtì saŋlɨ̂ nô sɨ a ŋaŋ.
verses.niv: So the women hurried away from the tomb, afraid yet filled with joy, and ran to tell his disciples.

verses.kom: Kɨ̀ têyn, Jisòs ɨ kòynɨ̀ ŋêyn àŋena ɨ toŋtɨ àŋena, àŋena ndu ghal ɨvɨ ŋweyn ɨ nà sɨ ngvɨmlɨ̂ ŋweyn.
verses.niv: Suddenly Jesus met them. “Greetings,” he said. They came to him, clasped his feet and worshiped him.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ kæ be sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Ka yì fî fàyn. Yì ndu bè sɨ̂ woyn-nà ghem na àŋena ndu a Galìlî, a ka àŋena yeyn ma afu.»
verses.niv: Then Jesus said to them, “Do not be afraid. Go and tell my brothers to go to Galilee; there they will see me.”

verses.kom: Ghɨ̀kì ghî ɨ lù ɨ nà bu jêl ndû kɨ a dzɨ, sugèy’ sɨ lisɨ antêynɨ̀ nɨ ɨsîsɨ̀ a sɨ nì nà chi ise i Jisòs tì ɨ zɨ ndù antêynɨ̀ ntè’ ɨ fè’tɨ̀ nô mɨ ghà ta yi nì gàyn sɨ̂ ngàŋsɨ ndô Fɨ̀yìnì sɨ gha’nɨsɨ.
verses.niv: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests everything that had happened.

verses.kom: Ngàŋsɨ ateyn sɨ ɨ ghal nchɨ̀yntɨ ŋêyn chye’sɨ ila’sɨ ɨ ba’tɨ na ghɨ fu ɨkwo sɨ̂ sugèy’sɨ ateyn sɨ, wu dvɨ̂ kɨ tèyn,
verses.niv: When the chief priests had met with the elders and devised a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money,

verses.kom: ɨ bè sɨ̂ àŋena na, «Yì na bê kɨ sɨ̂ ghelɨ na, ‹À tî nà ghɨ nɨ̀ntu’, njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ ŋweynsɨ gvî, ghèsɨ bunî bùni, ɨ̀ choŋ lù nɨ̀ ìgvɨyn i ŋweyni.›
verses.niv: telling them, “You are to say, ‘His disciples came during the night and stole him away while we were asleep.’

verses.kom: Fòyn kæ yvɨ iwo ateyn, a ghèsɨ̀ keli kɨ̀mɨ ìwo zɨ̀ a ka ghèsɨ̀ fe’tɨ sɨ̂ ŋweyn sɨ chɨ̀ylɨ ŋweyn ta ka yì faŋ tɨ̀ zɨ a nge’.»
verses.niv: If this report gets to the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”

verses.kom: Sugèy’sɨ ateyn sɨ ɨ fsɨ ɨkwo nâ vzɨ̀ ɨ ni kɨ ta àŋena bè. Ànkaŋ nâ kèynà a àŋena nɨ̂n bà’lɨ ɨ waŋ kɨ ila’ nâ zɨ̀ ì jɨ̀m, ghelɨ Jûsɨ na sɨ chî kya kɨ na ghɨ n-chòŋ choŋ igvɨyn i Jisòs sɨ chem layn.
verses.niv: So the soldiers took the money and did as they were instructed. And this story has been widely circulated among the Jews to this very day.

verses.kom: Njùmtɨ̀sɨ ibam nɨ̀ Jisòs sìsɨ̀ njvà ì mò’ ɨ yvɨ ntûm ŋweyn ɨ ndu chem a Galìlî ɨ lù ɨ ko’ atû kfɨyn ì lì, alè’ ghè a wù nì tum fè’tɨ̀ sɨ̂ àŋena.
verses.niv: Then the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go.

verses.kom: Àŋena ndu chem afu ɨ yeyn ŋweyn ɨ nà sɨ boŋ ngvɨmlɨ̂ ŋweyn, mɨtì ghɨli bu kayn kɨ kayn nâ, a ti bè na à n-ghɨ kɨ nô ŋweyn a.
verses.niv: When they saw him, they worshiped him; but some doubted.

verses.kom: Jisòs ɨ ndù ɨ ba’sɨ sɨ̂ àŋena ɨ kæ bè na, «Fɨ̀yìnì fɨ fu meyn àdya’ sɨ̂ mà iyvɨ nô à jɨ̀m ɨ̀ fì fu sɨ a nse na, mà na sa’ ghelɨ.
verses.niv: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.

verses.kom: Yì ndu læ̂ sɨ̂ ghelɨ tɨla’ tɨ̀ jɨ̀m, ɨ̀ fè’tɨ̀ ntum ì jùŋ nɨ̀ mà sɨ̂ àŋena ta ka àŋena bɨmi ɨ̀ nà boŋ jûmtɨ̀ mà, a yì fu mu sɨ̂ àŋena sɨ izɨyn nɨ̀ Bæò nɨ̀ Wàyn nɨ̀ Àyvɨs a Ŋwa’nɨ-a.
verses.niv: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

verses.kom: Àŋena bɨmi tèyn, yi ye’i àŋena na àŋena na yvɨnɨ-à, nî àwo à jɨ̀m kì a mà sɨ ghɨ ma ma be meyn sɨ̂ zɨ̀ na yì na ni-à. Mà na ghɨ kɨ ghɨ ghesɨ̀nà. Yì na kya na mà læò visî wì zɨ nô ta ka mbzɨ læ̂ mæò.»
verses.niv: and teaching them to obey everything I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age.”
